mod_name: Evolving Traits World (ETW) [B41/B42] - alternative to "Dynamic Traits"
description: Welcome to the world of Evolving Traits This mod allows you to get really ripped in PZ and see an actual character progression besides getting your skills from lvl 0 to lvl10. You'll be able to purge the majority of negative traits and earn a lot of positive ones (but also earn some negative ones as well). This would help you to go from your average Joe to actual GigaChad in-game. You repair a lot of cars? You get better at it. You train yourself to take long-range kills with proper rifles? Why wouldn't it warranty getting Eagle-Eyed? You pick up thousands of plants through your lifetime and still can't call yourself Herbalist? Yea, that doesn't sound right to me. You maintain great sleeping schedule but for some reason you still need same amount of sleep as when you were sleeping whenever? Not anymore. Welcome to the Dynamic Traits World, ladies and gentlemen! Features UI with all needed mod information in-game! Default hotkey is "[", changeable in settings. 70+ dynamic traits (vanilla + added by the mod). FULL sandbox customization. Choose which perks you want to be dynamic, choose how fast you get them, choose how fast you lose them, customize anything with more than 150 sandbox options. Nothing is forced upon player, if you like 1% of the mod, you can literally set it up so you get to use that 1% and nothing else. Advanced systems that affect a lot of traits. Affinity system, that allows you to stick to your starting traits better. Delayed traits system, that allows you to get/remove traits with random delay. (B41 ONLY) QOL (Quality of Life) submod - mark all traits that are dynamic so in character creating you can see which perks are obtainable during gameplay! Can be enabled without enabling main mod, so if you don't like main features added by this mod and just want to see which traits are dynamic in your game with SOTO/MST/MT/DT - you can do that. For new traits (aka not vanilla game), customization is also present. Want Hoarder perk to give you more carry weight per point of STR? Go adjust it in Sandbox. Want to be even happier under rain with Pluviophile? Sandbox it is. (B41 requires mod, B42 has in-game mod options now)Client-sided configuration available with Mod Options. (B41 ONLY) Don't like some/all traits added by this mod but only want to have vanilla traits dynamic? Also possible, with help of Evolving Traits World (ETW) - Disable Selected Traits. Compatibility and Installation Installation instructions can be found in this discussion. List of compatible/incompatible mods can be found in this discussion, including details on: Dynamic Traits, Expanded Taits, More Traits, zRe ARMOR PACK by kERHUS, Simple Overhaul: Traits and Occupations (SOTO), More Simple Traits (MST), Explorer Trait, SixthSense, Superb Survivors!, Snake's Mod Pack 41.77 Recommended Mods (b41) Mod Manager and Mod Manager: Server - for the love of god, use these and not vanilla mod manager Moodle Quarters - so you can clearly see which stage your moodle is in right now Clear description for Moodles - so you know what your moodles do More Description for Traits - so you can read what your traits do Change Sandbox Options (by Star) - use this to change SP starting options mid-game. ATTENTION: upon changing any settings it's highly recommended to reload save (if SP) or rejoin server (if MP) for technical reasons (mod decides what to run based on sandbox settings when character is loaded in game world) GitHub and Discord If you want to submit translation files, make suggestions or report bugs, the easiest way to do it would be on Discord. description: About Tired of scrolling to your equipped section of the inventory to check your weapon's status and attachments? This mod allows you to inspect your currently equipped weapon on your primary hand at anytime, by: - Hold down the reload button and choose "Inspect Weapon" - Right click on any weapon in your inventory or a world container and choose "Inspect Weapon" will automatically try to equip it in your primary hand slot and inspect it - Pressing ; button to inspect current weapon. You can rebind this button through PZ's default option menu This mod comes with a simple UI and a terrible animation that took an hour to make :) Stats & Navigating UI Unlike the exact stats that are shown within the weapon's tooltip, the "condition" and "number of repair" stat are shown in estimation text (yes, I took this out of the DayZ book). I personally think that this will give players a better immersion on how their characters physically see the condition of the weapon, rather than numbers on a datasheet. Condition - Pristine: This weapon has a perfect 100% condition, and on top of that, it was never repaired - Used: This weapon has a condition between 50%, all the way to 100%. Weapons that are 100% but were repaired even once will get knocked down from "Pristine", to this category - Damaged: This weapon has a condition between 30% to 50% - Badly Damaged: This weapon has its condition less than 30% Number of repair - No sign of repair: Pretty self-explanatory, this weapon hasn't been repaired even once - Slightly repaired: This weapon has been repaired, but less than 3 times - Heavily repaired: This weapon has been repaired at least 3 times It is sort of hard to determine what's the good number for "Number of repair" stat. Realistically, I think 3 times duct taping or replacing some parts of a firearm would look noticeable enough to be deemed "Heavily repaired" Repair If weapon is damaged, an "information" button will be shown next to "Number of repair" stat. You can press on it and directly fix your weapon from the pop-up context menu, just like how you usually do it within the inventory pane Attachments This section is only shown for ranged weapon. I am not too sure if the melee weapons can use attachments (or any mods out there that allows it), prove me wrong :) Attachments can be equipped by clicking on a blank attachment slot, and a list should show options for compatible attachments for that slot. To un-equip it, double clicking on a currently equipped slot. For "Magazine" slot specifically, ammo will be shown for each one, and you can choose to load or unload them by right clicking on them. For controller You can navigate the UI using D-Pad buttons, with A (South) Button as accept, B (East) Button as Back/Close, and X (West) Button as Context/Sub menu Also please be advised, I am aware of the issue that the radial menu entry not showing. This has to do with other gun mods overwriting all the radial menu entries. For VFE specifically, I am working with the devs to figure out a solution to that. description: This mod adds an event that takes some inspiration from the "You Have One Day" challenge. Zombies migrate away from the player and form massive hordes, which, after a certain period of time, return to hunt the player. This mod is intended to work in both singleplayer and multiplayer (albeit limited). This will work on both new and existing saves. The event cycles through three phases: The Cooldown Phase - The time between events. Gameplay is normal and zombies will behave as usual. The 'Calm' Phase - The period in which mass zombie migration occurs. Towns and cities will seem deserted and eerily quiet. This gives players the opportunity to scavenge and build defences before the inevitable horde arrives. The 'Storm' Phase - Zombies return in massive hordes and persistently hunt down the player(s). Zombies are, by default, always aware of the player's position, which can be changed in the sandbox menu. Players will be notified of the start of the storm phase by the sound of wind and distant zombie noises. Note that unlike mods such as Horde Night and Here They Come, this does not spawn any zombies, but rather moves the existing ones in the world to form hordes. The mod is very customizable through the custom sandbox menu and allows you to adjust the duration of each phase, as well as the radius and distance of the horde. Workshop ID: 2953621037 Mod ID: CBTS

description: Tired of zombies splattering their brains all over your pretty lawn? Well no more! Just wait for some rain or snow and watch it all fade away. What does it do? When it's raining or snowing, blood slowly fades from floors, walls, vehicles, and even your worn clothing. Ash from burned corpses is cleaned up too. Everything is gradual and configurable. Does it work in multiplayer? Yes, fully server-authoritative. What about ash? Same as blood — ash from burned corpses will slowly be cleaned by rain or snow. Does it also clean clothes and vehicles? Yes! Both are optional and enabled by default. Your worn clothing and nearby vehicles will gradually shed blood and dirt while you're out in the rain. Can I add this to my current game? Yes, you can add or remove this mod at any time. It contains no save-breaking features. How does it work? Every game minute the mod checks the weather intensity against a configurable threshold. If it's raining or snowing hard enough, it randomly selects a number of nearby tiles and cleans them. Clothing and vehicles are cleaned incrementally on the same tick. Why not always? Immersion — watching blood fade in the rain just feels right. The gradual approach also keeps the performance impact minimal. That said, there's a sandbox option to always clean regardless of weather if you prefer. Sandbox options Everything is configurable: cleaning speed, weather threshold, tiles per minute, and toggles for ash, indoor cleaning, vehicles, and clothing. description: Hello survivors, Another Vehicle Claim System (AVCS) is a vehicle ownership system designed for MP. Yes, there is indeed already a vehicle claim system feature in a mod called Valhalla Community but this mod works differently and is a complete standalone mod with no other features except vehicle ownership. This is primarily made for KWRR community server as I want a mod that do a particular thing and I don't need any other features. Features Ownership tracking We track ownership very differently from Valhalla mod, so differently that it is made possible to remotely revoke claims via UI while being on distant edge of the map. Location tracking We tried really hard to find a way to track locations without putting much overhead on the server. This location tracking is not real time but good enough. It won't track vehicles that disappeared to the void. Actions probations KWRR is a community server thus we do not want to prohibit positive community behaviors thus we block very specific behaviors with primarily intention to prevent your vehicles to be stolen or griefed: Uninstalling parts Taking engine parts Deflating tires Siphoning gas Entering driver seat Opening (closed) trunk Attach or detach vehicle That is to say we allow everyone to Repair parts Repair engine Be a passenger Inflate tires Full access for Safehouse or Faction members Depending on sandbox settings, fellow safehouse or faction members will have full access to your vehicle which include the ability to unclaim them. AVCS is a simple personal vehicle ownership mod, not a comprehensive vehicle ownership which include separate system for faction and safehouse. As a middle ground, we simply provide the option at the discretion of server owners to allow fellow safehouse or faction members to have access to each other vehicles. Claim limits Through sandbox settings, you can set maximum number of vehicles one can claim. Mysterious Vehicle Claim Orb You are require to have a claim orb item to claim vehicle. Depending on the server, it can be sold on server shop or be simply be crafted. This is intended to act both as a economy sink for server with shop system and prevent claiming abuse. Vehicle ownership timeout Through sandbox settings, you can set the number of hours owner have to be offline before vehicle automatically release itself. Related Patches Tsar's Common Library & AVCS Compatibility Patch CarWanna & AVCS Compatibility Patch Vehicle Repair Overhaul & AVCS Compatibility Patch FAQ What is the claim item id so I can add to my server shop? description: IMPORTANT This mod is the legacy version of the mod. It will no longer be updated. Instead, you should use: Overview Vanilla sound events can feel repetitive after many hours. The same dog bark, the same distant gunshot—always random and disconnected from what is actually happening in the world. Reactive Sound Events reworks this system by making sound events context-aware. If it’s nighttime, maybe someone is being overwhelmed by zombies. If the weather turns extreme, chaos may be unfolding somewhere else. If survivors are nearby… you might hear the consequences. With this mod, sound events have meaning, not just randomness. Current Features 51 handcrafted sound events divided into several categories: Animal Sound Events (6) Gunfight Sound Events (12): Survivors fighting zombies or other survivors Gunshot Sound Events (11): Isolated gunfire in the distance Screaming Sound Events (5): Survivors in panic or pain Vehicle Crash Sound Events (5): Accidents gone wrong Weather Sound Events (8) Zombie Sound Events (4): More frequent during nighttime Event Preference System Each event type has conditions (“preferences”) that affect how likely it is to occur: Weather: Normal or extreme conditions Time of Day: Day or night Player Playstyle: Passive, aggressive, or passive-aggressive World Age: As the world evolves, some events become rarer while others become more common Player Location: Certain locations increase or reduce event priority Compatibility Compatible with all mods (no known conflicts so far) Mods that add sound events (e.g. Random Sound Events) are compatible; adjust settings to avoid overlaps Primarily designed for Singleplayer Worlds started with this mod enabled remain save compatible after updates Planned / Completed Features [strike]Add save compatibility[/strike] — DONE [strike]Complete sound rework (normalization and cleanup)[/strike] — DONE [strike]Separate Weather Events logic[/strike] — DONE [strike]Player reactions (panic, waking up)[/strike] — DONE (2.0) [strike]Expanded preference system[/strike] — DONE (2.0) Event Scenes: Environmental storytelling tied to sound events — DONE (visit Reactive Sound Events for the lastest version) Credits The Indie Stone — for creating Project Zomboid SonidosparavideosSINCOPYRIGHT, Sound Effects Library: Tema, squareal (freesound.org), and STALKER Anomaly developers — for sound assets Project Zomboid content creators — for keeping the game alive 5tratz, for pointing out what was no longer working in the 42.13 update and providing a temporary fix so the mod could remain playable until I updated it properly. description: Build Support: B41.78 and B42.12 to B42.19 Updated for recent Build 42 versions. SP / MP Host testing is recommended before using it on a live server. Dedicated server feedback is welcome. Surviving the Storm makes bad weather more meaningful and dangerous. Rain, snow, wet clothing and thunderstorms can now affect survival in a more noticeable way. The mod keeps PepperCat’s original gameplay idea, while the internal structure has been updated for newer Project Zomboid versions, with improved Build 42 compatibility and better multiplayer handling. Main Features Rain Rain can now wet equipped clothing and the player at a more noticeable rate than vanilla. Rain wetness is affected by: Rain intensity. Wind intensity. Clothing water resistance. Clothing wind resistance. Umbrellas and ponchos. This mechanic was originally inspired by the rain behavior from PepperCat’s older Dynamic Traits work. Snow Snow can slightly wet some equipped clothing. Snow exposure is affected by: Snow intensity. Wind intensity. Fog intensity. Clothing water resistance. Clothing wind resistance. Clothing insulation. Umbrellas and ponchos do not reduce snow exposure. Wet Clothing Wet clothing can increase the player’s body wetness over time. The effect is based on the total wetness of equipped clothing. Keeping clothes dry becomes more important during long storms, cold weather or travel. Thunderstorms Thunderstorms can generate world sounds at the coordinates where thunder happens. The sound can happen far away from the player, so zombies may move in another part of the map without you directly noticing it. The thunder sound radius can be configured in Sandbox options. By default, the radius is 500. For comparison, the vanilla gun event radius is around 600. This feature is especially useful if you play with pinpoint hearing or settings where sound strongly affects zombie movement. Sandbox Options Thunder world sound radius can be configured. Weather effects can be tuned through the mod’s sandbox settings. Server owners are encouraged to test values before using them on a live multiplayer server. Known Notes This mod affects clothing wetness, body wetness and weather-related survival behavior. Existing saves should work, but testing on a copy of your save is recommended. MP Host behavior has been briefly tested. Dedicated server reports are especially useful. This mod does not add new clothing, items, tiles or world objects. Credits Original mod, concept and design by PepperCat: PZ Workshop Build 42 compatibility update and maintenance by Afyrmo, with PepperCat’s permission: PZ Workshop Special thanks to everyone reporting issues, testing multiplayer behavior and helping keep PepperCat’s mods updated for newer Project Zomboid builds. If you wish to support the development of PepperCat’s mods, you can do it through PayPal: Copyright 2025. This mod does not have authorization to be published on Steam, except under the account name PepperCat. Afyrmo has been authorized to upload new versions on this Workshop item. Select the extraction zone (6 points in Louisville, 2 in Muldraugh, 1 in March Ridge, 1 in Rosewood) or pick it randomly. description: 42.15 update Huge thanks to Lenniitsch for updating the mod to 42.15. I've been really busy with work and new relationships and just haven't had time or energy to bugfix. He's another mod creator in the community so go check out his stuff :) https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3660382016 Are you tired of backpacks being too small? Have you ever spent 3 hours digging around looking for a decent bag only to get stuck with the school bag? Do you want a backpack upgrade mod that works with all modded backpacks? This is the mod for you! Introducing Dynamic Backpack Upgrades! The only backpack upgrade mod that can upgrade EVERY inventory container item in the game! Upgrade Mechanics Explanation Each container item will now have 1 or 2 Upgrade Slots. Containers that can be worn on your back get 2 slots. all other containers get 1. To add an upgrade you will need the upgrade item you want to add, a sewing needle, and at least 1 unit of thread. To remove upgrades you will need a pair of scissors. At level 10 tailoring, you can add an additional upgrade to any bag. Upgraded bags retain their upgrades until the item is destroyed or the upgrade is removed. This means you can add an additional upgrade to other people's bags if you have level 10 tailoring. Obtaining/Crafting Upgrade Items All upgrade items can be looted in the world, and all but the best ones can be crafted. The stats for each upgrade and spawn rates for each tier of item can be changed in the Sandbox settings. These stats are always displayed as part of the Upgrade Items tooltip and changes dynamically based on the sandbox settings of the world. Military upgrades cannot be crafted, but you can convert Military upgrades into their opposite type if you have level 10 tailoring. (Meaning you can turn a Military Capacity upgrade into a Military Weight Reduction upgrade) Capacity Upgrades Bag capacity upgrades have 2 components to them. Flat Bonuses and Multipliers. The Bonus will add a flat amount of capacity regardless of what kind of bag its attached to. The Multiplier will add a percentage bonus to the bags existing size, rounding to the nearest whole number. Example; a 10% bonus for the duffel bag would increase its capacity from 18 to 20. the bonus from the multiplier is +1.8, rounded up to to a +2. Formula; Capacity = math.ceil((BaseCapacity*(1+SumMultiplierBonus))+SumFlatBonus) Container Capacity is still affected by the Organized and Disoragnized traits. This leads to some pretty insane bag capacities with modded backpacks. (Brita's) Default values for Capacity upgrades; Weight Reduction Upgrades Weight reduction upgrades only have 1 component, their Weight Reduction Efficiency bonus. This value is not a flat bonus to the weight reduction of an item, and the math is fairly complicated compared to the capacity bonus. The weight reduction increase is a bonus based on the difference between its current value and 100%. Simply put, increasing a bags weight reduction efficiency by 50% will cause the items in the bag to weigh half as much as they did before. Increasing the efficiency by 25% will make the items in the bag weigh 25% less than they did before. and so on. Example 1: the Big Hiking Bag has an 80% weight reduction value. giving it a 50% bonus adds an even 10% bonus (20*0.5) bringing it up to a 90% reduction. Example 2: the Duffel bag has a 65% weight reduction, giving it a 35% bonus results in a bonus of 12.25, rounded to 12% totaling a 77% reduction Example 3: the Military Backpack has a 87% weight reduction, giving it a 20% bonus would add 2.6 (13*0.2), rounded up to 3%, totaling 90% Formula; Weight Reduction = 100-( (100-BaseWR)*ProductEfficiencyBonus ) Why do capacity upgrades break around 50 or 65 capacity? Zomboid has a hard coded limit of 50 for all inventories. The Organized trait applies after this limit, meaning that with that trait it can go up to 65. The base capacity is capped at 50 though, and will block any attempts to set capacity higher than that. Fixing this requires you to edit the vanilla files which you can find tutorials for in the pz workshop. I've never done it myself as I haven't played zomboid in a while or i'd make a post here. Is this mod compatible with Inventory Tetris? Yes and no, I've never used inventory tetris so i don't know how it works. I've been told in the vanilla game it segments the bags into various compartments. and that does break with modified inventory size values. turning it into quote "one big box" but otherwise I've been told it does work functionally. I can't pick up my backpack / My backpack is stuck in a container Yeah.. this is an issue caused by the 50 weight hard limit on every character. Weight reduction doesn't apply until you have the bag equipped, which means you need to put the full weight of the bag in your normal inventory before you can equipo it But, when dealing with upgraded or modded bags, its possible to fill a bag so much that picking it up would put you over that 50 weight hard limit before you can equip it, which prevents you from picking it up in the first place. To fix the problem, move the bag to the floor if its not already there. Then you can access its inventory and move things out of the bag to make it lighter, then equip it and put the stuff back in. Crafting Upgraded Items Warning When you upgrade an item with this mod, that upgrade info is saved as part of the items Mod Data. If you use the upgraded item to craft another item, it will be deleted and the upgrades will be lost. This isn't too likely, as very few mods use backpacks as crafting ingredients, but it's worth a warning anyway. Known Issues This mod has text clipping issues with pretty much any other mod that adds custom Tooltips. Sometimes items have their stats reset. Upgraded items will not automatically fix their stats by default. This was done to hopefully avoid conflicts with other mods that change item stats. If an item has unexpected stats then an option to Fix Upgrades will appear in the context menu for that item. If you'd like to help translate one of my mods or just need help sorting something out feel free to join the discord and message me. https://discord.gg/FgvW5vDyYV Workshop ID: 2996978365 Mod ID: LazoloDynamicBackpackUpgrades

description: Hello, this is my first mod for Project Zomboid. I realized that A LOT of people said that "there is no need to level the Electronics Skill past level 6," so why not make a mod to change that? As an electrician myself, I immediately started thinking about a lot of ways electricity could be implemented in the game better, so here we go for now... As said, the mod is aimed at giving the Electronics Skill a purpose on higher levels. So the new stuff mostly comes with a high skill threshold. It's quite powerful though if used properly. The mod should be compatible with existing save games; however, the loot will most likely only spawn in areas where the loot tables have not yet been created if loot respawn is turned off. New Items: 8 Recipe Magazines for upgrading Walkie Talkies, Radios, Ham Radios, Crafting Speakers, Motion Sensors, and Remotes 4 Circuit Diagrams which can be crafted by reverse-engineering electronic devices -> used by high-level electricians to craft some of the magazines above 3 higher-tier Noise Makers which will attract zombies from a wider range than the Vanilla ones - Compatible with Remotes and Motion Sensors 3 higher-tier remotes which let you trigger connected stuff from way farther away than the Vanilla ones An Electronics Kit for Practicing which, with the use of some materials, helps you get to the higher levels without dismantling all the TVs in the neighborhood New Recipes: Scavenge Electronics Scraps for Components Craft Upgrade Magazines from circuit diagrams (If your Electronics Level is high enough) The new magazines should spawn in bookshops and similar places, and the Electronics Kit is something children usually would use ;) I plan to add more functionalities to that mod, like automated doors and better generators/solar stuff/wind turbines. However, I still need to get used to coding in LUA, so that can take some time. If you encounter any bugs, feel free to notify me on the workshop page. Enjoy! Greetings, Luno Wroo Workshop ID: 2999183635 Mod ID: LWBetterElectronics

description: UPDATE June 26th: Added tiles, woodstain and siding NOTE! You need to have exact woodstain bucket or a tile pack in your INVENTORY, selection in recipe panel doesnt affect anything. Devs transfered wallcoverings to java and this is the only way i found to make it work these features doesnt work with Neat Building yet. Unfortunately B42.19 Updated. If your game doesnt start with only this mod enabled - write in comments BETA!!! Only plastering, painting and applying wallpapers available. Not all walls can be changed for now. For example, fossoil and other "location" walls. Tested in MP (host) Not sure about gamepad compatiblility. Not sure with what mods could be conflicts. What changed? I reviewed how mod works, now it doesn't rewrite tileproperties when it can be avoided and mostly relates on lua code added "arch" and "dbldoorframe" walltype, so you can paint them plastering and painting works via Building Tab like in vanilla game. added necessary doublewindowframe wall tiles enabled recently added vanilla wallpaper walls plastering removes cracks and grime and graffity painting doesn't remove cracks Wallpapers can be found only in crates marked as "CrateWallFinish", paint also available in crates marked as "ArtSupplies", "ToolStorePaint", "CrateRandomJunk", "CratePaint". As before you have more chances to find them in warehouses, garages, building shops. What in plans? add missing tiles find out how to add more wall cover types. Its now in java and I'm not sure that it is possible via lua. add more paintable wallshapes refresh old option with baseboards and other partial wall covering B42 changes: plastering requires new item called plaster trowel applying wallpapers now uses wallpaper paste instead of glue and also requires scissors. Have you ever thought why you can't make your walls look like walls of vanilla houses? With this mod you will have a wide variety of options to make your house look as you wish both inside and outside. PLEASE READ THE DESCRIPTION. Works for maps that built with vanilla tiles. Main goal of this mod is give the ability to have any walls without using MoreBuilds+ and rebuilding the wall, so if you live in vanilla house your wall stays invincible for zombies. Full options list: Plaster. I added an option to plaster all brick walls, all wooden walls, all cinder block walls. You will need a bucket of plaster and a trowel (Hand Shovel item, NOT a brush) and 4+ carpentry. You can not plaster walls covered with siding or tiles (ceramic or stone), for them you have next option. It doesn't replace vanilla plaster option for player-made-walls. In case of misunderstanding this is Trowel: https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Trowel (couldn't add image to text, sorry) Remove siding or tiles. If your wall is covered with siding you can remove it and get wooden wall, using a crowbar or a hammer. If your wall is covered with tiles you can remove tiles and get plastered wall, using hammer, club hammer or ball-peen hammer. Apply siding. If you don't like plastering your walls you can apply siding. Use a wooden plank and a wooden mallet. You will get brown siding, which can be painted in any of existing paint colors. Wood Stain. If you prefer plain wooden texture, but want a different color you can apply a wood stain on a wooden wall. Use a paint brush and a wood stain. You can see swatches on screenshots. Wallpapers. All plastered or painted walls (not siding, bricks or cinder blocks) can be covered with wallpapers. Swatches are on screenshots. Vanilla and Manik's wallpapers available. Requires wallpaper and wallpaper glue. Wallpaper glue can be only crafted from 5 glues, water and an empty water/pop bottle. Tiles. All plastered walls and garage walls can be covered with tiles. I added some additional textures to make bathrooms more diverse or have your own brick walls. Requires a trowel and a pack of tiles. Swatches are also can be seen on screenshots. Paint. Added 16 more paint colors (all painted walls you could see on the map). You can paint not only plain walls, but all siding walls, all brick walls and all cinder block walls in all existing colors. Mouldings for walls and doorframes (demo). You can remove or apply mouldings and decorative panels to make you walls double textured. Can be found in Carpentry menu. Based on More Builds code.This option will be upgraded in further updates. An error can occure while removing some mouildings on glass walls. Don't worry, its not critical, but I don't know how to fix it yet. Fireplaces. I needed this option and thought it would be logical here. You can build a fireplace with a stone frame as all vanilla fireplaces have. Fireplace shelf is now a table so you can place items on it. Can be found in Carpentry menu. Based on More Builds code. IF YOU HAVE PROBLEMS BUILDING FIREPLACE over stone or brick "center" piece make sure you DO NOT stand on same square that you want to build. Additional info: Mod works in SP and MP. Can be added to existing saves and servers. All new paints, tile packs, wood stain and wallpapers spawn as usual paint tins. One paint bucket can paint plain walls, siding, brick or cinder block walls. One paint bucket and plaster bucket now lasts longer. (UseDelta = 0.01 intead 0.1) Changing wall color or texture now removes dirt, graffiti and cracks. (Huge thanks to Skizot for "Repair walls extended" mod, from which I got the code for cracks!) Wooden walls can be disassembled All color swatches can be seen on screenshots. Might be little different according to lightning in your game. Replaced textures of 3d paint tins so they are more similar to resulting wall color. Replaced tile for white painted wall with whiter one. In vanilla game plaster and white paint have same swatch. I don't like it, so now plaster matches ivory paint color. Non-standart window walls and half walls are not yet plasterable or changeable. Will fix this in further updates NEW! 18/08/23 Big update. ADDED PLASTERING AND PAINTING TO ALL WALLS. NEW! 29/07/23 Added clean wallpapers from "Manik's a Decade later" mod. HUGE thanks to Manik Goblyn for permission ang sharing the tilesheet! Check screenshots for names and swatches. NEW! 17/09/24 Added separate version for those who use Building Menu Added compatibility with RV interior walls. You can now plaster them. My mod should be loaded AFTER RV mod or you will lose your walls forever! Known Issues: Error popup on removing door moulding. not critical PLANS (not soon): Add a possibility to paint halfwalls and some other non-standart walls. Rework moulding stuff. TRANSLATIONS If you want to add your language send the file to me on discord @birget.lisa or write in "Translations" discussion and I'll add it in the nearest planned update Workshop ID: 2999595757 Mod ID: Wallpapers Mod ID: WallpapersBM Mod ID: WallpapersOLD

description: Description Immersive Lore is a mod that breathes life into the post-apocalyptic world. Immerse yourself in the raw emotions and untold stories of survivors and victims who have left behind fragments of their existence. Scattered throughout the world, these weathered papers hold precious thoughts, heartfelt letters, and intimate reflections from the early days of the apocalypse. NOTE: The vegetation in the preview images are from the 10 years later mod. Q&A How does this mod work? Immersive Lore introduces a new item, "Tattered Paper," to the game. These weathered remnants serve as vessels for the poignant thoughts and messages of those affected by the apocalypse. As you explore the world, you'll stumble upon these items, granting you the opportunity to delve into the narratives they hold. Unfolding the stories within, you'll gain insight into the lives of survivors and victims, immersing yourself in their experiences during the apocalypse Where can I find the item? This item can be discovered in a variety of locations scattered throughout the game world, such as offices, kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and more. Each spawn location holds the potential for a unique story, ensuring that you encounter a diverse range of narratives as you explore. How many stories are there? At the time this mod was last updated (6th of May, 2025), there are a total of 188 stories Is it possible to come across the same story twice? Technically speaking, yes. The mod employs a prioritization system that aims to present you with new and unseen stories whenever possible. However, there are still rare cases where you'd see a repeat story, such as having already read all stories the mod has to offer. How do I blacklist certain stories from spawning? Each story has a unique ID. To find the ID of the story you want to block, head to mod directory/media/lua/shared/Translate/EN/UI_EN.txt. Press Ctrl + f and search for the story you want to blacklist. The ID of the story will be in the translation name. For example, UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_1_Title points to story with id 1. Compile a list of ids you want to block separated by semi-colons, like 1;14;16;32;94, then go to sandbox options of the mod and paste it into the "Blacklisted Stories" field. Compatibility Other Mods - No known incompatibilities with other mods currently. Game Version - Tested and works on 41.78.16+. Not tested on earlier versions. Multiplayer - Functional in multiplayer. Pre-existing saves - Can be added to your pre-existing save, although the item most likely won't show up in areas you've already looted. Known Bugs/Issues None at the moment. If you come across any, feel free to report them so they can be fixed as soon as possible Translations Translations are in progress for this mod. If you'd like to contribute to translating it to your native language, the help would be greatly appreciated and you'll be credited on the mod page! Feel free to head over to the translations discussion. Links - Join us on Discord - I love Coffee. Perhaps you'll consider buying me one? Feedback Whether it is a suggestion, feedback, or something else you've got on mind, it'd be hugely appreciated! Credits The letters and notes found in this mod have been authored by different people. Huge thanks to all of them! Background image used in the video by kjpargeter on Freepik The voice in the video is generated by ElevenLabs This mod's permissions fall under TIS's policy Ask for permission This mod can only be added to and extended with the express permission from the original creator. Having received permission, credit must be given to the original creator, both within the files of the mod and wherever the mod roams online. If no permission is received you may not alter the mod, and it must be treated as a mod that is 'On Lockdown'. The only exception is that servers may freely include this mod in their modpacks, with the freedom to alter it or make modifications as they see fit, as long as credits are properly given to the original creator. description: NOW IN BETA FOR BUILD 42! Have you ever wondered what a real-life furry might experience during the zombie apocalypse? This mod--Anthro Traits--attempts to answer this question by adding in relatively realistic and balanced traits that are specific to Anthros. Choose between traits like Carnivore, Herbivore, Hoofed, Beast of Burden, or even... Stinky? Customize almost everything about these traits, including how strong they are, how many points they're worth, and more! Roleplay your fursona, a popular character, or any other Anthro in your quest to Die Just the Way you Want! Compatibility Generally, Anthro Traits is compatible with other mods. Anthro Traits has built-in compatibility for, but may not work perfectly with: Expanded Traits More Simple Traits Simple Overhaul Traits and Occupations More Traits Anthro Traits may not play nice with mods that: edit item tooltips. edit character creation GUIs. affect timed actions. affect how food is eaten by players. are "overhauls". add the same sort of traits. Positive Trait List Anthro Immunity Knox Infection is rare, even from bites. Optionally, be infected as normal from anthro zombies. Beast of Burden Carry additional weight. Bug-o-ssieur You don't gain unhappiness or boredom when eating bugs. Will find more insects when foraging. Carnivore Meat is more beneficial for your character, plants less. Will find more dead animals when foraging. Carrion Eater Can eat rotten meat without getting sick (boredom and unhappiness still displayed in tooltip, but don't actually apply), is more beneficial than usual. Will find more dead animals when foraging. Digitigrade Feet cannot be scratched. Stomps do more damage, but carry weight is slightly decreased. +1 Sprinting. +1 Lightfoot. +1 Sneak. Feral Body +1 Strength. -1 Fitness. Food Motivated Food makes you slightly less unhappy and bored. Dog/cat food doesn't make you unhappy. Herbivore Plants are more beneficial for your character, meat less. Will find more vegetables, fruits and berries when foraging. Unguligrade (UN-gyuh-lih-grade) Feet cannot be scratched, lacerated, or bitten and won't bleed, but glass or bullets are still dangerous and will leave deep wounds. Stomps do much more damage, but carry weight is decreased. +1 Sprinting. +1 Nimble. Natural Tumbler The damage and severity of your falls are reduced. Tailed Reduces trip chance from zombies. Vestigial Wings Don't take fall damage. Bird-like/Feline/Sheep-like Voice, Adds a mitigation chance to the Exclaimer trait: sometimes zombies will mistake your warnings calls for real animal calls and ignore them. "Drag Down" In vanilla, if you are surrounded by enough zombies you get locked into "Drag Down" animation that always results in your death. The ability may* trigger immediately when this animation starts, preventing you from dying. 2. "Hit Activation" Since the "Drag Down" can be disabled in vanilla settings, this serves as a fallback option. With default settings, the ability may* trigger when you take damage by a zombie and there are more than 8 zombies in 1.5 (tiles?) radius. * note that there is an Endurance Cost & Requirement for the ability to actually activate - read more below. Endurance Cost & Requirement Ability consumes 20% of endurance and adds 40% of tiredness (fatigue) when triggered. description: This is a realistic overhaul of a mod called Advanced Trajectory. It tries to involve as much player skill as possible while having PZ's RPG mechanics such as moodles play a big role during gunplay. If the mod is too easy or hard, nearly everything can be customized in the sandbox options. If hosting a server, disable Anticheat 12 to prevent players from being kicked from no clipping from True Crawl/Crouch mod. If you are running into any errors, make sure you are not subscribed to any third party ATRO patches as they may be outdated. B42.14 Update 2/17 + 2/21: Check change notes to see info about previous updates. Fixed mod not working when playing 42.14 Fixed revolversfx not being removed in MP Many changes and fixes to Advanced Trajectory. Watch the video for an overview of the core changes. A lot has changed so make sure to also read past change notes. Gunplay (keyword is bloom) At levels 3 to 10, the gunplay works similarly to Resident Evil 2 Remake meaning the player has to wait a bit for the character to "focus" and aim for their target before hitting an accurate shot. For example, when a player is aiming and standing still, bloom value will reduce from 100 to 30. Once the bloom reaches 30, it waits for a second or two before reducing to 0. A value below 5 (crosshair changes color) is what you want as it allows you to deal the most damage when aiming for the head, otherwise, it will be treated as body damage. So don't waste your ammo spraying bullets because you'll either miss or do little damage. Let's call this whole thing the "focus mechanic" for the sake of naming. Higher level = higher accuracy and crit chance, less chance of missing levels 0 to 2: very bad at shooting with anything but shotguns; player is limited to only dealing body and foot damage, but is not limited to dealing crit damage level 3: focus mechanic is unlocked which allows the player to get an accurate shot on a target from afar (can hit headshots) level 6+: bloom reduction rate is capped and no longer scales, however the crosshair will continue to get smaller the higher level you are level 10: player can run n gun and is a headshot machine (if stationary) Hit/Miss (Can be disabled) When the crosshair is slightly transparent at a certain bloom (which is dependent on aiming level), RNG will begin to play a role in determining whether or not the individual projectile will hit their target. Shotguns give a significant buff in increasing the bloom in which the RNG will be in effect. Distance Penalty (Can be disabled) Crosshair will get bigger after a certain distance. The penalty is less severe the higher the aiming level and the longer the weapon range. Moodles Has a Cold: sneezing adds a big burst of bloom whereas coughing adds a little Drunk: more bloom is added when moving and turning Endurance: aim sways a lot Hyperthermia/Hypothermia: slows bloom rate reduction Fatigue: slows bloom rate reduction drastically Stress: limits the value of how small bloom can reduce to and makes crosshair shaky Pain: slows bloom rate reduction, adds shaky visual effect to crosshair, and limits how small bloom can reduce to Panic: increases effect of distance penalty and makes crosshair shaky Heavy: Similar to drunkness, penalty when moving and turning is amplified. In addition, stamina consumption when switching stances is increased and more bloom will be added when switching between crouch and stand stance. Weapon Attachments If you deck out your weapon, you will have a much easier time shooting. It can even nullify negative effects at a certain level. AimingTime(+) => Increases bloom reduction HitChance(+) => Shortens focus timer Recoil(-) => Reduces recoil Range(+) => Increases range True Crouch and True Crawl Support Not required, but a necessity for a full and funner experience. Switching stances will consume stamina based on fitness level and heavy moodle level. Switching stances between crouch and stand adds bloom while aiming. Crouch When performed, bloom is reduced for levels that have not unlocked the focus mechanic Bloom reduction rate is increased for all levels, helps a lot when exhausted Can burst a few bullets while ignoring the focus timer depending on the level and recoil Is OP when your gun is decked with attachments Crawl/Prone you get effects from crouch but better and faster time to focus (less time waiting at minaimnum) recoil reduced by half Suggested Mods [B41] Alternative Crosshair for ammo counter near crosshair To set it up, you'll need the "Mod Options" mod to make changes to the Alt. Crosshair. Go to your settings and locate Mod Options -> Alt. Crosshair, then set Ranged Weapon Crosshair to "IsoCursorFade" or "IsoCursorOpaque". After that, turn down the transparency of the vanilla isometric cursor in the main settings tab. Brita's Bow Dupe Fix for ATRO (Brita users only) To get the bows to work properly, download the fix and have it loaded after Brita's Weapon Pack. Then go to sandbox options -> ATRO[DEBUG] and check debugEnableBow. That's all you need to do. FAQ (MORE IN DISCUSSION SECTION) Does this work with multiplayer? Yes. Do I need the original Advanced Trajectory mod? No, this mod is all you need. Does this work with existing saves and can I remove them mid save? Yes and yes. Does this work with splitscreen or controller? No. Does this work with other weapon mods? Yes. Do I really need True Crouch and True Crawl [B41] or Lethal Stealth [B42]? No, but it is RECOMMENDED for a full experience. I'm missing my shots on zombies with 0 bloom. Why? The mod's crosshair is not always accurate. Sometimes, you must use the vanilla's isometric cursor. Make sure the base of the cursor is on their center of gravity. It takes too long for the bloom to get to 0, how do I make it faster? You can go to the sandbox options and increase the value of "Focus Counter Speed". How do I get rid of the crosshair's low framerate? Uncheck "UI Offscreen Rendering" in your settings. Does this work with Superb Survivors or any NPC mod? Yes, enable "Ignore PVP Safety" in sandbox options so you can damage NPCs with guns. How to get rid of iso cursor? Go to Sandbox options -> Advanced Trajectory (CROSSHAIR) -> set Iso Cursor [Transparency] to 0 I'm seeing 2 bullets being shot at once. How do I fix this? [B42] One bullet is from ATRO and the other bullet is from vanilla. PLEASE LOCATE ATRO MOD FOLDER THEN GO TO "42\media\effects" and read the README file for instructions. Do not enable hide tracer option in sandbox. description: Welcome to Tikitown! Tikitown sits between Riverside and West Point, near Fallas Lake, and plays like a full extra city rather than a small add-on. You can treat it as a long-term home, a supply-run destination, or just another problem on the road. Wander the old main street, pick through downtown shops and offices, or move into one of the custom houses and rebuild it to your taste. The town mixes familiar Kentucky sprawl with a lot of new places to fight over, fortify, and get lost in. Some spots are comfortable, some are not, and a few are better left alone. Tikitown's Own Powerplant The latest updated has removed power plant functionality for now, will attempt to bring it back soon. The plant mod can still be used and the facility is available, but NO FUNCTIONALITY is currently enabled Tikitown’s newest and most ambitious expansion is the fully functional power plant. It comes as an add-on mod that you enable separately from Tikitown, but it is bundled with this workshop item, so there are no extra downloads to chase. I’m working on a full user guide; the current version is already a bit out of date thanks to last-minute tweaks, but you can find it here: Tikitown Power Plant User Guide Feel free to give it a go and leave some feedback. I've added the ability to modify the wear rates of the power plant to mod options to suit your playstyle, and I’ll be making minor tweaks along the way including incorporating a fueling requirement. What’s new in Tikitown With the wrap-up of Domestic Dread, which adds more than 100 new locations, Tikitown has gained over 250 new buildings since the launch of B42. Even if you knew the B41 version well, a lot of the town has changed. • Downtown rebuild: A reworked business core with new landmarks, side streets, and trouble spots. • Rail and docks: A commuter rail line plus a large warehouse, railyard, and docklands for late-game looting and base ideas. • Blackshields Sheriff's Office: A large police station themed around the Blackshields. • FBI field office: A small federal site with security, offices, and higher-end loot if you can clear it. • Tikitown University: A full campus with lecture halls, dorms, and a proper, to-scale, American baseball and football field. • Mansion Row expanded: More big houses on the hill for players who like gated compounds and long driveways. • New underground spaces: Tunnels, garages, and service corridors that link parts of town and give you more options to move around or disappear. • Industrial sector overhaul: Factories, depots, and yards now built out as a proper industrial belt on the edge of town. • Tikitown Power Plant add-on: A fully mapped power station behind the hospital, with repairable equipment, custom loot, and an optional system to bring the town’s grid back online for a while. • Expanded docks: A fleshed-out Port Authority and northside docks, with more warehouses, offices, and places to stash a boat or a safehouse. Will you claim Tikitown as your own, or will it just be another place you passed through? Tikitown in B41 requires the following tilepacks: Melos Tiles Daddy Dirkie's Tiles Newburbs Drazion's Tilepack B41 Tikitown sits on the following cells: 23,23 23,24 23,25 24,23 24,24 24,25 25,23 25,24 We’ve been rebuilding Tikitown piece by piece and we’re not done yet. Here is some of what is still on the way: • High-rise work: More attention to the taller office area and business district to flesh out the area. • Extra underground links: More service corridors and tucked-away connections between key blocks and districts. • Street and traffic passes: Road markings, signs, and signals in the busier parts of town so it feels more like a real place that was suddenly left behind. Thanks for giving Tikitown a try. There is more to come. CN Translation CN Translation Workshop ID: 3037854728 Mod ID: tikitown, TikitownPower Map Folder: Tikitown

description: New Extractor Hoods in B42! Build them in a square where you place your generator to extract the fumes from it out of the building. All automatically, but the hood will not start until power is there and will not extract unless a running generator is under the hood in the same square. Popcorn Machines: They now have function and will convert instant popcorn packets and Sapph's corn kernels into edible popcorn without the pain of burning the food. Popcorn buckets are also added and you can butter the popcorn when in a bucket. Hotdog Machines: They also have function and will keep from burning those priceless sausages. It uses the base sausages and sliced bread in the game to make hotdogs. If you have Sapph's Cooking mod installed you can also use the sausages and hotdog buns from that mod as well. Soda Fountains: Are now plumbed objects and will dispense water for all the uses. It also dispenses soda to fountain cups and refills soda/water bottles for preserved use. They use soda syrups and CO2 tanks to operate. Just drop them into the counter the table top unit is on or put them inside the Slurp 'n Burp stand alone unit. These can now pull materials from any static container in the square or the square behind them. If water is a problem, try using water jugs from the Water Dispenser mod or plumb it like a sink. Bar Taps and Kegs: Setup the kegs in furniture containers with the taps connected and you can pour them into red cups, beer mugs, and refill bottles. Kegs pulled from any static container in the square with the bar taps. Compatible with More Brews and More Brews kegs now spawn in bar tap counters in 2.0! Food Display Counters, Buffet Islands, Rounded Glass Display Counters and Vending Machines: These are now temperature settable appliances for food storage. Some have Hot, Warm, or Cold others just Warm and Cold. Each segment has it's own settings. Now automatically spawn on when they can and switch to cold in ice cream parlors, cafes, bakeries, etc. Pizza parlors and other restaurants will default to warm. Soda Machines automatically default to cold. Industrial Deep Fryers: The deep fryers are now setup to randomly have vegetable oil in them. You can add and drain the oil. If you have power you can turn them on and fry various foods that usually need a pan of oil with Sapph's Cooking mod. A few new recipes have been added: Doughboys, Chicken Fillets, Chicken Tenders, Blooming Onions, and Fried Cheese Sticks. Added Sapph's Cooking Oil for a second option to fill the vats. Pay Phones: They have a minor interaction. If you touch them they might just ring but they'll attracted anyone that happens to be listening... Wall Clocks: They will now display the time. Clicking on them will give you the current time. Wall clocks work based on electrical availability, once off the grid they run off a built in battery that slowly drains. In Build 42, keys no longer spawn on doors. However, the logic for obtaining keys from doors remains intact. Therefore, this mod has been updated to be compatible with Build 42 in case door key spawning is reintroduced in the future. It's difficult to check the implementation frequently, so if you can confirm that spawn on the door have been restored with this mod for B42, please let me know! Overview & Features : Car keys spawn in the ignition, glove box, buildings near the vehicle, on the ground, and on zombies, but there is also a low probability that they will spawn on the "vehicle door". However, when it spawns on a vehicle door, there is no way to confirm that it has spawned, and it seems that the key can only be retreived under certain conditions. Therefore, this mod will add the feature to automatically retrieve the keys from the door and notify the player with a message when the player attempts to enter a vehicle whose keys are spawned on the door, regardless of the conditions. Confirmed to work with Build 41/42 and also work on MP. Q&A : What is the probability of a key spawning on a vehicle door? It is 1/4 probability compared to the spawn to the glove box. Of course, spawning keys on the door is not a feature of this mod, but of vanilla. This mod only reteives keys that have already spawn on the door. Is it possible to retrieve the key from the door without using this mod? Yes, it's possible. If a key is spawned on the door, it can be retrieved when trying to enter through a locked door. However, there is no notification, and the key is only silently added to your inventory. Do I need to try entering through every door to retrieve the key from the door? No, as long as the key is spawned on the door of that car, the key can be retrieved by entering through any door. Does it work even if it's enabled in the middle of the save data? Or do I need a new game? This mod makes it easier to get keys spawned on doors, rather than having them spawned on doors. Therefore, a new game is not required. Options : These options are available with Mod Options in B41. Finding Message Notification : Can specify whether to enable or disable. Sound Volume (Found) : You can adjust the sound volume when you find the key on the door. description: For B42 MP+ There is a new stand alone version. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3631572046 True Music Radio Default Radio Stations: 94FM (92FM in B42) plays from the global list or the Terminal A playlist at the station 94.2FM (92.2FM in B42) plays from the global list or the Terminal B playlist at the station 94.4FM (92.4FM in B42) plays from the global list or the Terminal C playlist when activated by an admin at a terminal 94.6FM (92.6FM in B42) plays from the global list or the Terminal D playlist when activated by an admin at a terminal 94.8FM (92.8FM in B42) plays from the global list or the Terminal E playlist when activated by an admin at a terminal True Music MTV TV Ch.211 in B42 plays from the global list or the Terminal MTV playlist when activated by an admin at a terminal Stations can now be changed in the sandbox settings, it is possible to change them mid-playthrough but you will need to restart a server if involved or replace the sandbox file in a solo game. These radio stations were made compatible with the True Music player mod and it's cassettes and vinyl. Without True Music song mods loaded, you will only hear the game's theme song and the terminals will only have a single tape and a single record. New! Song announcements, weather reports, and Horde Night compatibility. When using Horde Night, the radio will display a warning every hour on the hour. You can turn these off in sandbox settings and in solo games in mod options. Horde Night! https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2714850307 If you make the trip out to this station in the west end of Riverside, you can update two special terminals next to the computer. Drop your music items into the terminal and update the music list. The only limit to the number of tape/vinyl tracks added is the weight that the terminal can hold. Alternatively all the radio stations start with a default list of all the True Music mod packs you have in your mod list. The terminals can also revert the music back off the playlist if you want to change it back. If you switch the terminal options, all radios on those channels will update and play a new song. So you can use it to resync immediately or switch songs but it's always random. Just added in v1.11 the terminals will now start with some random music media in them but it does not pull tracks to the terminal channels immediately. You still need to make the trip out. Also the terminal on the western wall has an option to eject media. It will allow random spawns of media from that terminal. I will be working on a way to choose a title in the future so you can download the songs of your choice. The new sandbox settings allow control of the amount of media found in each terminal. The west terminal eject system is also limited to the same spawn amounts and the ability disappears once empty. Added in v1.13 play radios everywhere in single player with immediate world sync. In multiplayer the music must stop and be restarted between world switching as radios in inventories and backpacks can only be heard by that player. Added in v1.18 you can now turn off all TMRadio station music on all radios with mod options. Great for streamers that need to control the music. Added in v1.21 an admin can now activate terminals to control the 94FM and 94.2FM stations that are not at the station. This will help custom maps to control the music. Even though multiple terminals can change the music, only one can control the music list at a time. The last one that updated will be the one in control. Added in v1.27 radio stations can be moved in the sandbox settings. Added in v1.29 an admin can now remove songs from the global list so that the 5 music stations will never play those songs unless overridden by playing them from the terminal list directly. The admin can go through the terminal menu and add and remove songs from the list. The sandbox is also updated to choose to remove the theme music with TrueMusic, the additional songs added by TCCacheMP, or just the holiday music from the TCCacheMP mod. Known issues: ***On servers you may need to set anti-cheat 21 as false if it kicks players, it seems to be a generic failure involving corrupted mod files that differ from server to client.*** They way this works now, no longer needing script codes from the broadcast, just turn on a radio and tune in to one of the 5 stations. It will start a song immediately but if someone already started a song on that station it will be out of sync until the next song is played. Then both radios will be in sync. Handheld and inventory radios are not heard by other players in multiplayer. Handheld radios are only heard by the owner in multiplayer but zombies will still hear them unless you use a headset. New in v1.13 zombie attraction has a toggle and is default to off. Disassembling running radios will cause the audio emitter to detach, have not written a fix for it yet but on the way. Station location in southwest Riverside: https://map.projectzomboid.com/#4835x6283x6360 Updates: v1.28 Added - ability for the admin to activate the other 3 channels for control through a terminal, by default only the first 2 could be controlled Added - ability to turn off the theme music from the radios in the sandbox v1.29 Added - Blacklist for admins to remove music titles from the lists Added - Sandbox settings so that the theme music, TCCacheMP music, or just the TCCacheMP holiday music can be removed from the lists v1.30 fixed - bug with empty blacklist causing client mod data issues on disconnect v1.31 Updated to b42, work around to get tapes and records to drop until True Music is updated, can be used without True Music or the cache for now. Updated the terminals at the radio station to control all 5 stations. Updated to include a mumble removal (this may affect other mods so it needs to load separately). *** Now compatible with the new mod "TV & Radio ReInvented" as I have added the tuning decorations for those interfaces when that mod is being used in B42 *** ***Warning, some TM add-on mods are causing errors that are caused by old item spawning locations that do not exist in B42, they will need to remove those missing locations from their script files to stop the errors*** The new multiplayer true music jukebox is now available! True Music Jukebox https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3398874593 New Discord - A work in progress: https://discord.gg/cEZc6rBuHz Huge shout out to Burryaga and Lazarus for their help in programming and testing! description: Have you ever thought that you enjoy multi hit but feels a little too OP? Then this mod is for you. It brings: RNG check on each swing, depending on skill level Configurable parameters in sandbox options for overriding the game's default max hit values, including unarmed (Now defaulted to 2, because you have two hands) Minimum str requirement for 2 and 3 hits, enabled globally, by default off Shoving with a snow shovel now is different than shoving with a knife B42: Shoving is vanilla for the time being. Muscle strain not accounted for, might see later as a sandbox option. B41 ONLY: For shoving to be moddable it requires a java fix Copy zombie folder from this workshop item (Default: "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\workshop\content\108600\3138387399\mods\ProgressiveMultihit\zombie") over the main install of Project Zomboid (Default: "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\ProjectZomboid\zombie"). It should ask you to overwrite file and you need to click yes for all. Change explained below. To revert check integrity of game files. There will be no errors if you don't do the Java fix, but the shoving will work like vanilla. How it works in vanilla Each weapon has a base max hits value, which the game flat out applies if you have multihit on, or treats it as 1 if you have it off. For shoving, if you have any weapon equipped it's always 3. Shoving unequipped is 1. How it works after java fix Shoving now actually uses the max hit stat while unarmed, and when shoving with a weapon equipped it uses the greater max hit value of the two. Because it makes sense to only shove 2 targets since you have two hands, but if you pick up a large stick to use it for shoving 3. How it works after mod It adds a chance for the swing to multi hit or not based on the following formula: 10 % chance per weapon skill level, averaged with 10% chance per strength level For example, having lvl 6 weapon with lvl 3 str gives 45% chance. 50% penalty applied if a two handed weapon is being used one handed. 25% penalty per Exhaustion and Exertion levels applied multiplicatively Max chance can be capped at a percent given in sandbox options. Works in both SP and MP. Only client needs java fix, can't really enforce it. Works in split screen. Should be compatible with any modded weapon, as long as there isn't another mod interacting with the hitcount when swinging. Now works with other mods such as Multihit Limiter, need to uncheck override hit count toggle in sandbox settings. Workshop ID: 3138387399 Mod ID: ProgressiveMultihit

description: This mod has been discontinued, the new version is here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3534101589 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- One day I was playing and I thought "Wow, I wish there was a wider variety of clothes in Zomboid like I have in my wardrobe…” and then I realized “oh… wait, I'm a 3D artist, I can literally add EVERYTHING I want to the game" and so the idea of "Bianca Wardrobe" was born. Bianca Wardrobe is an ongoing mod with the promise of colossal proportions, at the launch date there are already 1,751 different variations of items weighing only 80 mb and the plan is to increase exponentially and always keeping quality first! My goal is to always improve the items that have already been released and each time launch more beautiful and cool visuals to improve your gameplay This mod will have frequent updates with different types of visuals and new ideas. My wish is that there are infinite clothes in Zomboid, in all possible colors and tastes for everyone to feel comfortable and happy playing! I feel strange doing an F.A.Q before launching the mod... i mean, no one has even asked anything yet Q: “Bianca, what do you plan to add to the mod?” A: Everything, literally, everything involving clothes and style! all styles, all fabrics, shirts, all clothes, boots, pants,hairs, coats, overcoats, helmets, hats, scarves, bags, wings, ponchos, harness, lingerie, panties, underwear, bras, caps, capes, glasses, nails, tattoos, earrings! of all variations, sizes and colors and in the future you can be sure that I will also make optional clothes and skins for animals (I would also like to make clothes and cars with neon but unfortunately Zomboid doesn't support emissive map, maybe in the future) Q: “Are the models yours?” A: Yes, I created all the models from scratch! This mod will not have any models that were not created exclusively for it Q: “Can I use your mod in my modpack?” A: Of course, feel free to use. Q: “Is this mod incompatible with X mod?” A:anything should work, if there is an error it's not the mod's fault because it is very simple and just adds items known incompatible mods: Paw Low Loot Q: “Can you add X mod compatibility?” A:I'm not going to add compatibility with any mod because it takes time to learn how the other mod works and put it into practice, but if you want to add compatibility feel free! the more compatibility the better Q: “This mod must weigh a lot, won't my game have problems because of this?” A: I know how annoying it is to use a cool mod that is poorly optimized and disrupts your game! Don't worry, that won't happen here. As I said, there are currently 1,750 item variations and the mod only weighs 80 mb. I worry as much as possible about getting the most out of a model or texture that I can without consuming unnecessary weight. Furthermore, the mod will never stop being more and more polished! It is always possible to optimize further Q: “There are many items, how does the drop work? Will my game be full of items from your mod?” A: I also have a big concern about the drop table, I don't want to pollute people's games and hinder other mods from spawning their own items! That's why I did everything I could to make it easier to acquire items without having to pollute the game. The drop table won't be intrusive, you'll find mod items but not at a high frequency! and to compensate for this, the mod has 2 more possibilities to get the items: the selection of clothes in the home menu and the "Fashionmancer" This is a pretty big mod so it's understandable that errors will appear that I didn't notice before! It is very difficult to organize the workshop comments so if you are going to report an error, please do it on discord. Did you like our mods and do you play or know a friend who plays FiveM? Then go check out our Tebex store! Now, in addition to using Bloodforge items on your Project Zomboid character, you can also use them in GTA RP! Did you like my work and want to support me and help my mods have frequent updates? support me on ko-fi! <3 Special Thanks <3 Roddo Thanks for ES translation in both mods, Bianca Boxes and Bianca wardrobe WastelandCanid Thanks for your commission, trust, preference and for always being kind Did you like it? Go check out other mods we made! description: This mod provides the ability for players to repair their guns using a dish towel with expendable uses available, a toothbrush, and a screwdriver. The amount repaired is based on your maintenance skill, meaning the higher your maintenance the more you will see repaired to a certain degree since weapon condition is something that is typically represented by an integer value in Project Zomboid. ------------------ Default System ------------------ The math for determining how much you repair with each attempt is equal to: (Maintenance Level * 6/100) * Max Durability of weapon. Meaning at level 5 you will repair 30% of the durability per repair versus 24%-6% repair at level 4 or lower. You will also be given a small amount of Maintenance experience when performing the repair action. Unlike the normal repair system, these repairs are not counted. However, there is a chance that you will destroy the toothbrush being used while cleaning your gun. The chance your toothbrush will be destroyed is equal to the following: (11 - Maintenance Level) * 3. Meaning, at 0 Maintenance level you have a 33% chance to have your toothbrush destroyed and since you are more than likely going to need multiple attempts this adds up fast and makes it more likely you will destroy the toothbrush. At level 5 you have an 18% chance to destroy the toothbrush. ------------------ Feature Update ------------------ You can now customize this mod using ModOptions! You have the following options: Toothbrush Break Chance This allows you to set your own toothbrush break chance ignoring the default system parameters specified and ignoring your maintenance skill! Custom Toothbrush Break Chance? This enables the toothbrush break chance you specified. Repair Tracking? This enables the mod to track how many times you have repaired the gun giving you diminishing returns. Every 2 times you repair a gun the maximum amount you increase the durability drops by 1 (4 repairs = 2 loss in max durability). Custom Repair Cap This enables you to set the maximum % the gun can be repaired to, granted this does get rounded based on the durability of the gun. This is also reduced even further when utilizing repair tracking, so something to keep in mind. Custom Condition Repair? This enables you to set the amount you repair each time you make a repair ignoring the math formula in the default system. Custom Condition Repair Amount This sets how much durability you restore to a gun with each repair ignoring the math formula in the default system. Workshop ID: 3164282444 Mod ID: GunCleaningMod

description: Overview : There may be multiple patterns of furniture overlay graphics, but the patterns are defined per coordinate, not per item. Therefore, when you bring furniture back to your base and place it there, you may see a different graphic than the first time you picked it up. This mod solves that problem and allows free selection of overlay graphics for furniture. And for world-placed items other than Moveable, the placement position can be adjusted. Confirmed to work with Build 41/42 and also work on MP. Split-screen play is not supported. Features - 1.Change Furniture Display : You can change the overlay graphic freely by following the steps below. (1) Execute "Change furniture display" from the item or world context menu. (2) You can select the graphics to display from the configuration window. Press the "Select" button below the graphic you want to display. The currently selected graphic will be marked with a red circle icon in the upper right corner. "Default" will return to the original display mode. In this setting, the graphics displayed will change depending on the coordinates of the placement. Features - 2.Adjust Item Position : This feature has been integrated into vanilla as "Extended 3D Placement" in Build 42. Therefore, it has been removed from this mod in the B42 version. However, the vanilla functionality has been extended as follows: Expanded position offset range (range can be adjusted via options) Feature can now be accessed from the item's context menu You can adjust the placed item position by following the steps below. (1) Execute "Adjust item position" from the world item context menu. (2) You can change the item positions and rotations from the adjust position window. "--" button : Decrease value a lot. "-" button : Decrease value a little. "C" button : Clear value to zero. "+" button : Increase value a little. "++" button : Increase value a lot. Options : These options are available. (Only B42) Offset Range : You can extend the item's position offset range to span from negative to positive values. Sandbox Options : These options are available in Sandbox Options. (Only B41) Meta > Enable Adjust Item Position : Enables Adjust Item Position. This option is intended for cases where you want to limit this features to users in MP. Q&A : Which furniture can I select graphics? This includes container-type furniture such as shelves and furniture with overlay graphics such as chairs covered with sheets. Can furniture from other mods be made to work? It's possible, although it needs to be handled individually. Please request the mod name. How do I do a piece of large furniture that has been divided? You can select graphics in each divided part. What happens if I rotate the furniture? If the furniture is rotated, it will be processed as a different item. Therefore, please select the graphics for each direction. However, if the same direction is made again, the previous selection is kept.
