description: (VVA) Vanilla Vehicles Animated What this mod does? There are many cool mods that add vehicles with openable doors, meaning the game can handle such animations. But vanilla vehicles remain as solid bricks. This mod fixes that. Vehicle models are reworked - split into multiple objects, and code added to display vanilla vehicles. As a free bonus of it - if a part is removed (or torn off) it would become visually missing, rather than tinted grey. Why are Dash Roamer, Drive90s and other modded cars no longer animated? Trying to keep the mod more focused so since they are not based on vanilla models and not all of them were transitioned to build 42 - that created a bunch of issues making sure stuff got updated correctly. So I made a hard decision to drop them from this mod. I am repackaging all the animated model patches for those vehicles and will publish them as a couple of separate workshop items - for build 41 and 42 separately. But at this moment they are just remived as a hotfix to them getting broken by latest code rafactoring. B41 or B42? Both. This workshop item contains versions both for Build 41 and Build 42. Though I am planning to move Build 42 version to a different workshop item eventually and make this item Build41 legacy only. Multiplayer? By itself only the local player would see animations in action. Remote players would only ubdate parts state when they moved far enough from vehicle and then returned to it so server sends current state for all parts. To fix this issue you need to use a mod that patches in server signals to update parts state when they change For build 42 use https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3685499657 For build 41 use https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2959512313 Existing save - safe? Yes. This mod only changes the way vehicles are displayed and does not interfere with save data in any way. It is safe to add or remove this mod on existing saves/servers. There are many mods in this item. Which ones I should enable? Vanilla Vehicles Animated - Main mod. Nothing works without it. disable passenger rendering (VVA_cullseats) - (optional) - The main mod enables rendering character model in the interior. But animations for characters switching seats, exiting vehicle or aiming a weapon if a window is rolled down, are not set up, so defailts ones (for character standing on ground) are used, resulting in character clipping through vehicle roof. If this bothers you - enable this mod. It will prohibit my mod adding passenger rendering. But if some other mod also enables interior character rendering it might not work. Standard Vehicle Upgrades Patch (VanillaVehiclesAnimated_SVU) - (optional) - If you wand to MadMax your vehicles using armor from Standard Vehicle Upgrades, by default the armor would be rendered static. So an open door would clip through armor plate. Enabling this optional mod patches armor definition scripts to make armor animated too. ApocalypticallySlowDoors (VVA_slowdoors) - depricated - In Build 41 version using Fancy Handwork together with this mod could cause a bug with door close animation being unable to play properly because it was running too fast. This mod slowed all animations down to avoid this bug. Pikamy's Delighter - depricated - Build 42 specific. A little mod created for Pickamy_ (follow her on Twitch!). Changes models and textures for seats of Lady Delighter specialty van to be pink with some embroidery. Snappy Doors Removes animated transitions between opened and closed states so doors/hoods/trunks snap open/closed. Requested for consistency with how building doors are not actually animated in B41, or mods that synchronize animations between different clients actually just synchronize end states. Just Vanilla Vehicles? No. Some mods that add reskins of vehicles based on vanilla models (i.e. Donny's Company Cars) are also supported. And if you know such a mod that is not supported - please let me know and I would gladly cover it in an update. Also Vanilla Vehicle Enhancer (both 41 and 42 versions) are supported, including custom models for all vehicles that match enhanced textures with geometry. Can a vanilla-model based vehicle mod hook into animations without requiring update to this mod? At this point - I feel the code is settled enough, so yes. If you are making a mod that adds more vehicles that are reskins of vanilla models - they can be easily added as long as you don't change shape of windows and headlights. Also if your mod is not based on vanilla models, I am eager to help you set up the models and scripts to have animations on their own. How many people are working on this mod? One. Just me in my free time. If you want to support me - the best way would be to show up to my Twitch streams 8am till 1pm GMT on saturdays and sundays. I mostly work on another huge mod adding animations to PZK Vanilla Like Cars pack... You can also support me on Boosty. description: Simple Skill Books reworks both skill books themselves, and the rewards they offer. They still come in sets of five, but each has been altered in respect to their tier level, and now have a value even after that tier level has been achieved: Book 1 - Pages 10 - Available at Tier 1 - Awards 100XP on completion. Book 2 - Pages 50- Available at Tier 3 - Awards 500XP on completion. Book 3 - Pages 175 - Available at Tier 5 - Awards 1,750XP on completion. Book 4 - Pages 500 - Available at Tier 7 - Awards 5,000XP on completion. Book 5 - Pages 800 - Available at Tier 9 - Awards 8,000XP on completion. With zero XP in a skill, Book 1 will provide all of the first level of the skill's required XP, and a small amount more. The remainer must be obtained through other means. This gives a boost initially into the skill, but still requires the player to level the skill to advance further, rather than simply skill up via books alone as some other mods offer. A character that already has the first level in that skill completed, such as a Repairman (Carpentry T1) will obtain 100XP for the second level of the skill, a decent amount but not enough to progress onto the next tier. A character that has progressed even further, such as a Carpenter (Carpentry T3) can still obtain the 100XP Book 1 offers, although for this level it is a drop in the bucket. That OCD satisfaction can be obtained without considering this a wasted effort. The same applies to every skill, for every level. As standard, the XP Multiplier that vanilla provides has been disabled, but there is a sandbox option available to restore it for those who want the easy mode. Build 42: All new skill books added. Please note that this multiplier, and perk multipliers do not apply to the XP skill books provide. You can't have it too easy :P Build 42MP: Fixed to work for SP, haven't checked if it is working on MP. Please let me know. Workshop ID: 3291799176 Mod ID: SimpleSkillBooks

description: Build 41 & Build 42. World temperature affects the food spoilage rate as you experience seasonal and day-to-day variations. Compatible with everything, works in multiplayer, works with existing items, temperature-dependent decay time/spoilage rate updates every in-game hour. Sandbox settings included. Build 42.12 note: Compatible with the newest update. The example picture has been created with the help of Eris' Food Expiry (for B42 it is better to use More Item Information), which shows the remaining freshness and time until the food is completely rotten. The game does not differentiate between items left outside and inside, where it is typically warmer, which is a limitation for this mod, but has been accounted for to the best of my ability. Items do not freeze unless are in the freezer, same as vanilla. Please see Outside Freezer by TwisTonFire for this functionality. Extra Notes: Because the refrigeration effectiveness sandbox setting is a flat multiplier against the decay timer, it is also adjusted to best fit realistic expectations. If I was to leave the settings alone, your food would spoil quicker if it's hotter outside. It is not possible to make food spoil faster in a refrigerator than outside, so when in doubt, use the fridge. I would recommend using Surviving Through the Seasons to make the year last less than 365 in-game days so that you can actually experience all the seasonal variations through your average playthrough length. I would also suggest KYR Real Weather with the base minimum temperature to -4°C if you want the fairly typical real-life winter lows of Kentucky. Permissions: Please do not modpack or reupload. If this mod is deleted, you are welcome to reupload to Steam Workshop only. Thanks and enjoy! description: I am aware of a few errors in the mod and hope to find time to work on it when I can, but currently I'm too occupied working on the Horse mod so this mod will sadly have to wait a bit Ever felt like peaking through a window or door or looking upstairs or downstairs was a natural human trait ? Now you can do it in Project Zomboid ! Saving you from those nasty floors hiding zombies upstairs, or even downstairs ! You can also check behind windows or door ! But peaking a closed door can have risks and cause a creeking sound that can attract zombies in the next room ! Or even players... How to use: Check upstairs* When in stairs or at the bottom of it, press the keybind to check upstairs. By default, the key isn't set**. This will check in a circle around the square at the top of the stairs. If any zombies are detected, their amount will be shown above the player. If no zombies are detected, your player will mention it. Check downstairs* When at the top square of stairs (not on the stairs), press the keybind to check downstairs. By default, the key isn't set**. This will check in a circle around the square at the bottom of the stairs. If any zombies are detected, their amount will be shown above the player. If no zombies are detected, your player will mention it. * these voicelines can appear at the same time if you are in both conditions Check behind windows Right click an opened, non-barricaded and with opened curtains window to have an option to check outside of it. This will check in a circle around the square behind the window. If any zombies are detected, their amount will be shown above the player. If no zombies are detected, your player will mention it. Check behind doors Right click a non-barricaded door to have an option to check behind it. This will check in a circle around the square behind the door. If any zombies are detected, their amount will be shown above the player. If no zombies are detected, your player will mention it. But take care ! If the door is closed, you will have to peak it first which could possibly cause a creeking noise based on the health of the door and your sneaking skills: Nimble, Lightfoot, Sneaking. Your traits can also influence your chance to cause a creeking noise: Graceful, Inconspicuous, Conspicuous, Clumsy. 15 sounds from Pixabay. Customize your experience: Change your keybind in the options ! (Category mods for B42) Adapt your sandbox options to your liking ! You can increase the radius which the character checks for zombies. You can chose to show the zombie position or not. Chose the lore name of the zombies ! This can also be forced with a mod (check the next part about modder's documentation). Customization available to other modders Other modders can easily modify the mod and its parameters ! Add your own voicelines or modify the name to show above zombies or in the voicelines ! description: Included items The mod adds the following items to the game: AN/PVS-7 AN/PVS-14 AN/PVS-15 GPNVG-18 Rhino Mount Night Vision Head Mount Counterweight How to use The mod introduces a 'Night Vision Head Mount' item that serves as the primary attachment point for other items. Before it can be used, it must be combined with the 'Counterweight' item. This item occupies its own slot and can be worn under under other items such as gas masks, motorcycle helmets, hats from other mods, etc. The 'Rhino Mount' item can be attached to the mount by itself, or can be combined with any of the goggles in their "item" form (goggles in the 'Material' category) to create the attachable version (goggles in the 'Accessory' category). When the goggles have been combined with the Rhino Mount and attached to the Night Vision Head Mount, they can now be toggled on/off using the 'Toggle NVG' ( by default) hotkey given they have enough battery. They can be raised and lowered using the context menu or the 'Flip NVG' hotkey (unbound by default). Both of these keys can be changed in the in-game settings under 'Options' > 'key bindings' > 'Night Vision Goggles'. All goggles have identical functionality and differs only in appearance. Sandbox options The sandbox options allows you to adjust the spawn probability for each of the items introduced, along with the battery lifetime. These options can be found under 'Night Vision Goggles' on the 'Sandbox options' page when creating a new game. If you do not wish to use one of the goggles, you can effectively disable them by setting their spawn rate to 0. Where to find them All items introduced can be found in military containers and army stores. The goggles always contains a battery with between 30%, and 100% charge. The spawn probability values of all included items are not a weight or a percentage. It is based on the values of existing in-game items, which i am unsure how is reflected in-game or if it is balanced. Per default, all goggles have a spawn probability of 0.05 and the Night Vision Head Mount, Rhino Mount, and Counterweight have a spawn probability of 0.1 which should make them as rare as some of the rifles. Dependencies None! Does it work in multiplayer? The mod has been developed with single-player in mind. It has not been tested in multiplayer so it might not function as expected. It is currently not my priority to ensure compatibility with multiplayer games. Notes on Build 42 I try to keep the mod up-to-date with the most recent minor version of Build 42, but cannot guarantee backwards compatibility with previous minor versions. Known issues Models don't appear correctly when placed on the ground Other notes For feature requests and bug reports please see their respective discussion threads. description: Simple Silencers adds new weapon attachements to the game for vanilla firearms. They are: Suppressor: This is a factory made suppressor, and can be attached to rifles, assault rifles and pistols. This retail suppressor can NOT be attached to revolvers or shotguns. Suppressors can be found in gunstores, police stations and a few other places. Makeshift Suppresor: This has been hand-crafted, and can only be attached to pistols due to the poor quality. These can usually be found in crime-related containers. Additionally, this can be crafted by the player, provided they learn the recipe. I made this mod because the few silencer mods made specifically for vanilla firearms are either out-of-date, buggy with red errors, or apply to every firearm under the sun. Revolvers do not benefit from a suppressor - they exhaust from the chanber, not the barrel D: Shotgun suppressors are bulky - there is no universal size for every gun D: Finally, I wanted to add more balance between firearms. Revolvers are easy to reload, and shotguns are powerful from the onset, and do not need additional buffs from a suppressor mod. IMPORTANT I have added a picture that gives the general idea of how far sound will carry for each suppressor. The line designates the approximate safe distance, while the positions of the character is the point where the sound can be heard by the target group. Please note: This distance only applies to zombies with NORMAL hearing as per the "survivalist" default. Please understand that "apocalypse" zombies have RANDOMISED hearing, so different zeds will hear you from different distances! Hopefully this will finally put rest to the misconception that this mod is not working as intended. For B42: Options are back! MSR700 is default now. Yeah, I kinda got annoyed that I couldn't use a suppressor on my M3, so I took another stab at updating the mod. So, we're back to attaching suppressors uniquely. B42MP: Fixed to work for SP, haven't checked if it is working on MP. Please let me know. Workshop ID: 3309896124 Mod ID: SimpleSilencers

description: Thank you for 200k+! The mod has finally been updated to B42.13 with multiplayer support, massive thanks to the PZWiki and the modding discord (@StarkTruffle & @pwrcosmic) for all the super useful information on updating for B42MP. I've lowered spawn rates of magazines based on feedback and I've also slightly changed how gaining positive traits work if you started with the negative trait. If "Replace Negative Traits" (now renamed to "Negative Trait To Positive Trait") and consumable magazines is enabled, you will need to read 2 copies of the magazine to remove the negative trait, and the other to gain the positive one. If consumable magazine is off, you will get the positive trait immediately. I'm still tweaking things so please post any feedback on to the bug report or in the comments! About Find and learn traits through trait magazines! All with unique and vanilla-friendly name and designs. Each magazine can also be placed on the ground and have their own unique textures! This mod is very customizable with sandbox settings, start a game in "Custom Sandbox" or use Change Sandbox Options mod to change settings mid-game for a singleplayer game. By default, if the player starts with a negative trait counterpart of a trait (like Disorganized vs Organized), reading the magazine will not give the positive trait but instead remove the negative trait only. (*) (*) B41: This can be changed in sandbox settings to allow players to gain the positive version of the trait. (**) B42: This can be changed in sandbox settings to allow players to learn the positive version of the trait with a second magazine (or right away if consumable magazines is off). Other sandbox settings include the option to choose which magazines spawn, toggling of a trait by rereading a magazine (for those who want to toggle Speed Demon), and an option to change the spawn rate of all magazines. Available Trait Magazines Simple traits: - Nutritionist - Outdoorsman - Handy - Axe Man - Burglar Traits with negatives (in brackets): - Speed Demon (Sunday Driver) - Organized (Disorganized) - Fast Learner (Slow Learner) - Fast Reader (Slow Reader) - Inconspicuous (Conspicuous) - Graceful (Clumsy) - Dexterous (All Thumbs) - Keen Hearing (Deaf / Hard of Hearing) (*) (*) Reading the Keen Hearing magazine with deaf will not do anything. Finding Magazines All trait magazines can be found in common magazine locations like magazine racks and libraries. Some magazines have unique spawns where they have a higher spawn rate. For example, "Fast Learner" can be found more commonly in schools and "Burglar" more commonly in police/evidence lockers. The spawn rates for magazines will differ in rarity depending on the value of the trait. By default, the cheaper trait magazines are roughly as common as Skill Vol. 1 & 2 books. The more expensive trait magazines are roughly as rare as/rarer than "How to Use A Generator" magazines. Changing the sandbox spawn settings will multiply spawn rates accordingly: Very Low (0.05x), Low (0.25x), Default (0.5x), High (1x), Very High (2x) Supported Languages Please report any translation errors or improvements in the discussion thread. - English (EN) - Traditional Chinese (CN) - Spanish (ES) by @Trapito222 - Portuguese Brazil (PTBR) by @Rafakes - Russian (RU) by @Revil - Korean (KO) by @MUKI - Polish (PL) by @Nacho Juarez - Turkish (TR) by @kazoo - Japanese (JP) by @sync01 - Italian (IT) by @Art Tippet - Indonesian (ID) by @Shieru - French (FR) by @Bobitec - German (DE) by @Beathoven Extra Notes I mainly made this mod because I wanted a way to learn Nutritionist, figured why not design and add magazines for other traits as well. Also, this is my first time delving into Zomboid mod making so I'd highly appreciate suggestions or bug reports in the comments, thanks! FAQ Q: Does this work in multiplayer? A: Yes! Q: Can I add this mod mid-save / ongoing world? A: Yes, but the magazines will only spawn in unexplored chunks. If you're adding this mod on a late save, I'd recommend resetting chunks outside of your base or in previously looted towns. Q: I read the magazine but didn't get the trait! A: This is usually due to mod incompatibility. First, try playing with only this mod enabled to ensure that the issue is coming from this. If magazines are still bugged, help make a post under the Bug Reports discussion with your build version and steps on how to recreate the issue. If you find an incompatible mod, please leave a comment so others know what mods are incompatible. Q: Does reading magazines also give XP/level for skills? (E.g. Handy's +1 Carpentry & +1 Maintenance) A: No, reading magazines will only give the associated trait. Q: Can you add support for X mod's traits? A: Unfortunately there are too many trait mods to create magazine designs for, so I'm sticking with vanilla traits only. Though if you would like to expand or create an add-on for the mod, you have my full permission to look through the code and attempt it yourself! Q: Is this compatible with Evolving Traits World or mods that add or remove traits dynamically? A: Functionally, this mod simply looks through the traits you have and if it matches the vanilla trait, it will add or remove it. If the mod changes the name for traits, this mod will not work. With dynamic trait mods, adding/removing traits may also be undone depending on how and when they check for conditions. Known Issues / Bugs - Some languages are missing translations, if you would like to help with translations please post them in the discussions! Before reporting bugs, please test this mod on it's own to ensure that the issue is coming from this mod, often problems reported are due to another broken or incompatible mod enabled alongside this one. If the mod produces errors by itself or if you find a mod that is incompatible, let me know in the Bug Reports discussion! This is the only magazine mod made by me, I did not make the other add-on mods and they may be outdated and cause errors, please check before reporting issues as well! description: I'd like to thank everyone who supported and played this mod. Honestly i did not anticipate that it would be as popular as it turned out to be. My appreciation for TLOU series remains unchanged, as i still love The game and show but with that being said This mod will not be receiving any more updates. Over time my interest in developing this mod has degraded and ultimately i decided to focus on other projects. The mod introduces a few new outfits and items inspired by factions from The Last of Us : Seraphite Outfit: -Represent the mysterious and devout Seraphites faction with this unique outfit. Jacket comes with 2 attachment slots, allowing you to attach items and quickly equip yourself with tool or weapon in times of emergency. Perfect for role-playing as one of the survivors in a more tribal-like, isolated group. Jacket can only be found on Seraphite's Zombies, spawn chance can be changed in sandbox options. FEDRA Hazmat Suit: -A specialized outfit used by FEDRA (Federal Disaster Response Agency) personnel for handling hazardous environments. Offers protection and enhances immersion, especially in dangerous scenarios. Whole outfit can be found on zombies, aswell as in military locations. FEDRA Uniform: -The standard outfit worn by FEDRA soldiers, who enforce martial law in the quarantine zones. It brings a militaristic and authoritative look to your character, ideal for role-playing as a post-apocalyptic enforcer. Whole outfit can be found on zombies, aswell as in military locations. Related Items: - The mod also introduces several craftable and faction-specific items that enhance the gameplay experience, giving players new survival tools and immersive role-playing options. These items are designed to fit the world of The Last of Us, focusing on practicality and customization. Craftable Leather Water Bottles: -Handcrafted, durable water bottles made from leather, essential for long journeys in the zombie apocalypse. Designed to help with hydration in a more rugged and immersive way, reflecting the scarcity of modern resources. Craftable Improvised Backpack: -A rugged, survival-style backpack that can be crafted by players. Unique feature: It includes 3 attachment points where you can attach various tools and items (such as melee weapons or bottles), making it versatile for carrying gear and essential supplies. Craftable Leather Pouches and Pockets: -A small, handy pouches that can be crafted and attached to your character’s Back Left or Back Right. -A pockets made from leather that can be worn on the Back Left, Back Right, Left Leg, or Right Leg of your character. Perfect for storing small items, adding a practical and immersive inventory expansion option for players. Seraphite’s Scythe: -A brutal, handcrafted melee weapon inspired by the Seraphite faction from The Last of Us. Perfect for close combat, this scythe not only adds style but is a lethal weapon against zombies and other threats. Faction Armbands: Show your allegiance with unique Faction Armbands for the following groups: FEDRA (Federal Disaster Response Agency), Seraphites (The Scars), WLF (Washington Liberation Front), Fireflies, These armbands can be worn to identify yourself with one of the iconic factions, adding a layer of immersion and customization for role-playing or faction-themed gameplay. Additional Informations: -If The Last of Guns Remaster or Infection Scanner mods are enabled zombies can spawn with items from those mods. -Each submod works on its own, meaning you can only choose what you like, -Can be used in ongoing saves, but will require visiting new locations/waiting for zombie respawn. description: Map Mod Manager is a tool for managing and organizing your map mods. With a cell grid display, you can visually identify conflicts between maps, regardless of if you're subscribed to them or picked from the huge database of over 800 maps. Whether you're curating a fine collection of maps, checking your current subscriptions for conflicts or expanding your map collection, Map Mod Manager is the tool to help you do it. Now reads subscribed mod cells! The latest update enables Map Mod Manager to read your map files directly, so you don't need to wait for the database to update when a new map is released. As long as you're subscribed, it will know exactly where on the map it belongs. Currently available for Build 42 only. Features: Interactive Cell Display: View maps on a detailed grid that highlights selected mods to instantly spot conflicts - either with other mods or with vanilla map areas. Toggle Mods: Quickly enable or disable your subscribed mods and their dependencies directly in Map Mod Manager, you don't have to go back to mods to manage them. Quick Select and Filter: Quickly select map mods that don't conflict with your current selection or filter by specific cells to find compatible mods. Steam Links: Open any map or dependency workshop page directly from Map Mod Manager - if a map works with your current collection, you can update it in a few clicks and a refresh of the game. Dependency Checker: See required mods for every selected or enabled map. Hover over a dependency to see which maps are relying on it, so you don't miss anything essential - preventing in-game issues. Read Subscribed Maps (Build 42): Automatically reads the cells of any subscribed map, ensuring that even the newest maps are checked for conflicts with your collection. Export Data (Build 41): The export function generates a list of selected maps, including their URL's, dependencies and multiplayer data, enabling you to quickly set up a server or share it with a mate. How do I use it? Enable Map Mod Manager in the mods menu, save and go back to the main menu. A button called 'Map Mod Manager' will appear under the Quit button. Select maps to show them on the cell grid, conflicting maps appear red, if they conflict with a vanilla map they appear yellow. Purple cells are map mods without conflicts, green and blue cells are vanilla maps. Hover your mouse over any cell in the grid to show what map/s are occupying that cell. If you're subscribed to a map, it will appear in the Subscribed Map Mods list, green maps are enabled. Dependencies will populate for both active mods and selected mods, active mods are green, required dependencies that aren't enabled are white, dependencies you aren't subscribed to are red. Hover over a dependency to see what map enabled it. Use the steam link next to any map or dependency to navigate to the workshop page, if you subscribe to a new mod, you'll need to quit and re-open the game for it to show up in your Subscribed Map Mods list. Buttons have tooltips, so you know exactly what they are doing. Mod changes are saved by closing the UI. Note, if you have increased your font size, you will have issues displaying the UI. Reduce your font size to default while using this mod. Important disclaimers about maps that aren't in the database: Uninstalled Dependencies: If a required dependency isn’t installed and isn’t already in the database, it won’t be listed as required. Always check the map Workshop page for any dependencies when subscribing to new maps. Mod Packs: Map Mod Manager will detect “mod packs” (workshop items that contain multiple mods). This can cause issues if you’re subscribed to both a mod pack and one of its individual mods. It’s best to avoid subscribing to both at the same time. Translations: French, thanks to Aatheom. Korean, thanks to Teray. If you'd like to translate it for me, please reach out! Even if the user disappears, he or she would much rather you didn't touch the fruits of their hard labour. You are not allowed to repack this mod under any circumstances, ever. description: Overview : Adding the "Sound Scouter" to visualize sound information (Volume, Radius). This item is intended for testing purposes to understand the sound situation. Confirmed to work with Build 41/42. Features : Equipping the "Sound Scouter" will visualize sound information. 1. Pin and Circle Display A pin is displayed at the sound source. The pin shows the volume (top) and radius (bottom). The color of the pin changes depending on the sound source. Player: Orange Zombie: Green Others: Gray A circle is drawn around the pin to represent the volume and radius of the sound. Volume: The color inside the circle; the larger the volume, the darker the color. Radius: The reach of the sound is represented by the size of the circle. 2. Scouter Display Equipping the Scouter will show a Scouter panel. The panel displays sound information (source, xyz-coordinates, volume, radius) in text form. Clicking the icon at the bottom of the panel will toggle the display of specific pin/circle/information ON/OFF. The panel can be moved freely, and you can close it by pressing the red button. If the panel is hidden, it can be re-displayed from the item's context menu. How to Obtain : You can obtain the "Sound Scouter" by selecting "Obtain the Sound Scouter" from the character's context menu. It can be obtained only once per character. After obtaining it, the menu will no longer be displayed. Options : In B41, These options are available with Mod Options. Sound Pins Display : When the Sound Scouter is equipped, the Sound Pins will be displayed. Sound Circles Display : When the Sound Scouter is equipped, the Sound Circles will be displayed. Scouter Panel Display : When the Sound Scouter is equipped, the Scouter Panel will display automatically. Sound Volume (Activated) : You can adjust the sound volume when the Sound Scouter is activated. Sound Volume (Deactivated) : You can adjust the sound volume when the Sound Scouter is deactivated. Sound Volume (Display Toggle) : You can adjust the sound volume when the Sound Scouter display is toggled. Sound Volume (Recording Toggle) : You can adjust the sound volume when the Sound Scouter recording is toggled. Known Issues : In B41, the text size cannot be changed through options or so. description: So you are here ? Ah.. you wanna play with cars but you lack experience. You've come to the right place. How to ? Get a Screwdriver, a Wrench, a Lug Wrench and a Jack. Ensure you've read the book associated with your car. Find a car you can spare, and just start training with serenity. On vehicle mechanics menu, right click any mounted part and left click on Train Mechanics button. Other Actions You can continue a previously interrupted training. You can uninstall all parts in one click. You can inflate all tires in one click. Mod Options You can set a waiting timer between mechanical actions. This allows to adapt to servers with high latency in multiplayer. You can select a threshold for uninstall attempts depending on risks of breaking the part. It is 100 (unrestricted) by default. You can use or not a pause at the end of all actions (e.g. when using time speed increase for a full training). You can re-try vanilla Uninstall and Install actions until they succeed. Verbose options are logs that reduce (a lot) performances: only for debug analysis. Sandbox Options You can enforce the failure threshold server side in multiplayer. The lowest (most restricting) value between the client value (mod option) and the server value (sandbox option) is used. It is 100 (unrestricted) by default. Tips and Tricks Any mod with invalid fixing recipe will induce errors when right clicking on some vehicle parts. "attempted index: isEmpty of non-table: null" ISVehicleMechanics.lua:224. This mod is for version B42 and further versions. This mod is NOT compatible with version B41 and previous versions. Remember there is no need to train more than once a day (per car). You can increase game speed. The training can reach a stall due to pathfinding. Keep a lot of free space around the car to avoid this. Broken items will be dumped. (items you uninstalled and cannot reinstall will not be. e.g. a tire will not be reinstalled nor dropped if the suspension is broken and dropped) Make sure to disable re-equipment before "Train Mechanics" if you're using the Tidy Up Meister mod. This mod can be added to or removed from any save. Project Zomboid gives much freedom to players and modders, but there are tricky stuff I will not explain a thousand times in the comments below. description: You can climb one level up. How to climb You can climb to a place one level higher but not directly over you. The target place must have a floor (but no stairs). The target place must have no wall window or fence blocking the climb. There must be nothing on top of your head blocking the climb. You must not be on stairs. You must be in good health conditions*. Press the Climb key, 'F' by default, configurable. Health condition* Each of the following points apply to the torsos, arms and hands body parts. Health must be above 50 percents. Exercise fatigue (stiffness) must be below 50 percents. No fracture. No deep wound. Success / Struggle / Failure Computation details: Base chance: 80% Each point in Strength and Fitness adds 2% (at best +40%) Each level of Endurance removes 10% (at worse -40%) Each level of HeavyLoad removes 16% (at worse -64%) Any trait among Emaciated / Obese / Very Underweight removes 25% (at worse -25%) Any trait among Underweight / Overweight removes 15% Each zombie attacking the player from its initial tile removes 25% (no limit) Each zombie not attacking the player from its initial tile removes 7% (no limit) Success chance: sum of all variables above - 25% Struggle chance: 25% (if Success chance < 100%). 0% (if Success chance >= 125%) Fail chance: 100% - Struggle chance - Success chance. Critical success: 1% (there is always a chance). Critical failure: 0% (no critical failure for PZ. player must be able to guarantee success if carefull). A struggle result leads to a new computation. Exemple 1 Fresh New Bill : Player with 5 fitness, 5 strength, no moodle, no trait, no zombie around. Base = 80% + 2%*(5+5) = 100%. Success = Base -25% => 75%. Struggle = min(Base,25) = 25%. Failure = 0%. Exemple 2 Zero (Wannabe Hero) : Player with 0 fitness, 0 strength, First Endurance moodle, Obese trait, one zombie attacking. Base = 80% - 10% - 25% -25% = 20%. Success = Base - 25% => 1%. (critical success only) Struggle = min(Base,25)-critical success = 19%. Failure = 80%. Exemple 3 Hero (Experienced Zero) : Player with 10 fitness, 10 strength, First Endurance moodle, no trait, one zombie attacking. Base = 80% + 2%*(10+10) - 10% -25% = 85%. Success = Base - 25% => 60%. Struggle = min(Base,25) = 25%. Failure = 15%. Endurance consumtion Success: 6.24% endurance. Failure: 6.24% endurance. Struggle: 2.6% endurance per struggle. Warnings Animation is clunky. You will get access to places you usually don't: beware the holes in some roofs. Close range teleport is used. I've not had any death while climbing, but I cannot guaranty you wont. But as time passed, it became clear that it was too late. The remnants of this effort are all that remain... Drug Overhaul All drugs have been overhauled and are now more dangerous to use, with delayed and/or prolonged effects. Misusing CDC drugs can severely harm or even kill you. Viral Test Kits - Viral Test Kits provide an overly complicated and adequately frustrating experience to ensure you test yourself correctly. - Consumer Grade Tests: Provide solid results quickly (if you read the directions! "Did we remember to put those in?", wonders a lab tech). - Premium Grade Tests: Provide better results and are easier to use. - Weathered Test Kits: These might help you... or just give you false hope. - Packaged Viral Test Kits contain everything you need, but you're more likely to find loose components of these kits. - The Viral Test Kit system now requires the user to use a sialogogue or equivalent. (Built-in PZ systems allow for other methods—figure it out, or die trying.) Kit Types: - Consumer Viral Test: Test for the virus. - Premium Viral Test: 100% accuracy. - Weathered Test Kits: Good luck! Medications Medications are now more dangerous. Use them cautiously and prepare accordingly—especially when using unfamiliar ones. Poor health or unknown preexisting conditions can lead to sickness or death. - Consumer Grade Medications: Assist with infections but may cause sickness or death, particularly for those with preexisting conditions. - Premium Medications: Safer and more effective but still require careful use. - Weathered Medications: These may have been sitting in filth for years. Would you trust your life to a pill found in a drain? - Medications can be found packaged or as loose pills. Medication Types: - Bitezapro: 24-48 hour protection (with side effects). - Fevarax: 48-72 hour protection (with side effects). - Humanox: 24-48 hour protection (with side effects). - Salivix: 48-72 hour protection (with side effects). - Zomboflex: 24-48 hour protection (with side effects). - Zedalis: 36-48 hour protection (with side effects). - Weathered Pills: Who knows what they do?! - Viazom: 5-day protection (no side effects, single-use inhalant). - Several secret medications—where could they be? Antidotes Antidotes provide a cure but come with risks. They allow you to start over and survive this terrible new world. - Low-quality antidotes are painful and risky—only the strongest will survive their effects. ("Burns like 1,000 suns!") - High-quality antidotes are safer but require proper preparation and a calm environment. - Weathered Syrettes: Found in the wild. Use them at your own peril. Antidote Types: - Globunex: Cures infection (with side effects). - Novaulin: Cures infection (with side effects). - Sovextin: Cures infection (with side effects). - KX9 Spike: Cures infection (no side effects). - Roto-mRNA: Cures infection (no side effects). - Weathered Syrette: Don’t do it!! CDC Packages and Airdrops - Over 1,000 tons of medical aid were delivered via air and ground. Supplies were distributed at checkpoints and public facilities or delivered directly to homes. As the virus spread, secure zones fell, and airdrops became the primary method of delivery—until they stopped entirely. Airdrop Types: - CDC Yellow Airdrop: Low-grade items. - CDC Orange Airdrop: Mid-grade items. - CDC Red Airdrop: High-grade items. - CDC Weathered Airdrop: Wet and gross! description: Homemade Things - created by nheve, with additional help from PepperCat. All of my 'Homemade' mods put together into one mod for Build 42. This mod should be also very useful for more rural and even only wilderness gameplay scenarios. Players, who are looking for a more challenging experience, designed more in line with a current Build 42 direction, can use now (thanks to PepperCat) additional version of recipes, by enabling the Base Mod and additional submod 'Homemade Things (Hard Recipes)'. Then activate only one of the additional submods - either choose Homemade Things (Easy Recipes) or Homemade Things (Hard Recipes). Choose Easy Recipes submod if you want the game to feel more like in Build 41 - it provides tools affordable in early gameplay stage (but not too overpowered), without any skill level requirement, and almost all homemade recipes dont require any crafting surface - only exceptions are: making homemade bleach and homemade sledgehammer. Choose Hard Recipes submod if you want the game to feel more in line with Build 42 - it provides necessary homemade tools but with more expensive resources - also adds requirement for crafting surface and specific skill levels, and removes few recipes for tools already added in vanilla. description: This mod has been officially integrated into vanilla in version 42.3, so it is no longer needed. It will no longer work in 42.3 and only functions properly in versions 42.0 to 42.2. Adds a rollback version of the rain collector barrel from Build 41. You can craft it by right-clicking on the ground -> Carpentry -> Furniture -> Rain Collector Barrel. When crafted through the ground -> Carpentry -> Furniture, it becomes the Build 41 version of the rain collector barrel. If crafted through the Building Menu -> Outdoors menu, it becomes the Build 42 version of the rain collector barrel. 1. Fully functional in Build 42.2 2. To connect plumbing, the rain collector barrel must be crafted through the right-click Build menu and must not be pickup after crafting 3. Compatible with lifestyle mod like bathing and showering 4. Plumbing can be connected in basements. Since the visible basement terrain often doesn’t match its actual location, if you wish to connect plumbing in a basement, it is recommended to use the Plumb Helper PLUS [B42] mod. 5. To ensure rainwater accumulates even outside loaded chunks, enable the "Fixing the Rain Update Bug" option in the sandbox settings. 6. In Build 42, there are two types of garbage bags: TrashBag and GarbageBag. The rain collector barrel can only be crafted using GarbageBag. The mod includes a recipe to convert TrashBag into GarbageBag, which can be used if needed. 7. The capacity unit of the rain collector barrel is in liters (L) instead of milliliters (ml). When pouring water into the barrel, make sure to do so in 1000ml increments. 8. This mod is compatible with the Irrigation Pipe Mod. Water synchronization and watering crops work correctly. If vanilla fertilizer is fixed in the future, an automatic fertilizing feature will also be added. How to Connect Plumb 1. Sinks and washing machines must be located indoors. 2. The rain collector barrel must be newly crafted through the right-click "Carpentry" menu on the ground. 3. The rain collector barrel must be placed "Outdoors" (otherwise, rainwater won't accumulate). 4. Demolishing the walls or roof of a pre-existing building on the map does not change its designation to "Outdoor." (The "Indoor" designation is fixed based on coordinates.) 5. A pipe wrench is required. 6. The rain collector barrel must be located directly above the sink or washing machine within a 3x3 range. 7. For the same reason as above, it is not possible to connect pipes across more than two floors simultaneously. 8. Once all the preparations above are complete, right-click the sink and select "Plumb" Sandbox Options 1. Fixing the Rain Update Bug Currently, in version 42, water in rain barrel is updated only while it is raining If you move to a region with rain barrel after the rain has stopped in another area, the water that should have accumulated during the rain will not update and will instead be updated all at once the next time it rains. Enabling this option fixes this issue. However, as the status of rain barrel is checked every 10 minutes, there may be slight frame drops depending on the number of rain barrels 2. Allow snow to fill the rain collector barrel However, the fill speed is 1/4 that of rain. Workshop ID: 3392186516 Mod ID: RollBackRainCollectorBarrel

description: With this mod looting is done automatically. With this mod store your loot in one click. So you are here ? Ah.. you're bored of spending your life looting dead corpses and searching through furnitures.. You've come to the right place. How to access your loot selection You can (and should) change your configuration. You can access the configuration page: By pressing the key selected under OPTIONS >> MODS >> Auto Loot >> Change Configuration (default key is NONE). How to modify your loot selection On the configuration page, you have tools to help you change your configuration quickly: Filter on unique ID. Filter on displayed name. Filter on category through a combo box. Filter on display category through a combo box. Green and red buttons apply on current filter. Double click on an item for individual selection. See this video for a full exemple of the configuration interface. Alternatively -I do not recommend but- you can add/remove an item type through contextual menu. Toggle ON / OFF Toggle Auto Loot ON / OFF by pressing the text button on vanilla inventory window, next to vanilla "Transfer All" button. Toggle Auto Loot ON / OFF by pressing the key selected OPTIONS >> MODS >> Auto Loot >> Toggle On / Off (default key is NONE). How to store your loot ? This functionnality is an evolution of the great mod SmartStack. By clicking on Store All icon/button (next to "Auto Loot ON / OFF" button), all items that are not equipped or favorite will be spread onto any reachable container that already has an instance of the same item. Annex functions Sandbox option Loot Mode allows select one single mod for the whole server. Sandbox options allows to deactivate bag priority option (if you find the function useless and do not wanna clog your contextual menu). Sandbox options allows to deactivate bag filter option (if you find the function useless and do not wanna clog your contextual menu). Sandbox options allows to deactivate bag activation/inhibition option (if you find the function useless and do not wanna clog your contextual menu). Sandbox options allows to deactivate item type add/remove option (if you find the function useless and do not wanna clog your contextual menu). You can permanently inhibit Auto Loot on a furniture or vehicle through a contextual "Inhibit/Activate" toggle. Inventory icon of modded item is corrected in the Item List (for the Autoloot configuration). Inventory weight overlap is corrected. You have questions ? Works in solo and multiplayer. Can be added / removed mid game. The mod still works, it will be tagged obsolete otherwise. Check the tutorial video. This version si for B42 and further. Check this other mod for B41 version. Many other questions are answered in the FAQ. If you still have questions or problem reports, ask on Official PZ Discord: mod_support channel. Tips & Limitations Keep default settings (except loot configuration) for a vanilla friendly experience. Set Auto Loot OFF in order to not plunder your own carefully ordered base. KeyRing has the highest priority: "1" and cannot be changed. Credits Snlon for Smart Stack. That's it. Why are you still here ? What ? description: About Not having friends that play PZ? Need to check on your chicken coop before it gets dark while doing a long loot trip? Need a getaway driver? This mod allows you to play up to 8 characters by yourself. By open the radial menu (default to TAB, and is rebindable), you can choose to add new members to your party, to switch to their perspective and play as them! This comes with these constraints: - New member will be spawned next to your leader (the character you created in the main menu) and you can only add new member when controlling the leader - When a member dies, they cannot be revived and is removed from the party - When the leader dies, you can create a new character as the leader, and your party would be kept the same - When someone in the party sleeps, their fatigue status will be set for all other party members when they wake up, since sleeping in this game is weird and also UI based, not all player based Vehicle constraints Due to vehicle registering and rendering differently than player, I have to enforce this so no one can crash their game. If there's at least one out of all local members (members within the currently rendered cell, about 300x300 from the selected member) inside a vehicle, you have to make sure they exit the vehicle before being able to switch to members that are outside of the currently rendered cell. If you , however, walk away from members inside a vehicle until they are outside of render range, open the party radial menu will force kick them out of the vehicle. tl;dr: if you wanna switch to a far away member, make sure all the closeby members (usually the one that you can select) are not in a vehicle. Simple AI (Experimental) When unfocused member are close, they will: Attempt to drink / eat when thirsty / hungry, only when drink (only select few liquid container for now) / food is in inventory Read existing books, newspaper and magazine when bored. Note that for B42, the reading system is reworked. The AI may reread an already read book and yield no benefit, other than immersion Command (Experimental) You can ask a member to follow you by right click on top of them and choose the "Ask ... to follow" option You can ask a member to stop follow you by right click on top of them and choose the "Ask ... to stop follow" option Random event (Experimental) When switching to a member that is far away, there's a 10% a random event is trigger on that member. Random events currently available are: Eat when hungry, even if no food is in the inventory prior to switching Drink when thirsty, even if no drink is in the inventory prior to switching More events will be added in the future! Controller You can access the party radial menu by selecting the new "Party" option in your "Select" radial menu. Once the menu pops up, use right thumbstick to highlight slice and confirm the slice with "Right Bumper" Note that the character creation does not work with controller yet, it's currently still cooking! Known bugs - On Build 42, the characters that isn't the currently controlled one have their model disappeared. This is due to the new lighting change and for some reason IndieStone specifically told the renderer not to render another player object (FBORenderCell @ line 3527). Thanks Naneek for the FBO cell rendering discovery! There is now a temporary fix for this, but you need to patch your game by overwriting some game files, instruction is provided here. Frequently asked questions Why is the limit 8? - I ran out of distinguishable color. Are non-leader members their separate entities, with their own moodles and stats? - Yep. Every character has their own moodles and stats, just like in multiplayer. The only thing that they share right now is level of exhaustion, since there's the limit in the base game where each player can only sleep once every certain amount of time. It's a pain in the neck to get them all to sleep though, I wouldn't think anyone would like to tuck them all to sleep at the same time, so it works out this way. Does this work with B41 / B42? - Yes, the mod works with both B41 and B42 Is this multiplayer compatible? - I haven't tested it, but I would say no, since a lot of things are hardcoded for 1 player. Try it if you want, but you have been warned. What mods are compatible? - Mods that modifies character such as traits, stats, etc. are most likely not compatible (unless they have a module for integration). You can always try and let me know which one is and which one isn't. If you found it incompatible, why not just ask if they can integrate? It's easy, I promise! Just send them this thread Why are some members disabled on the radial menu? Why can't I select them? - Check the Vehicle constraints section above! Mod integration You can learn more on how to integrate your mod into this system thru this thread Credits Massive thanks to: - nolanritchie for his work on Superb Survivor, a lot of discoveries helped making this mod - Naneek for the FBO cell rendering discovery - Jianghao for CN translation - JimmyCC for KO translation And all early subscribers for testing out and reporting issues! Like the mod? Buy me a coffee if you can :) Workshop ID: 3395761583 Mod ID: RiskyPartySystem

It is initially found inside of containers and can be placed like toasters/microwaves, and relocated later. The drop rates are balanced for single player game, with rare random chance to find it in select locations. How to obtain it - There's a minimal chance to randomly find it in various locations and containers with tools. - There's a very small chance to find it in metalworking shops, among ranger tools and in survival gear locations. - There's a small chance to find it in all locations where you may find firearms or with hunting gear/army surplus rare crates. - There's a noticeable chance to find it in Gun stores, in hunters' caches, in pawnshops and in safehouses. - Once you obtain Metalworking level 5, you can craft it from multiple tools (check screenshots). What does it do The mod adds: - A portable "Ammo Reloading Toolset" furniture item that can be found in pawnshops/safehouses/gun-related areas. - Empty ammo casings, bullet cores of each caliber. - Ability to disassemble ammo into components and reload it. - Lead scrap and ability to break items into lead scrap. Turn lead scrap into bullet cores. - More ways to obtain brass scrap. Turn brass scrap into empty ammo casings. - Distribution of lead/brass scrap items into the world. With the toolset, you obtain a variety of new reactions. The mod also adds Scrap Lead. It also adds Scrap Brass and Lead Pipe to various junk/bin containers. New Recipes - Make Scrap Brass (any surface). Hammer brass nameplates, brass ingots, saxophones and trumpets into 2 Scrap Brass. - Make Scrap Lead (any surface). Hammer Lead Pipe, DumbBells, BarBells and Car Batteries into 1 Scrap Lead. - Melt bullet cores into lead chunks (furnace). Takes 1 bullet core, returns 1 scrap lead chunk. - Melt scrap lead chunks (furnace). Takes 10 scrap lead chunks, returns 1 scrap lead. - Forge <caliber> bullet mold (in any forge). They are made out of "Iron Blocks" (check attached image to see how to get them) using a hammer, tongs and a chisel. The bullet mold requires you to find the recipe in "Moden Metalworking at Home", "Small-Scale Smithing" or "No Man's Land". The recipes are auto-learnt at Blacksmith skill level 5. - Make <caliber> bullet core (in any furnace). Use a bullet mold, tongs, lead scrap and charcoal to create 10 bullet <caliber> cores. - Make Empty Casings (Ammo Reload Toolset). Press [Scrap Lead/Scrap Metal/Scrap Sheet Metal] into 10 Empty Casings. - Disassemble 1/5/10 <caliber> bullets (Ammo Reload Toolset). Receive 1/5/10 GunPowder, Empty Casings and <caliber> bullet cores. - Reload 1/5/10 <caliber> ammo (Ammo Reload Toolset). Takes 1/5/10 of [<caliber> bullet core, empty casing, gunpowder], produces 1/5/10 <caliber> ammo. All vanilla ammo types are supported (9mm, .38, .44, .45, .223, .308, 5.56, shotgun shells). Inventory Tetris Inventory Tetris is a comprehensive inventory overhaul for Project Zomboid. The inventory is replaced with a grid based system. All items now have a size. See inside all your equipped bags at once Bags now provide additional inventory space, not just weight reduction. Worn items do not take up inventory space. No more shoving 3 boxes of cereal and a carton of milk in your pants. CONTROLS Keyboard & Mouse Drag and Drop - Almost everything can be dragged and dropped across the inventory Split Stacks - Drag and drop while holding CTRL Popup Window! - Double click on containers to open them in a popup window Quick Gather - Double click on stackable items to quickly gather them up Rotate items - Press R* Quick Move - Hold CTRL + Left Click Quick Equip - Hold ALT + Left Click Check out keybinds and mod options to customize these controls! Controller Written in Xbox General A - Menu B - Pickup X - Quick move Y - Close inventory/popup SELECT - Open equipment panel LB - Change/select inventory window RB - Change/select loot window While holding item A - Rotate B - Drop Y - Cancel While hovering over a container B+B - Open container popup TRAITS Inventory Tetris makes sure to give new uses to the vanilla traits related to the inventory! Organized - Does nothing right now, will improve autosort when it is added. Disorganized - When using quick move, items will not always stay stacked and will end up in a random spot in the grid. Cannot autosort (in the future when its added). Dextrous - Faster container searching. All Thumbs - Slower container searching. Search Mode! Use sandbox settings when creating your world to enabled searching! When enabled, containers must be searched before they can be looted. FAQ How do I open the keyring? Double click it. The items will be shown in a pop-up window. Furniture is too big for my bag! Use your hands. Equip the furniture as you would a weapon. Your hands can only hold 1 item each, but the items they hold can be as big as you want. How do I place a thing? It is too big for my main inventory. If you want to place a large item such as a tent or furniture, equip the item into your hand as if it was a weapon. Once the item is equipped, it will appear as an option when trying to place/build objects. My game lags / Low FPS Ensure that the following game options is CHECKED: Options -> Display -> UI -> UI Offscreen Rendering -> CHECK You can now use the use the UI Rendering FPS dropdown to choose a target FPS to reduce the performance demand. Can I add/remove this on existing saves? Yes. Inventory Tetris can added/removed at any point without issue. (Note: When adding the mod the player may drop items to the ground if they do not have enough space.) How do items from other mods works? Inventory Tetris automatically examines items from other mods and determines what size they should be. Make My Own Changes? Inventory Tetris includes some very easy to use dev tools that can be used to quickly create compatibility/balance packs to provide more fine tuned support for popular mods or fit your personal tastes. description: This version of True Music Jukebox is exclusively for Build 42. If you are still playing Build 41 for the better gamepad support and multiplayer, please follow this link to True Music Jukebox B41. Are you tired of swapping cassettes and vinyls after every track? Is the effort to find batteries doing more damage to your sanity than the zombie apocalypse, itself? Well, now you can load hundreds of cassettes and vinyls from the infamous True Music into a handy multipurpose jukebox and dance until you're undead! Unfortunately, Build 42 does not yet have multiplayer, but we will look into that in the future. 1. First remove and then unsubscribe from the old version of True Music Jukebox! (!!!) 2. Get True Music (and it's prerequisites) 3. Subscribe to some good True Music track packs. 4. Find or build yourself an epic jukebox (but don't forget electricity)! 5. Turn it on, fill it with cassettes and vinyls, and crank it up to ELEVEN! * How to Use Jukeboxes To use a jukebox, simply interact with it once after finding or placing it in the world and turn it on. This will convert the jukebox into a container object. After that, you can move (or "load") True Music cassettes and vinyls into the jukebox. Once tracks have been loaded, you can play them using either any loaded track's inventory menu or the jukebox interaction menu. Powered jukeboxes will play continuously. You can create a queue of specific tracks that will play next in the loaded playlist, and you can lock the queue if you want to loop through a subset of loaded tracks. Jukeboxes can hold ELEVENTY arbitrary Zomboid weight units (110 AZWU) of your finest tapes and vinyl records. There is no track limit. By default, zombies will be attracted to the sound of the jukebox up to 50 squares away. The range at which zombies can hear a jukebox at full volume can be set using sandbox options. * Jukebox sound is controlled by Ambient Volume in sound settings. Jukebox Therapy and Nutrition Jukeboxes can be given the power to improve the moods and health of players who hear them in many ways; they can even quench your thirst if you want them to be that magical. These features are off by default; enable them in sandbox options if they are up your alley! Jukebox Icons This mod features icons to help people navigate its menus nonverbally. All buttons still do what their button text says they will do; buttons that say "play", "enable", or "turn on" do exactly that. However, the icon for buttons that toggle things on and off will reflect the CURRENT state of that option, not the state it will be in after it's pressed. We made this decision because we wanted the icons to appear "on" when the associated toggle is "on" - e.g., the Jukebox icon is green when it's on. This pattern can be inverted on our game options page. Portable Jukebox Keys Want to remotely access a jukebox's playlist and queue? Simply enable portable jukebox keys via sandbox options, add a jukebox to your key ring via the jukebox's main menu, and open the context menu on your (or any) key ring to control the box at any range. You may rename jukeboxes to remember locations more easily. Controller input is supported via the in-game keyboard. Range Options In sandbox options, you can determine the audible sound range of the jukebox (a special setting exists for zombies); note, however, that our option for players will only work if you use our custom sound mode (the default sound mode of this mod). If you are using Project Zomboid's 3D sound effects, however, be aware that we are not able to control the sound range; it will drop off in volume according to whatever is deemed realistic by Project Zomboid. Jukebox Hero Want to get a jukebox as fast as possible? Just choose the Jukebox Hero trait at character creation, and you will spawn with a Jukebox Starter Kit for building your very own jam station! You will also learn a recipe for making jukeboxes out of scrap. 3D Audio Effects True Music boomboxes and cassette players use 3D audio effects that many people find annoying because they have excessive bias toward one ear, and that ear is often the wrong ear (it's based on player position, not head orientation). We do not like the sound of that audio, so we replaced it with something we like much better. However, you may enable that form of 3D audio using both game options (for the individual level) and sandbox options (if you want to force your entire server to use the same 3D sound as True Music). Just be aware that we do not control the audible range of that sound mode. Multiplayer Sync We have spent many hours confirming that you will hear the same songs as other people, and tracks will change at almost the same time. Feel free to contact us if you believe you have ideas that can significantly improve this aspect of the mod! We have not seen any desync in testing lately; however, if for some unexpected reason a jukebox does become desynced for one or more players, there are two things that will likely fix this. If the data is only wrong clientside, reconnecting should fix the issue; if the jukebox data is somehow corrupted serverside, then picking up a jukebox and putting it back down will reset its data. Game Options True Music Jukebox now has its own page in the Game Options menu, where players can control a wide range of settings from jukebox volume to hiding menu options. Translations We want True Music Jukebox to be available to every player in every language! Please learn more via our permanent discussion about language support. Update Schedule We will push feature updates on Sundays at 10 PM EST whenever those updates are ready. Discord Server Come join the True Music Jukebox community on Discord! In the future, we plan to warn people there if we need to do an unscheduled update for any reason (such as bug fixes that we consider urgent). We are also able to respond to usage questions, bug reports, translation requests, and feature suggestions faster on Discord. Please join us! Compatibility This mod was written and will continue to be improved with compatibility as a high priority. It was tested alongside hundreds of mods, and it was fully compatible with all of them. It also integrates smoothly with Lifestyle: Hobbies. If you have any information regarding a potential incompatibility, please visit us on Discord and ping us! You can add this midsave. description: Does not work yet in 42.13.1 MP, it will require a complete recode because all item movement is server side now Welcome to the Industrial Revolution B42! Added new functionality for Industrial Revolution Vehicle Parts to spawn vehicles. Use factory pieces to build an auto-sorting lair, machines that build and repair items, or saw everything down to dust... This release version uses Factory Pieces add on to run. In order to build the machines you need to find the 5 magazines from Factory Pieces first: Factory Life Magazine Volume 1: Go Conveyourself! Factory Life Magazine Volume 2: CNC & Me! Factory Life Magazine Volume 3: I SAW it all! Factory Life Magazine Volume 4: Sorting out your life! Green Oven Silo Generator Design Manual With these mods combined, you can build factory pieces from scratch and use them to activate existing factories or make a new fresh factory of your own. The launch version has a limited recipe list with the idea for growth, please drop your ideas for recipes on the discord, discussions or in the comments below. https://discord.gg/W5zapqD9JD New Exhaust Fans in B42! Build them in a square where you place your generator to extract the fumes from it out of the building. All automatically, but the fans will not start until power is there and will not extract unless a running generator is under the fans in the same square. Conveyors These will push items from place to place and in factories these will come pre loaded with items based on the factory type. Added the ability to push items to the vehicles through the conveyor belts. These now add items to multiple containers in a square. Conveyor Lifters These will push items from floor to floor. (You will need to read the magazine if you haven't since the update to get the lifters) Track Lifters These will take items from place to place up high and will also fill multiple containers in a square. They can filter by item type. Example: They can pull wood planks only or a list of items. Robotic Claws These will take items from vehicles and containers. They can sort into a separate direction items based on conditions and move the rest a different direction. They will also attack zombies in the target pick up square, strip the bodies of items, place the items into the deliver to square, and dispose of the body. Should one wander in... UPM - Universal Production Machines These will sort items based on display categories and is compatible with Better Sorting. There is also a consolidation mode that will hold back partial items until a full item can be created. During the process it also kicks forward any empty containers with version 1.13. These machines can now change direction as well, the other outputs and filters switch to match as it turns. Saws These can be used to cut logs to planks, planks to sticks, sticks to scrap wood. They can also cut metal sheets to small metal sheets, small metal sheets into scrap metal, and scrap metal into unusable metal. With Authentic Z loaded, you can throw corpses onto the belt and the saws will turn them into tainted meat chunks. Control terminals These can be configured to control 3 milling machines at once. Drum and Tower Hoppers These are used to hold secondary materials that can be used in automated production. Milling machines These can have recipes added into them to repair some basic items as well as create new items. The drum and tower hoppers need to be placed alongside the mill for it to find them as seen in the photos. Mills will show the materials needed for the items to be made. The primary item needed should enter via the conveyors and the secondary materials should be in the hoppers or on the conveyor input. The repair process can now repair items with less than max condition so you don't need to wait for something to break. Recipes can now include fluid input, with a placeholder item in the recipe and a container of the right fluid in the hoppers. Industrial Conveyor Ovens Used to thaw or cook foods with a trip through the machine, one for each step in the process. From frozen to thawed and then room temp to cooked. No chance of burning. Auto Butcher Used to attack zombies and animals that wander too close, cutting them up, taking their items and depositing them inside it's storage compartment. Blood from the butchering can be stored in fluid containers placed on the west side of the butcher for collection under the fluid output. It can be configured to push items in a direction of choice which will fill stacked boxes, conveyors, or load into vehicles. Any sprite based containers will do. See video for more information. https://youtu.be/MhHh-kHEwkw Volume Slider: All New! A volume slider for the machines has been added to the mod options screen. Saws are terrible at perfect component extraction, so a deconstruction option was added to milling machines. Example: the baseball factory by default can convert logs into baseball bats, add nails into a drum or tower hopper and switch the recipe to spiked baseball bats and it will create them from baseball bats. Set direction and power on any of the devices. Right clicking on the objects will bring up basic menus to configure them. One of my favorite parts is coming home and dropping all my loot on a conveyor, the conveyor brings them through the sorters and dumps the materials by category into the boxes or on more conveyors. For instance, you can put a freezer next to the UPM in sorting mode and set food to be pushed into them. You can also configure the directions for the filters to send multiple categories into the same box with one sorter. Recipe Add-Ons Now Possible! This new version in v1.17 now unlocks the hard coding between this mod and the recipes it uses. It also pulls in lists using event triggers (Thank you, Elyon!). In the coming days I will explain how to make the add-on mods to pull outside recipes into this mod. Add-ons already created by other modders: Industrial Revolution Craftable Projectiles Add-on https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3364732874 Industrial Revolution Brita Add-on https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3364732562 Now compatible with Organized Categories. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3370707195 **Added an update with a sandbox option to force add-on mod categories to float to the top of the filtered category lists.** This has been tested in multiplayer and can be added to an existing game. Make sure you have the prerequisites! Workshop ID: 3400131934 Mod ID: IndustrialRevolution

description: Barricades, Doors, Windows, and Vehicles Hurt Zombies [Build 42] Updated for B42.17+ A comprehensive Build 42 update that makes zombies take damage when attacking barricades, doors, windows, and vehicles. This mod introduces damage systems that make fortifications matter in the zombie apocalypse. Key Features Damage on thumpable objects such as doors, windows, and barricades. Fully functional vehicle damage system based on B42 vehicle attack states Material-based damage scaling for both barricades and vehicles SVU3 armor script and visible armor part detection when available Customizable sandbox settings for all damage values Visual feedback through blood effects How It Works When zombies attack structures or vehicles, they take damage based on what they are attacking. The system identifies different structure materials and vehicle armor signals: Material Damage Multipliers: Wood Structures: Base damage (1.0x) Metal Structures: 25% more damage (1.25x) Heavy Metal: 40% more damage (1.4x) Light Spikes: 50% more damage (1.5x) - SVU3 armor script/part support Heavy Spikes: 75% more damage (1.75x) - SVU3 armor script/part support Reinforced: Double damage (2.0x) - SVU3 armor script/part support Vehicle System The mod features a vehicle damage system that: Detects B42 vehicle attack state against occupied vehicles Uses the passenger door or nearest bodywork part when B42 exposes one for the attack Falls back safely to base vehicle material damage when no specific part is available Applies appropriate damage multipliers based on material type Sandbox Options Customize the mod to your liking: Base Damage: Control how much damage zombies take (0-100%) Vehicle Base Damage: Tune vehicle attack damage separately Material Multipliers: Adjust damage for different materials Damage Source Selection: Choose which objects can hurt zombies Blood Effects: Toggle visual feedback Cooldowns and log level controls Current Status The mod is fully functional for all base game content and vehicles. SVU3 compatibility is best-effort through vehicle script and part IDs: All vehicles are recognized and processed Vehicle damage works correctly Modded vehicles without recognizable armor signals use the base metal multiplier (1.25x) Recognized SVU armor scripts and visible armor parts use their configured armor multipliers B42.17 Testing Needed This update has been code-reviewed and statically validated, but I still need real SP and dedicated MP feedback on Project Zomboid 42.17. Please enable BHZ debug logging if you can: Set DebugMode=true, VehicleDebugMode=false, LogLevel=5 Reproduce the issue, close PZ, and share %USERPROFILE%\Zomboid\Lua\BHZDebug.log The log includes PZ build, SP/MP side, BHZ settings, ZombieLore, active mods, and damage calc/apply/kill lines Please also mention what looked wrong in-game, such as blood with no damage, full-health zombies suddenly dying, or the object/vehicle being thumped Changelog v2.2.2 - B42.17 Dedicated MP Fix Fixed dedicated MP cases where zombies could show blood effects but keep full health on Build 42.17. Client-owned zombies now take damage on the owning client first, then report the target health to the server so normal PZ zombie sync cannot undo the damage. New mod The Ark is now released! Week One Week One let's you begin the game 7 days before the zombie outbreak. You will start in a clean, zombie-free world along with other people (NPCs). It will be your choice whether you want to be a decent citizen, a serial killer or somebody else, just remember that your actions have consequences. Over time you will experience the progression of events leading to the unavoidable Knox Event. You are immune to the airborne transmission as well as some other survivors. But most of the people are not. Be careful, even in the beginning, the people are already nervous which is the first symptom of what is to come. There are many hidden features that you will have to discover yourself. Your will receive some clues during sleep. Please do not post spoilers in the comments. If you are lost and like spoilers, check guide Also check out Week One and Bandits Discord. This mod isn’t meant to be a faithful simulation of reality — it’s not possible to achieve that. Instead, it’s supposed to be funny, so take it lightly when things don’t go as planned. Based on your feedback, I may refine it over time. Don’t expect a peaceful experience either. You won’t get a leisurely seven-day grace period without zombies to prepare. Things escalate quickly, and the intensity ramps up fast. Be ready to adapt to new challenges, even if it means player deaths along the way. Donations / Payments / Gifts Before you begin This works only for B42 version of the game. You need to switch manually to unstable beta branch! Must also have enabled Bandits mod which serves as NPC engine for this mod This mod consumes a lot of performance. The workaround is to decrease NPC and zombie numbers in sandbox settings. Also NPC vehicles use a lot of performance) Must start with the mod (don't add to existing save game). NPC vehicles might crash the game. Just reload the save or disable NPC driven cars if the problem persists. Always start at hour 9.00 otherwise some events will happen in awkward time. Some sandbox settings are overwritten because they don't make sense in the world before the outbreak, for example car condition The mod modifies the world, if you remove the mod, the changes in the world will stay. If you die, it's better to start with a new world During the game, the icons pointing to events can be removed by a double click. FAQ Q: Why are sounds so loud? A: Zomboid plays differently sounds from original sound banks and modded sounds. If your system volume is maxed and your game sound is very low (like 10%) you will have the problem. Decrease overall operating system volume and restore in-game volume to 60%+ Q: Can I interact with NPCs? A: Press "T" to chat with them. Use American English, type simple sentences, avoid spelling mistakes. Q: Where are the trailers? A: Initially they are removed as they spawn in middle of the roads, which does not make sense. Later you can find them. Credits Peter Hammerman - Vehilce 3d models Lauren Sinclair - radio transmissions scripts and sounds, other sounds SaneGuy - NPC animations Ravense - mod poster art and icons Shadesz, Joey Bracken - Voice acting Some modified and fixed for b42 animations orginate from iBrRus's (True Actions. Missing aiming cursor - disable NPC cars in sandbox options or learn how to shoot with iso cursor NPC cars drive only in straight line - no possible solution If you find a bug, leave a comment and if there was an error, post it in discussions.
