description: Newest Addition: Fishing Status UI Better Fishing now includes an optional, movable status UI that gives you quick visual feedback while using a fishing rod. It shows: Whether you are currently inside the bonus time window Whether your cursor is near shore Whether the current weather is good, neutral, or bad for fishing Whether your equipped fishing rod has valid bait attached Each icon also has a tooltip if you want more details. You can move the UI freely, and its position will be saved automatically. You can also disable it completely or change its scale in the Mod Options. Newest Addition: Reload Bait Press Reload to quickly attach the first valid bait found in your inventory. Press and hold Reload to open a radial menu and choose a specific bait yourself. Backpacks and nested containers are fully supported. Better Fishing — Simple, Readable, Adjustable Made for the latest Project Zomboid unstable Build 42. Better Fishing keeps vanilla fishing recognizable, but makes the important parts easier to understand and easier to tune. It is especially useful on small ponds, pools, and narrow water areas, where vanilla fishing can feel unnecessarily punishing. TL;DR This mod keeps the vanilla fishing system, but gives you better sandbox control over the values that matter most: shore detection casting distance time-of-day bonuses weather multipliers a flat fishing modifier applied at all temperatures Vanilla Tables or Better Fishing Tables Important Information This mod uses Sandbox Settings. It no longer uses ModOptions. All settings are configured in a dedicated Better Fishing sandbox page. Most settings apply directly through sandbox values. The only option that needs a reload is: Vanilla Tables ↔ Better Fishing Tables If you switch the table selection, reload the save or return to the main menu first. Existing saves are supported. If you add Better Fishing to an already running world, the mod applies its default sandbox values automatically. You can then change them however you want in Sandbox Settings. What this mod gives you Smarter, adjustable shore detection Uses a smaller and cleaner shore check, which works much better on tiny ponds and swimming pools. No more feeling “too close to shore” just because the whole water area is small. Adjustable casting distance Set a less frustrating casting range. Default: 16 tiles Range: 16–20 tiles Adjustable time-bonus windows Configure the morning and evening bonus windows, plus the strength of the bite-rate bonus. Adjustable weather multipliers Tune fog, wind, and rain to fit your preferred balance. Flat fishing modifier at all temperatures The temperature setting in Better Fishing is not based on warm or cold ranges. It is a flat fishing modifier applied equally at all temperatures. 100% = no change. Adjustable near-shore size behavior A single Near-Shore Size Shift setting lets you control how strongly near-shore fishing shifts results toward smaller fish. Switch Catch Size Tables: Vanilla ↔ Better Fishing Choose between the game's original catch size tables and Better Fishing’s tuned tables for a smoother progression. Why use Better Fishing? Vanilla “near shore” is very generous. The game checks a large area around your target tile. If any shore tile is found, you are treated as near shore. That reduces the odds for Medium and Big fish and pushes more results into Small fish. This feels especially harsh on small waters. On ponds, pools, and tight fishing spots, you often end up getting penalized simply because there is shore almost everywhere nearby. Vanilla can feel stingy at low and mid skill. Skill-based size limits and near-shore penalties can keep you in Small and Medium results for a long time. Weather can also swing results hard. Fog and strong wind reduce your odds, while rain improves them. With Better Fishing, you decide how strong those effects should be. The result: Fishing becomes easier to understand, easier to balance, and much more sandbox-friendly without replacing the whole vanilla system. Vanilla vs. Better Fishing — Size Chances and Limitations Click the image for a bigger view: Left = Vanilla / Right = Better Fishing How to use the options Open your world’s Sandbox Settings and go to the Better Fishing page. There are no feature checkboxes. You adjust the values directly. Reload required only for table switching. If you change Vanilla Tables or Better Fishing Tables, reload your save afterwards. FAQ Does this mod add items, maps, or UI screens? Mostly no. It only adjusts fishing logic, values, and table selection. But with a recent update I added a fishing UI. Is this safe for existing saves? Yes. The mod does not add map content or item content. Is this compatible with other mods? Usually yes. Conflicts are unlikely unless another mod directly overrides the same fishing logic or the same fishing tables. Your support helps me keep going—thank you very much in advance! description: Compatible with both B41 and B42 Works in multiplayer for any version This mod only affects the climate during winter - other seasons won`t be changed. Introduction: Vanilla Zomboid climate of Kentucky is set up in such a way that winters are quite warm and mild. For instance, snow barely stays for more than a month between December and February, and it melts pretty often. Additionally, you may only encounter quite low temperatures a couple of times throughout the whole winter. Even if you change the temperature preset in Sandbox to "Cold" the temperatures will drop to -15 degrees for a few weeks in January. Actually, these temperatures are historically accurate if you check KY weather history in 90`s, but some players may find it not challenging enough. What does this mod do: The "Cold Winters" makes winter tougher: temperatures can drop to -30 degrees Celsius, and you'll find yourself facing real cold by lowering winter temperatures, which is more challenging for your survival. Additionally, blizzards will occur more often (can be disabled in Sandbox settings), so be ready to cope with extreme weather. Moreover, there is a little chance in winter that your generator will failure due to cold and you have to restart it! You can disable it on world creation in sandbox settings. Winter will turn into a season that requires serious preparation. It will also take some time in the beginning of spring to make plus temperature back. My father was diagnosed with Stage 4 Cancer and we need funds to support him and buy him everything he needs, he is currently recovering from a back surgery where a tumor was removed from his spinal cord and will be undergoing chemo soon so if you can spare a dollar please donate to my Ko-Fi by clicking on the anime girl below, we deeply appreciate it even if it's a dollar, anything helps! Are you dissapointed that Generators no longer light up the outside world? Does it feel like darkness just consumes every corner of the world? Do you miss when generators would light up the city or your base? Well darkness no more! Bring the lights back to nights! This mod, restores a feature intentionally removed in B42 by TIS, where streetlights and world lights like shops, signs, and billboards, turn on when a nearby generator is connected and running. Streetlight colors are customizable too! Choose from several different presets (Neutral White, Defective LED, Crimson Red, etc.) or set your own RGB colors! Important Note: Generator Streetlights Restored, uses its own lighting system and is not tied to the vanilla power grid or vanilla lighting system... for now. This also means the mod can affect client-side performance, however i've optimized it as much as possible to prevent that, but there's only so much Optimization i can do with a system like this (thanks TIS, sigh). Consider this mod a WIP Project, so expect bugs and issues. Features Generator Streetlights Restored works in single-player with multiplayer support. Decorative world signs and billboards light up too. Supports several languages! Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Turkish, Thai, Portuguese, Spanish, Polish and Korean! Custom streetlight colors support! Use any of the presets or use your own RGB colors! Adjustable tile radius for lighting, set how far each generator powers world lights. Intensity and glow radius, tune overall brightness and glow size. Customize all this and more in Sandbox Options! Known Issues and Bugs - The tile lighting range in Sandbox Options is a bit bugged and won't actually "respect" a value past a certain amount. Afaik values 10 - 60 work fine. - Performance degrades when more than 1 generator is placed an area, you may notice hitching or micro stuttering if using multiple generators near each other in one area, i recommend you place generators far away from each other in different areas, if you want it to light up more of an area, raise the tile lighting range however raising this value too much can also cause performance problems, so test whatever feels best for you. Additional Note: I will most likely end up rewriting the entire lighting logic and just use the vanilla lighting system instead (since that's native and far better for performance) but we'll see, i have to look at what's possible first, as im not sure if TIS removed the original coding for generators powering world lighting. - A few bugs remain with the lighting. For example, Color Presets are actually only supposed to apply to streetlights exclusively but for now it's applying to a lot of other world lights which wasn't intended. May or may not fix that since it's not really much of a problem and some people may like it so we'll see. - Besides that, there's probably more bugs that i didn't notice or didn't catch, i did try to test this system a lot and fix whatever i could but nothings perfect. As always report them down below in the comments or on a post. Incompatibilities - Any mod that does something similar to my mod. (Lighting mods, Generator overhaul mods etc) Possible list of incompatible mods: Light Switch Plus (B42): https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3418843205 Ultimate Generator Overhaul: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3478628177 Reporting Bugs - This mod is complex, i need exact details of your bugs, so please provide detailed reports in the Discussions section. description: Quick'n'Auto Mark TL;DR Quick'n'Auto Mark automatically marks buildings on your map when you enter them and gives you a compact, slide-up dock for fast manual marking, quick color selection, easy symbol placement, symbol scaling, and nearby mark cleanup. If you also use Where Is My Car?, you can now assign a separate vehicle-only favorite color by right-clicking a color in the Quick'n'Auto Mark dock. If you like using the map a lot, I also highly recommend my companion minimap mod: TwisTonFire - minimap What this mod adds Automatic building marks When you enter a building, the mod can automatically place a marker at its center. Configurable auto-mark delay Choose whether buildings are marked immediately or after a delay of 1 / 2 / 3 / 5 / 10 in-game minutes. Manual marks take priority If you manually place your own symbol inside a building, that building’s automatic mark is suppressed so your own map notes stay in control. Slide-up quick dock A small dock appears at the bottom of the screen when you hover there, giving you fast access to colors, common symbols, erase tools, settings, scale controls, and minimap access. Full symbol picker Open a full tabbed symbol picker for more icons beyond the quick-access buttons. Smart color handling Your available colors depend on the pens and pencils you actually carry. Mixed colors become available when you carry the right combination of writing tools. Separate vehicle color support If Where Is My Car? is active, you can right-click a color in the dock to assign a separate vehicle-only favorite color without changing your normal Quick'n'Auto Mark color. Marker size control Use the built-in slider to adjust symbol size, reset it back to default, and fine-tune nearby marks more easily while playing. Nearby manual mark eraser Carry an eraser and you can remove nearby manual marks placed through the mod without wiping your entire map clean. Vanilla minimap integration Open the vanilla minimap directly from the dock, or combine this mod with TwisTonFire - minimap for an even better experience. Sidebar map popup support Adds an extra dock toggle to the map popup for quick access. Why it feels good to use The dock is compact, fast, and stays out of the way until you need it. The mod is built around the vanilla map and symbol system, so using it feels natural instead of intrusive. Your favorite color, dock state, and related settings are remembered. If you use Where Is My Car?, you can keep a separate vehicle color without changing your normal marking color. You can combine auto-marking with manual notes instead of being forced into one style. It is designed as a practical quality-of-life tool for players who actually use the minimap during normal gameplay. Settings included Turn automatic building marks ON/OFF Choose the delay before a building is marked Choose the auto-mark symbol Adjust the symbol scale Reset the scale back to its default value Quick Dock features Fast color swatches One-click quick symbols Right-click color support for Where Is My Car? Full symbol picker button Nearby manual mark erase button Scale slider + reset button Settings button Minimap button Compatibility & performance Designed to be lightweight and practical during normal gameplay. Built around the vanilla world map, map symbols, and minimap systems. Generally compatible with most mods, but mods that heavily replace the map UI, map popup, minimap behavior, or world map symbols may conflict. Best experience if you are already used to marking loot spots, bases, vehicles, generators, gas stations, or points of interest on your map. FAQ Do I need pens or pencils? Yes. Your available colors depend on the writing tools you carry. Can I still place marks manually? Absolutely. Manual marking is a core part of the mod, and your own manual marks can override building auto-marks. Can I change marker size? Yes. Use the size slider or the reset button. Can I remove marks again? Yes, nearby manual marks can be erased with an eraser. Can I use a separate vehicle color with Where Is My Car? Yes. Right-click a color in the Quick'n'Auto Mark dock to assign a vehicle-only favorite color. If no separate vehicle color is set, it will fall back to your normal favorite color. What if auto-marking does not happen? Make sure Auto Marks are enabled, make sure you are actually inside a building, and make sure you have a valid writing tool available. Will removing the mod erase existing marks? No. Symbols already placed on your map remain saved as map symbols. Controller? No, just no. Recommended companion mod For the best experience, pair this with: TwisTonFire - minimap It makes using map-based QoL mods feel much more comfortable during actual gameplay. description: You're bitten. You have two choices. Wait until you succumb to the virus or take matters into your hands. Cut off that infected part and live to die another day. Quick guide Amputation Get some kind of Saw, Axe, or Machete, right click on it, and choose which limb to amputate. You can also drag n' drop the item directly into the afflicted area to start cutting it off. If you have some bandages and\or stitches in your inventory you will automatically use them, multiplying the chances of your survival. If you have a tourniquet, place it on the correct side to dampen the amount of damage you will take after you're done amputating the limb. Keep in mind that if you amputate your upper arm, you won't be able to equip any prosthesis. After you've amputated a limb, you will gain skill points for the amputated side, making timed actions faster in due time. Cicatrization You can check the cicatrization status of an amputated limb from your Health Panel From time to time, you should clean your wounds with a bandage to help the cicatrization process. If your limb isn't completely cicatrized, you can still equip prosthetic limbs, but that can trigger random bleedings from that area. Prosthetics If you're missing a hand, you won't be able to do a lot of things, such as equipping two-handed weapons. With prosthetics limbs, you can fix that. There are two prosthesis type that can be crafted\found in medical areas: Hook Prosthesis Arm Prosthesis The main difference between the twos is that your actions will take longer with the Hook Prosthesis. When you equip a prosthetic limb, you will slowly gain skill points in the Prosthesis Familiarity perk, making actions more speedy in due time. Admin tools If something strange happened, an admin can reset TOC mechanics on any player by right clicking on them and select "Reset Amputations". They could also do the opposite by clicking on "Force Amputation" for each amputable limb. Issues and bugs? Got any issues or found some pesky bugs? Report them on GitHub! Credits Want to support me? description: Unseasonal Weather – Dynamic Climate Events & Radio Forecasts Does the weather feel predictable after a few in-game weeks? Unseasonal Weather adds a layer of unpredictable, season-aware climate events on top of the vanilla system — now enhanced with an immersive radio-based weather awareness system. The world no longer tells you exactly what’s coming. You’ll have to listen, interpret, and decide. What this mod does Dynamic seasonal weather events: each season has its own pool of climate anomalies (heat waves, blizzards, fog banks, tropical rains, cold fronts…). New Radio Forecast System (v1.3): weather hints are broadcast over radio frequencies using ambiguous, human-like reports. Imperfect information: forecasts can be normal, false, erroneous or interrupted — just like in real life. Automatic start & recovery: events trigger naturally and fade back into vanilla climate after several in-game hours. Soft randomness: every event receives subtle intensity variations — no two events feel the same. Rare & ultra-rare cinematic events: extremely uncommon atmospheric phenomena with unique visual tone. Radio Forecasting – How it works (v1.3) The weather is no longer obvious. Once per in-game day, the system may schedule a radio forecast. [* ]Forecasts are broadcast on a dedicated frequency and must be actively listened to. Messages are intentionally ambiguous: they describe air pressure, humidity, wind, heat or cold — never exact events. Some forecasts are misleading, incomplete or interrupted by interference. Silence is also possible — no broadcast doesn’t mean safety. Not all radios receive the signal from Unseasonal Weather Network. You are not told what will happen. You are given clues — and survival depends on how you interpret them. How to Use the Radio Forecast System Find a working radio or walkie-talkie. Equip it or place it nearby and make sure it is powered on. Tune the device to the Unseasonal Weather Network frequency (112.2 MHz). Set the volume high enough to hear broadcasts clearly. Wait for a scheduled forecast window: Morning broadcasts: typically between 08:00 and 11:00. Night broadcasts: typically between 20:00 and 23:00. (The active window depends on your Sandbox settings.) Listen carefully to the message — tone, wording and uncertainty matter. Important: Forecasts are not guaranteed every day. Some broadcasts may be false, erroneous or interrupted. Silence does not mean safety — sometimes there is simply no signal. Radio Teasers – Signal Noise & Early Warnings Sometimes the radio speaks before it knows what to say. Short, ambiguous broadcasts may appear days or hours before a real forecast — hinting that atmospheric conditions are being monitored. These messages do not guarantee an upcoming transmission. Some are vague. Some are precise. Some are simply wrong. They are not alerts. They are not schedules. They are fragments of information. Listening is a choice. Understanding is never guaranteed. Note about walkie-talkies: Even if a frequency is set, walkie-talkies do not receive automated radio broadcasts. This is a vanilla engine limitation. Use a radio device to listen to forecasts. Radio starts tuned automatically How climate events work Each in-game day rolls a chance for a special weather event. If triggered, an event is selected based on the current season (or from rare global pools). Temperature, fog, wind, rain and cloud density are overridden using the vanilla ClimateManager. Events last several in-game hours (sandbox configurable). Once finished, all overrides are cleanly removed and vanilla weather resumes. Rare Global Events Uncommon atmospheric phenomena that can occur in any season: SuperFog – extremely dense fog with near-zero visibility. Crystal Clear Day – unnaturally clean skies and sharp light. Moonlit Clarity – bright, cold nights with no fog. Blood Sky – heavy reddish clouds and oppressive atmosphere. Static Storm – storm clouds without rain. Ashfall / Dustfall – drifting grey haze. Frozen Dawn – icy sunrise with pale fog. Silver Skies – metallic-bright overcast skies. Ultra-Rare Cinematic Events Extremely unlikely. Not shown in sandbox settings. Solar Hellburst – a harsh red-orange solar glare, dune-like and oppressive. White Death – a polar-blue atmospheric freeze with piercing cold tones. If you see one… you were unlucky. Or lucky. Hardcore Temperature Extremes For players who enable hardcore settings: Extreme heat can force you indoors. Extreme cold can become lethal without shelter. The world won’t kill you instantly — but staying outside is a mistake. All temperature changes are additive and scale with sandbox intensity. Debug Commands UW.startEvent() UW.endEvent() Useful for testing, servers, and admins. Compatibility & Performance Build: Project Zomboid Build 42 Singleplayer / Multiplayer: supported (server-side install required for MP). Performance: extremely lightweight — periodic checks only. Compatibility: works with most weather mods unless they hard-override climate every tick. Having received permission, credit must be given to the original creator, both within the files of the mod and wherever the mod roams online. If no permission is received you may not alter the mod, and it must be treated as a mod that is 'On Lockdown'. The only exception is that servers may freely include this mod in their modpacks, with the freedom to alter it or make modifications as they see fit, as long as credits are properly given to the original creator. Support the Mod Support the Project If you enjoy this mod and want to support future updates and new systems: Your support helps expand the project and keep development active. description: Airdrops This mod allows you to spawn airdrops containing valuable loot or animals (in a living or deceased state). A clear marker will appear on the map showing the drop zone. When the crate lands, a signal fire will light up at the exact location to help players locate the drop. Key Features Advanced Sandbox Customization: Set the drop frequency your way: from 1 hour to 1 whole year. Progressive Drop Timer: Dynamic interval adjustment based on a multiplier (-5.0 to +5.0). Each airdrop can make the next one more or less frequent! Configure spawn-near-player settings (chance, min/max radius). The airdrop can now land anywhere on the map, no matter how far from the player! (try a radius of 1000–2000). Visual Effects Control: Choose drop site effects - none, fire with lighting, smoke, or both for enhanced immersion. Explosive Cleanup System: Configure what happens when airdrops expire - explosion with sound, zombie spawn, aggressive animal spawn, or nothing. Effect Power Scaling: Adjust the intensity of cleanup effects from subtle (1) to maximum (200) for dramatic finales. Turn off the map marker for a true challenge and hunt down the airdrop before it vanishes! All sandbox changes (presets, defaults, intervals) apply in real-time without a restart. Diverse & Configurable Loot: 11 Loot Presets: Medical, Survival, Tools, Weapons (with ammo), Materials, Food & Drinks, Kitchenware, Junk + Accessories + Bags, Clothing, Animals, and Books. Animals Preset: The crate includes hay and animal feed. Exactly one animal (live or corpse) will spawn 2–3 tiles from the crate. Mod-Friendly: Loot is drawn from ProceduralDistributions for maximum variety and mod compatibility. Full Control: Override loot lists via AirdropCategories.ini or use custom tables for coordinates and loot distribution. Immersive Gameplay Mechanics: Your character says one of five random lines when a nearby drop occurs (EN/RU). Game speed returns to normal on airdrop touchdown. If sleeping, your character will wake up (only if not drunk and fatigue < 80%). Visual Effects: Configurable drop site effects - fire with lighting, smoke, or both for up to 2 in-game hours. Explosive Cleanup: Airdrops now explode when their timer expires! Choose from explosion, zombie spawn, or aggressive animal spawn effects. Radio messages alert you to the airdrop zone. A beeper shows your distance — follow the signal! Daily Schedule Broadcasts: Automatic radio notifications from 03:00 to 06:00 every day, informing you of the time remaining until the next airdrop. Messages are fully localized with proper grammar for all supported languages. World Interaction & Dangers: The airdrop crate can be smashed open with a Sledgehammer. Zombies may appear near the airdrop site. If the "Bandits" mod is active, bandits may appear near the drop. Progressive Timer Examples Based on default settings: Airdrop Frequency = 5%, Min Interval = 24h How it works: Airdrop Frequency (5%): Each hour, there's a 5% chance to spawn an airdrop (if interval allows) Min Interval (24h): Minimum time between airdrops (base interval) Progressive Multiplier: Modifies the interval after each successful airdrop Formula: New interval = Current interval + (Current interval × Multiplier) Note: Intervals are capped between 1 hour (minimum) and 8760 hours (1 year maximum). Save Compatibility & Airdrop Cleanup The mod maintains full save compatibility — installing or removing it will not corrupt your existing saves. Airdrop Lifecycle & Cleanup: Configurable Timer: Airdrops automatically expire after a set time (1-8760 hours, default 24h). Explosive Cleanup: When the timer expires, airdrops can explode with sound, spawn zombies, spawn aggressive animals, or simply disappear based on your settings. During explosions, nearby players will be knocked back and damaged, potentially suffering fractures, wounds, and other blast effects depending on their distance from the airdrop and the explosion power. Effect Power Control: Adjust cleanup effect intensity from subtle (1) to dramatic (200) for the perfect finale. Manual Destruction: You can destroy airdrop crates instantly with a Sledgehammer before they expire. Upon mod removal: Automatic Cleanup: All mod-spawned airdrops are scheduled for automatic removal after a total of 25 hours (a 24-hour cooldown period + a 1-hour buffer). description: This mod was developed with this theme in mind. Bathing and showering in Project Zomboid should feel meaningful. This mod adds fully playable bath and shower mechanics, and gives them a real place in day-to-day survival. Bathing is not just flavor. It can become part of how you stay comfortable, clean, and in good condition over time. Is washing yourself in a sink, or even a toilet, really enough to feel clean? You might survive without proper bathing, but it should not feel ideal. Detailed feature notes are listed in the guide because of the Workshop character limit. This Mod Guide Features Adds an invisible body dirt parameter called Grime. The Grime system can be disabled in the sandbox options. Bathtubs function as fluid containers. Includes a dedicated bathtub UI. Adds "Take Shower" options to white showers and wall-mounted showers. Adds a "Take Bath" option to white bathtubs. Bathing Benefits: bathing can help relieve various negative stats. Items Body Shampoo: an alternative to soap. (Currently shower-only.) Bath Salt: can be added to tub water. There are currently 6 types, each with different bathing benefits. Automatic Clothing Change: includes a wide range of options. Improved Plumbing: bathtubs and showers can calculate available water from the total amount stored in all water collectors in the 3x3 area above them. Advanced Prep Location Detection: the character can better detect where to prepare for bathing. Toilets, cabinets, and other awkward tiles are given lower priority even if they are technically usable or closer. Bathtubs have four sprite variations: with shower (vanilla), cleaned with shower, without shower, and cleaned without shower. You can always climb over the edge of a bathtub. This can sometimes result in zombies ending up in the bathtub. Bathtubs and showers can be separated through the context menu. (Requires a pipe wrench.) Shower parts can be removed from bathtubs and deluxe showers. Removed shower parts can be packed, unpacked, and placed as wall-mounted showers. Deluxe showers can be crafted using shower parts and wall-mounted showers as materials. Separated bathtubs can have shower parts or wall-mounted showers attached again. Adds recipes for packing and unpacking shower parts and wall-mounted showers. Clean Tub variants are available for both attached-shower and separated-shower types. The improved Deluxe Shower can rotate in all four directions. The vanilla version only supports S and E. Recommended Mods Moodle Framework Bath Towels Overhaul Starlit Library I intentionally did not make these required, but I strongly recommend them because they support important parts of this mod. Compatible Mods Included Patches Ra's Body Mod - dedicated compatibility patch included. Lifestyle: Hobbies - [Important] Load after this mod. bath and shower interactions are replaced by this mod's versions, and bathing can also reduce `hygieneNeed`. WaterPipes - bathtubs and showers can be connected to WaterPipes pipes. General Compatibility Automatic clothing change is designed to work with most body mods. Tomb's Player Body Overhaul - one of my personal favorites, and the one used in the screenshots. Wash or Rot - its grime system is similar but not identical, so the two mods can coexist and may work well together. Anthro Survivors - Although a patch is included, there is no guarantee that it will work correctly with the latest version. More Damaged Objects - [Important] Load after this mod. My mods are not compatible with mods that directly overwrite the base game's files or functions. Using them together may cause unexpected bugs. FAQ I filled the bathtub with water, but I can't see the water. When I get into the bathtub, my lower body disappears. A: Please check the loading order above. Manual sorting is required, not just official auto sort. Known Issues Uninstalling this mod while saving is not recommended, as it will leave a large amount of junk in the game. Some features may still behave oddly in split-screen mode. The bathtub and shower faucet menus are currently limited because the vanilla fluid menu is broken. If you speed up the game during the movement or clothing-change steps before or after showering, the action may stop midway. This happens because WalkAction and PathFindBehavior can be canceled at high game speeds. Translations EN ES - thanks to Kasualidad. FR - thanks to Bukaroo_Fr. IT - thanks to [ITA] D4rk JP KO - thanks to Reeul2. PL - thanks to Marcus Vallerdon. PTBR - thanks to SIMBAproduz. RU - thanks to ESSEQUAMVIDERI. TR - thanks to xeotN. Please help support additional translations. Future Plans More balance adjustments. Additional polishing and expansion of bathing-related content. Metal barrel bathing. If you like my mod, please consider buying me a ko-fi. It helps support future modding work. Workshop ID: 3592172476 Mod ID: TakeABathAndShower42 Mod ID: TakeABathAndShowerNew

description: ✅ Status — Works from Build 42.12 to Build 42.19 Foraging Light Tuning Formerly: Foraging Light Fix & Tuning Foraging Light Tuning lets you tune how much flashlights help during Search Mode / Foraging in Project Zomboid Build 42. In newer B42 builds, vanilla flashlight handling can make an active flashlight behave almost like full daylight for foraging. That avoids older light fluctuation issues, but it can also make night foraging feel too forgiving. This mod restores configurable control over flashlight brightness for foraging, so a flashlight can help a lot without necessarily removing the darkness penalty completely. The Workshop name changed, but the internal mod ID is still ForagingLightFix to preserve save/server compatibility and existing sandbox settings. Safe for existing saves. Can be enabled or disabled anytime. What This Mod Does Lets you control the minimum effective light provided by an active flashlight. Allows flashlights to reduce the foraging Darkness Effect without always acting like full daylight. Keeps stable foraging light calculations while using flashlights. Allows stronger nearby light sources, such as street lights, daylight, ambient light, or lit rooms, to still improve visibility. Affects both the real Search Radius and the “Investigate Area” window tooltip. How It Works Minimum-Light Mode OFF If a flashlight is equipped and turned on, foraging uses the newer vanilla-style behavior: Effective light can reach 1.0. Darkness Effect becomes 1. The flashlight removes the darkness penalty. Use this if you prefer the current vanilla B42.18+ flashlight behavior. Minimum-Light Mode ON If a flashlight is equipped and turned on, the flashlight provides at least the configured Min Light (Flashlight) value. Default value: 0.8. Higher value = less darkness penalty. Lower value = harsher night foraging. Nearby stable light sources, such as street lights or lit rooms, can still raise the effective light level above the flashlight minimum. The mod keeps the tuned flashlight behavior stable while avoiding older square-to-square light spikes. This is the recommended mode if you want flashlights to help foraging without making darkness behave exactly like daylight. Sandbox Options All options appear under Foraging Light Tuning: Minimum-Light Mode — enables the tuned flashlight behavior. Min Light (Flashlight) — minimum effective light while using a flashlight when Minimum-Light Mode is ON. Suggested Presets Easy: 1.0 — flashlight removes the darkness penalty. Moderate: 0.8 — default; useful flashlight support without fully replacing daylight. Tough: 0.5 — flashlights help, but night foraging remains punishing. Compatibility Notes Designed for Project Zomboid Build 42. Reviewed for Build 42.19. Uses a simplified Build 42 structure for current supported versions. Does not add items, traits, recipes, or map content. Should be safe to add or remove from existing saves. Internal mod ID remains ForagingLightFix for compatibility with previous versions. Translations Includes translations for: CH, CN, CS, DA, DE, EN, ES, FR, HU, IT, JP, KO, NO, PL, PT, PTBR, RO, RU, TR and UA Suggestions and corrections are welcome. More Mods & Feedback You can find my other Project Zomboid mods here If you find this Workshop item useful, please consider leaving a thumbs up and adding it to your favorites — it helps other players discover it. Feedback, bug reports, balance suggestions, and translation improvements are always welcome. Workshop ID: 3596478900 Mod ID: ForagingLightFix

description: PoweredBuildings V2 Singleplayer + Multiplayer alpha Originally I just wanted to make a small mod that makes it possible to power an entire building with generators. Zomboid had other plans. Turn standard generators into whole-building power systems. Generator Powered Buildings lets you connect generators to a building and run that building as one managed power network instead of relying only on the normal nearby-generator coverage. You can link multiple generators into one pool, keep their vanilla outdoor radius, auto-refuel from linked storage, and monitor the whole setup from a dedicated Building Power Info window. You can access the full Building Power Info window from a light switch once the building has power (Generator -> Connect to Building -> Turn On). Main features Link up to 10 generators to one building. Generators still keep their vanilla 20x20 outdoor radius, so you can place them around the building for more coverage outside. Supports powered coverage from Z-3 to Z+16. Multi-level Generator placement Access building power management from generators and from supported light switches in powered buildings. Live Building Power Info window with pool fuel, condition, strain, power draw, active consumers, linked barrels, and heating data. Click a generator in the info window and your character will walk to it. Share power load and fuel usage across connected generator pools. Power strain system: if the building is too large for the active generators, fuel usage goes up. Link petrol barrels and compatible storage mods to the same generator pool for extra fuel storage and automatic refueling. Power grid extends about 3 tiles beyond the building footprint, so some appliances outside can still stay powered. Heating controls with target temperature support. Deactivate heating in the thermostat while grid power is still on to save fuel. Upper-floor heating placement support. Powered player-built buildings and player-built annexes on vanilla buildings. Automatic rebuilding of building consumer data on chunk load to avoid stale save data. Working placeable vanilla light switches. Generators have special multipliers What you do in game Place a generator near the building you want to power. Connect the generator to the building. Turn it on and let the mod scan the building's powered consumers. Open the Building Power Info window from the generator or a supported light switch in the powered building. Optionally link petrol barrels or compatible storage to the same generator pool for automatic refueling. Use the window to monitor pool fuel, strain, active lights and appliances, and heating settings. Sandbox options HeatingSystemEnabled HeatRadius BaseLoadCapacity MaxConsumersPerBuilding MaxGeneratorsPerBuilding Compatible mods Realistic Temperature Mod [B42] Fridges Off! [B42] Useful Barrels Known limitations HeatingSystemEnabled is currently most reliable in singleplayer; the full server-side master switch behavior is not final yet. Building mode currently still inherits the vanilla generator outdoor radius outside the building footprint. High strain currently increases fuel usage, but extra generator damage from strain is not final yet. Edge-case regressions are still possible while the integrated multiplayer branch is being stabilized. description: Irrigation Pipes/Cluster Barrels Turn your scattered rain barrels into a smart, connected water network. Cluster Barrels automatically links barrels through pipes, shares water evenly between them, and waters nearby crops on a timer—so your farms thrive even after the taps run dry. Key Features Plug-and-play: Build rain barrels and connect them with pipes. The mod detects connected barrels and groups them automatically. Auto-watering crops: Pipes periodically water farming plants within a configurable radius. Shared water pool: Water is averaged across all barrels in the same pipe group, keeping levels balanced. Fully configurable: Adjust watering interval, toggle auto-watering, set radius, and enable debug logs via Sandbox options. Performance-friendly: Targets only relevant areas with server-side logic and lightweight indexing. SP/MP ready: Works in singleplayer and multiplayer servers. How It Works Place rain barrels and connect them with pipes. The system assigns a group ID to each pipe network and “marks” adjacent barrels. On each interval, pipes check for nearby crops and water them using the group’s shared water. After watering, the mod balances water across all barrels in that group to avoid draining a single barrel first. Sandbox Options Watering Interval (minutes): 1–60 (default 10) Enable Auto Watering: On/Off (default On) Watering Radius: 0–10 tiles (default 0 = pipe’s own tile) Debug Logs: On/Off (default Off) Notes Works across multi-barrel networks on the same floor level (pipes/barrels connect on matching Z). description: About this mod: This mod makes temperatures more realistic, it completely changes how the air temperature feels, even when indoors. So at winter time you have to make sure to layer up, find some heaters, and close all doors and windows. In the summer time you can't be wearing too much clothing and run around in the heat or you'll risk overheating! Credit to my buddy NikoTM for making the custom heater models and textures! ------------------------------ FEATURES ------------------------------ Advanced simulation system for indoor temperatures. Warm air will flow out or in, depending on the outside temperature, if there's open doors, windows, or missing walls. It will also flow out of gaps under doors/around windows, so no house is fully sealed. Fully MP compatible, with specific code that makes sure that all players see the same temperatures. To save on performance and to make the simulation easier to apply, the indoor temperatures are updated every 1 minute of in-game time. Rooms in the same building will equalize towards the same temperature based on room sizes and their temperatures, if they have open or closed doors between them, and which floors they are on. Offline simulation system so even if you leave a building and return later, it will have updated temperatures based on the openings to the outside, and active heaters inside. If the world power is on then buildings still have active HVAC/Central heating systems that keep the building warm, but when the power goes out they will cool down based on the outdoor temperature. Supports huge buildings like malls, hospitals, and the airport New body temperature simulation which changes the efficiency of clothing, you will need to layer up with warm clothing to be fully protected. Hypothermia is now deadlier, and you will become hypothermic quickly if you don't have appropriate clothing. Supports player-made buildings. 4 new custom heaters, 2 electricity powered, 2 propane powered, with a custom UI to control the power and automatic shut-off timer. Vanilla heat sources are included in the simulation, so fireplaces, campfires, grills and ovens can be used to warm up. Standing near a heat source will warm you up faster. Car heaters also works for the simulation, so if you have gas in your car it can be used to stay warm (except in extremely cold temperatures). [EXPERIMENTAL] Food Freezing, this feature needs to be enabled in the sandbox settings and will cause some slight stutter. Simulated temperatures affects food, so food can now freeze at any point when the temperature is below freezing. You can put food outside, inside, in containers, or in your inventory, and they will freeze as long as the temperature is below freezing. ---------------------------- MOD INCOMPATIBILITIES ---------------------------- It's FULLY COMPATIBLE with other temperature mods that directly affect the outdoor temperatures, like Cold Winters or Unseasonal Weather or Cryogenic Winter INCOMPATIBLE with mods that change the digital watch UI as I had to implement my own to make my temperature values show up properly. If you use a mod to set the alarm by right clicning the UI, that feature has been added to my watch UI. Should be compatible with all clothing mods as long as they use proper insulation values. ---------------------------- FAQ ---------------------------- Is it safe to add mid-save? Yes it can be added/removed mid-save. In very rare cases when removing the mod mid-save there could be an issue with NaN values for temperature and wetness. To fix that use this mod: NaN Values Fix Also due to how my mod disables the thermoregulator, you need to fully restart the game after uninstalling the mod to make sure the thermoregulator resets to the default values. Does it make winters colder/summers warmer? No this mod does not actually change the outdoor temperatures, it uses the outdoor temperatures to set indoor temperatures. To have colder winters/warmer summers you need to combine it with other mods that changes the outdoor temperatures (like Cold Winters for example) Why am I getting cold so quickly even when wearing many layers of warm clothing? Most likely it's because the clothes are wet or have holes in them, or there's a strong wind causing you to get colder faster. Wet clothing is your number one enemy for staying warm, it lowers the insulation values a lot, so make sure to stay nice and dry with many layers! All the doors and windows are closed, so why is the room I'm in still getting colder? There is a small passive heat loss due to no house being 100% insulated, so it loses about 1 degree of heat per hour. ------------------------------ PLANNED FEATURES ------------------------------ Add more heater types and an air conditioner ---------------------------- KNOWN ISSUES ---------------------------- In rare cases it's possible that this mod triggers a vanilla bug that sets wetness and temperature values to NaN when it's uninstalled mid-save. To fix that, use this mod: NaN Values Fix If you have any issues, please join my Discord and post in the Support channel: ------------------------------ TRANSLATIONS ------------------------------ English Polish (Credit to Slav3106) French (Credit to Bonstalin) Ukrainian (Credit to Сonceived in a sock) Russian (Credit to Doctor Sex and Jackson Frost) German (Credit to Jackson Frost) Turkish (Credit to @Caesar) Spanish (Credit to @Ciro2020) This mod can only be added to and extended with the express permission from the original creator. description: Description This mod adds random blackouts and water shutoffs, creating a more immersive experience. These events can occur anytime during the week before a full power or water outage, adding tension and a sense of realism to the game. By default each in-game 10-minute interval carries a small chance of events: a 1% chance to turn off and a 5% chance to restore water or electricity. Features Dynamic Water and Electricity Blackouts – By default water and power can randomly go off (1% chance per 10 minutes) and come back on (5% chance per 10 minutes). Immersive Blackouts - Random Supply – This addon enables the random activation of water or electricity supply based on a configurable chance from the Sandbox Options. Each day at midnight, water and/or electricity can be restored for a specified period. Sandbox Options – configure blackout behavior to your liking. Light Flickering – before a blackout occurs, lights will flicker (as shown in the video). "Self-Cleaning" – once water and electricity are completely shut off, the mod stops affecting the game and can safely remain in your save. Safe to add or remove anytime – fully compatible with existing saves, no risk of breaking progress. Multiplayer Support WARNING (Light Flickering can be disabled) Flashing Lights: This mod contains flashing and flickering lights that may trigger epileptic seizures or fainting in individuals with photosensitivity. If you experience dizziness, vision disturbances, muscle twitching, disorientation, or loss of consciousness, stop using the mod immediately and seek medical attention. Note You can disable Water or Electricity events by setting their chances to 0%. Current Issues Sometimes the game fails to play the electricity shutdown sound, which causes the power shutdown event to break, and some objects (for example, signs) may remain illuminated. This is a game bug, not a mod issue, and it usually resolves itself after leaving the area, reconnecting to the server, or restarting the server. Compatibility Compatible with my other mod - Immersive Water Shutoff For Modders Immersive Blackouts exposes global variables These variables are intended for state checks only. Modifying them may cause unexpected behavior. ImmersiveBlackouts_isWaterShut ImmersiveBlackouts_isBlackout You can use them directly in your own Lua code to check the current shutdown state, for example: print(ImmersiveBlackouts_isWaterShut) print(ImmersiveBlackouts_isBlackout) if ImmersiveBlackouts_isBlackout then return end Debug/Server admins with Debug enabled You can toggle events via context menu. (Will not work if the global shutdown has already occurred) Translations Have a translation for the mod? Please share it in the Translations discussion! They're probably in military research sites, St. Peregrin Hospital and the Louisville university lab — you know, those charming places with armed checkpoints, biohazard warnings, and approximately eight million zombies per square meter. You’ll need to stay alive, stay healthy, and manage your resources carefully. Research takes time, preparation, and risk. I highly recommend setting the maximum texture size in the game options to at least 512x for the best visuals. If you prefer everything to blend in with Vanilla a little more then leave it at 256x. December 2025 Content Update 2! Merry Christmas 2 :) (Note: Skirts and Jackets are available exclusively for Tomb Body ver on B42.13+ only) What's included: Over 100+ clothing items with 600+ variations: Several styles of Leather Jackets + Trenchcoats. description: ZBBetterFPS A comprehensive performance overhaul for Project Zomboid that optimizes rendering, game logic, and CPU usage. Unlike traditional mods, ZBBetterFPS uses low-level runtime patching to fix performance bottlenecks deep within the game engine. ⚙️ All optimizations are disabled by default. Enable the ones you want in Mod Options → ZBBetterFPS after loading the game. 🚀 Key Optimizations: Smart Sprite Batching: Intelligently merges sprites and 3D models into fewer drawing commands, significantly reducing the load on your CPU. Graphics State Caching: Suppresses redundant graphics commands to ensure your GPU only receives necessary updates. Enhanced GPU Buffers: Increases internal render buffers to 1MB to reduce data transfer overhead between CPU and GPU. Faster 3D Models & Shaders: Optimizes the rendering of characters, items, and terrain through advanced data caching. Background CPU Throttling: Prevents the game from consuming 100% CPU when minimized or paused, keeping your PC cool while you're away. Adjustable Render Distance: Fine-tune how many tiles are rendered to match your hardware's capabilities. Streamlined Physics: Optimized math for object separation and physics updates to keep high-population areas running smoothly. ⚙️ Configurable Features: IndieGL Optimization: Caches graphics states for smoother rendering. RingBuffer Optimization: Larger GPU buffers for heavy scenes (Requires restart). Render Distance: Adjust from 24x24 to 312x312 tiles (Default is ~152x152). Background Throttling: Saves power and CPU when the game is not in focus. Uncapped FPS Control: Choose between Default, Force Uncapped, or Force Capped. ⚠️ Important: All optimizations are off by default—enable them in Mod Options. A savegame reload is required after changing the Render Distance setting for changes to take effect. The RingBuffer optimization requires a full game restart. Safe to add or remove on existing saves. ✅ Compatibility: Bandits: Compatible. When Bandits is enabled, minimum render distance is automatically limited to 130 tiles so bandit spawns work correctly. Game versions:: B41, B42.12 to B42.17 (inclusive) 📦 Installation: No manual installation needed for ZBBetterFPS! Just subscribe and enable it in the mod manager. You only need to install ZombieBuddy once (the required framework). See the ZombieBuddy mod page for instructions. After ZombieBuddy is set up, all mods that use it will work automatically! Requirements: ZombieBuddy - Required framework (one-time installation) Credits: Inspired by the original BetterFPS_B42 mod by Alree. ZBBetterFPS provides a modern, runtime-patched implementation with additional low-level optimizations. Links: GitHub Repository ZombieBuddy Framework ☕ Support the Developer: Workshop ID: 3622986450 Mod ID: ZBBetterFPS

description: PhunServer is an essential lightweight mod for multiplayer Project Zomboid servers. Designed for admins who want automation, safety, and quality-of-life without babysitting their server. TL;DR Automatically monitors Workshop mods and can trigger a controlled shutdown when updates are detected Provides useful admin and player commands (/players, /hours, /sethours) Supports resetting the players map when seasons change or even if the player dies Allows independent day/night speeds Adds optional chat quality-of-life features (greetings, cleaner radio/music output) PhunServer: Misc Various commands and server-side quality-of-life settings. Related commands: /players – Shows all online players. Can optionally include players who have been online in the last 24 hours by ticking the Include Recent option. /hours <username?> – Returns hours survived. If no username is supplied (or the user is not an admin/mod), the issuing player is used. Target player must be online. /sethours <username?> <number> – Sets a player’s hours survived. Admins and moderators only. Target player must be online. PhunServer: Chat Ensure your players feel seen. PhunServer: ModWatch Automatically monitor the Steam Workshop and trigger a controlled server shutdown when one or more mods have been updated. Heavily inspired by the excellent Udderly Up To Date, which I otherwise could not live without. Important: PhunServer does not restart your server automatically. It can trigger a shutdown, but you will still need a host, cron job, or service to bring the server back online. Once restarted, Steam will automatically update mods. Related commands: /check – Immediately checks the workshop for updated mods and triggers a restart countdown if any are found /restart <minutes?> – Trigger a restart with an optional countdown (0 = immediate). If omitted, the configured Countdown setting is used PhunServer: Maps Settings that control player visibility on maps and allow controlled map wipes for resets or seasons. Note that (when enabled) a players map is wiped when their wipekey differs from the one in your settings. This is evaluated at login or when a character is created (e.g. a respawn after death), PhunServer: Cycles Settings that allow you to control the start, end, and speed of day/night cycles. description: Compatibility: Build 42.13 → 42.19+ (SP/MP) Fix NaN Stats automatically detects when gameplay values become corrupted as NaN (Not-a-Number) or Infinity and safely restores them to valid values — preventing broken moodles/HUD bars, “temperature/wetness = NaN” issues, pain/health glitches, and other weird behavior caused by invalid numbers. What this mod does Sometimes a value can become NaN or Infinity due to a bug, a mod interaction, or an edge case. Once a value is invalid, many systems stop behaving correctly. This mod is a lightweight safety net: Detects invalid numbers (NaN, +Inf, -Inf) in stats, nutrition, pain/health sources, thermoregulation, and worn clothing. Repairs only values that are actually invalid (it does not change normal values). Runs automatically while you play. Optional on-screen + log notifications when something is fixed (Mod Options). When should you use it? Use this mod if you notice any of these symptoms: A stat/moodle looks “stuck”, behaves strangely, or never updates correctly. You use status-bar HUD mods (e.g. Simple Status, Modern Status) and one of the displayed bars shows weird/blank values, freezes, or behaves incorrectly. The Debug UI shows nan or an invalid value for a stat, nutrition value, temperature, wetness, pain, or a clothing-related field. You get the “body temperature = NaN” / “wetness = NaN” type of bug (especially noticeable during winter runs). You suspect a mod or an edge case caused numeric corruption. You can keep it enabled permanently, or enable it temporarily to repair a save and disable it again afterward. What it fixes Character stats The mod checks every CharacterStat and repairs any value that becomes invalid. Common examples include: Hunger, Thirst, Fatigue, Endurance, Fitness, Drunkenness, Anger, Pain, Panic, Morale, Stress, Boredom, Unhappiness, Sanity, Comfort, Wetness, Temperature, Health, ColdStrength, Sickness, etc. Nutrition Calories Carbohydrates Lipids (Fats) Proteins Weight (fallback reset if needed) Pain / health sources (BodyParts / BodyDamage) Repairs invalid numbers in BodyPart/BodyDamage fields that can cause global Pain to snap back to invalid values. Repairs BodyPart wetness and pain sources (plus related timers/fields when present). If a BodyPart’s Health becomes NaN, it is restored to 100 to prevent corruption loops. Repairs OverallBodyHealth (General Debuggers → Body) when it becomes invalid. Thermoregulation (temperature/wetness) Recovers from “body temperature = NaN”. Recovers from “wetness = NaN” (including per-body-part wetness). Scans Thermoregulator thermal nodes and performs a safe reset/update when needed. Includes BodyPart wetness recovery to prevent invalid-number feedback loops. Worn clothing values (when they become invalid) Insulation (invalid → restored to a safe/script default) Wind Resistance (invalid → restored to a safe/script default) Clothing/item wetness Blood level Dirtiness Notifications (optional) If enabled in Mod Options, the mod can display a small message over the character (and also write a log line) when it fixes something. This helps you notice when a specific action or mod interaction produced an invalid value. Example: Fix NaN: Temp/Wetness | Clothing x4 (Insulation/Wind) | Stats: Thirst | Nutrition: Calories Multiplayer notes Works in Singleplayer and Multiplayer (hosted/dedicated). For MP, the mod should be enabled on the server so fixes are server-authoritative and clients stay in sync. Performance / resource usage Very low. The mod performs lightweight checks at a fixed interval and only writes values when something is actually invalid. During normal gameplay (with no NaNs/Infs), it effectively does nothing. Safe to add / safe to remove Safe to add to an existing save: it only repairs corrupted values. Safe to remove: it does not add items, recipes, maps, or permanent content. It simply prevents and repairs invalid-number corruption while enabled. Notes This mod is a “sanity fixer”: it does not attempt to diagnose the root cause, only to restore valid, playable values. If you consistently get NaNs/Infs, consider checking mod conflicts and reporting details (build number + mod list + steps to reproduce). Planned improvements Possible future updates may include: Configurable check frequency Custom reset values (per stat) Credits Afyrmo — Original author and main maintainer (Fix NaN Stats) Kaori — Helpful investigation, reproduction notes, and contributions that improved the 42.15+ fixes (thanks!) description: Printer3D: Manufacturing & Recycling System A complete, balanced, and immersive industrial manufacturing and recycling system designed to integrate naturally into Project Zomboid’s survival gameplay. This mod introduces multiple types of 3D printers, filament materials, blueprints, power dependency, sound-based risk, and a late-game recycling pipeline — without turning the game into a factory simulator. Sustainability is not free. When industrial supplies run out, survival depends on dangerous, noisy, and unreliable recycling — not infinite resources. This is a tool for survivors, not a magic machine. Features Multiple 3D printer variants, each with a clear and distinct role Dedicated industrial recycling machine for late-game sustainability Real-time fabrication with noise propagation Power dependency (grid or generator) Printing failures, jams, and operational risk Filament-based material system Blueprint-based technological progression Portable emergency printer for survival scenarios Fully compatible with custom maps No crafting exploits, no infinite loops 3D Printer Types Standard 3D Printer Produces items faster than standard crafting Generates normal noise levels Provides reliable everyday printing Supports printing while you move around Requires indoor power Silent / Metal Printer Reduces noise output Maintains standard printing speed Performs well in urban or risky locations Supports printing while you move around Requires indoor power Fail-Safe Printer Reduces failure chance Maintains stable, controlled operation Supports long or advanced print jobs Supports printing while you move around Requires indoor power Focused on reliability rather than speed or silence. Portable Emergency Printer Compact and lightweight deployment Generates low noise Prints small emergency items quickly Requires the character to stay in place during printing Limited to small and medical items Requires indoor power Each printer is balanced to be useful — none is strictly better than the others. Printing System Printing takes real time Noise attracts nearby zombies Higher tiers increase noise and risk Power loss can cause failures Abandoning a print job has consequences Printing is a decision, not a free action. Filaments Different filaments affect: Print time Noise output Stability Access to advanced designs Advanced prints require multiple materials. Standard filament is always required as a base — precision and industrial filaments enhance or unlock advanced recipes. Blueprint Progression Blueprints define technological progress. Basic designs are common Advanced designs are rare Military locations provide faster progression Civil locations still allow long-term access Risk accelerates progress, but never blocks it. Blueprints are consumed on use. Item Acquisition Large printers spawn as rare industrial equipment Portable printers appear as rare survival loot Filaments and blueprints spawn in logical locations Fully compatible with custom maps No fixed locations. No memorized spawns. Every run is different. Sustainability & Recycling Finite industrial filament availability Late-game recycling as a survival fallback Higher risk, higher noise, higher failure rates Fully circular resource loop — no infinite production When resources run out, survival depends on what you can recover — not what you can endlessly craft. New in This Version (Framework v2.0 — Recycling & Sustainability Update) Recycling Machine System: Late-game industrial recycler that converts waste items into usable filament. Recycled Filament Type: A non-industrial filament with higher failure risk, intended for survival when standard supplies are gone. Circular Resource Economy: Empty filament spools are required for recycling, enforcing a balanced loop. Blueprint-Locked Recycling: Recycling unlocks only after mastering previous printer technologies. Anti-Exploit Safeguards: Switching to recycled filament permanently locks the printer into recycling mode. Machine Synchronization: Nearby printers synchronize recycling state to prevent exploits in SP and MP. High-Risk Operation: Recycling is loud, dangerous, and failure-prone. Expanded Recycling UI: Batch controls (x3 / x5 / x10), output previews, and failure probability indicators. Server-Safe & MP Compatible: Fully server-authoritative logic with deterministic outcomes. Sustainability isn’t safe. Recycling is loud, dangerous, and never guaranteed. Design Philosophy This mod does not make survival easier. It gives you options — at a cost. Noise, power, time, and risk always matter. Once you commit to a path, there is no undo button. Enjoy, survive, and choose carefully. description: My Spatial Refuge — Source Available / Community Versions Allowed Escape the apocalypse to your own personal, upgradeable spatial refuge! Build your ultimate survival space using Zombie Cores. Development Status & Source Code I can no longer actively develop this mod. I may still fix critical issues if I have time, but please do not expect regular updates or fast support. The source code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/nuclearthinking/myspatialrefuge You are explicitly allowed to use this code to create your own versions of the mod, forks, continuations, compatibility patches, or modified releases. You do not need to ask me for permission first. Credit is appreciated, but the main goal is to let the community keep the idea alive and improve it if someone wants to continue development. It will alert you if a vehicle isn't worth training on, so you never waste time. Resume Interrupted Training: If zombies interrupt you (or you cancel an action), you can pick up exactly where you left off. No more starting from scratch and wasting part durability! Efficiency First: The mod will never perform an action if it won't yield XP. Clearer Tooltips: Know exactly what tools you need and how your skill level, known recipes, and other factors impact the training before you start. Fast-Forward Supported: Fully supports speeding up the game in SP, allowing you to breeze through your training sessions. Nearby zombies will still reset the game speed to normal. Batch Uninstall: Quickly strip vehicles for spare parts! Translated into: English, German, Russian, French, simple + trad. Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Polish. 🚗 How to Use Open the mechanics window on any vehicle. Right-click any part. Select "Train Mechanics". Watch the levels go up! Note: Pathfinding can sometimes impact the training session. Please ensure your character has some walking space around the car. 💡 Tips You can only gain XP from a specific vehicle once per day. Right-click directly on a vehicle in the world to access the "Train Mechanics" button faster. The "Train Mechanics" button is automatically hidden once you reach Mechanics Level 10. ⚙️ Mod Settings You can customize the "Minimum Vehicle Part Success Chance" in the options. This value determines the safety threshold for installing/uninstalling parts; any part with a success chance below this value will be skipped during training. 0 (Risky): All parts will be worked on. Be careful—parts will break or lose condition at lower skill levels. 30 (Default): A good balance. Parts with a very low success chance are skipped to prevent excessive damage, while still allowing for decent XP gain. 100 (Safe Mode): Only parts that are guaranteed to succeed will be worked on. Multiplayer / Server Admins: Server owners can enforce this setting via Sandbox Options. -1 (Default): The setting is not enforced. description: Burd's Survival Journals Record your survival skills in personal journals and learn from the fallen. Find worn journals in bookcases and desks, loot bloody journals from zombie corpses, risk cursed journals for powerful rewards, or unwrap seasonal Yuletide gifts packed with supplies. Your knowledge doesn't have to die with you. Pass your journals to new characters, trade them with friends, or discover what survivors left behind before they turned. Leave a like or favorite if you're enjoying the mod, more features & polish to come down the line. Any feedback or bugs? Drop them in the comments or start a discussion! Features Sandbox Options — Fully Configurable Journals - Player: Enable/disable, XP recovery modes, baseline restrictions, pen/eraser requirements, learning times, capacity limits Journals - Loot: Spawn chances, XP ranges, trait/recipe/forget chances, limited-claim dissolution Journals - Loot (Fun): Cursed journal settings (curse types, disguise mode), Yuletide season timing and gift tiers, Krampus integration Journals - Advanced: Skill book multipliers, reading skill speed bonuses, light requirements, batch processing, multiplayer permissions, animated visuals toggle Journals - Other Mods: Compatibility toggles for Traits Purchase System, Adaptive Traits, Evolving Traits World, VHS skills Nearly everything is adjustable. Run it hardcore with strict limits, or generous with plentiful rare drops. Your server, your rules. FAQ Q: Does this work in the latest multiplayer build? A: Yes. Full server-authoritative multiplayer support with claim tracking, sharing permissions, and admin tools. Working Builds Checklist: ✅ B41 - SP/MP - Full working. Recently released, may not be as stable as B42 branches. ✅ B42 SP/MP (Up to 42.14) - Fully working ✅ B42.15+ SP/MP - Fully working Q: Will this break my existing save? A: No. Safe to add to current saves. "Only Record Earned Progress" takes effect on your next character respawn if you already have an established run. Removing the mod during save could destroy active player or loot journals. Q: Can I exploit this with profession skill farming? A: Not easily. Baseline restriction (enabled by default) prevents recording starting profession XP. You'd have to earn it the hard way first. Q: What traits can bloody/cursed/Yuletide journals have? A: Positive traits like Keen Hearing, Cat's Eyes, Organized, Brave, Fast Learner, and more. Negative traits are disabled by default but configurable. Cursed/Yuletide have higher drop chances for traits and forget slots. Q: Is this compatible with other mods? A: Generally yes. Works with most skill/trait mods that use standard B41/B42 registration. Compatibility toggles included for major trait mods. Safe function capture prevents crashes from conflicting mods. Q: How do cursed journals work? A: 0.08% zombie drop chance to replace a normal bloody journal spawn. Opening one applies a curse (10 possible effects), then transforms into a premium reward journal with 2-5 skills at 75-300 XP each. Can disguise as bloody journals if sandbox setting enabled - no warning prompt, immediate curse. Q: When do Yuletide journals spawn? A: During December by default, but configurable for in-game December, real-world December, or always-on. Replace worn (default 8%) and bloody (default 4%) spawns when active. Q: Can I use player journals as a memory system for my whole server? A: Yes. Record skills/traits/recipes, drop the journal in a shared base, let others claim. Per-character tracking means everyone gets their own copy of the progress. description: PZ Marketplace - Global Economic System Tired of risky hand-to-hand trading? Ready to build a real economy on your server? PZ Marketplace GES adds a fully functional, secure, and synchronized global trading system accessible through in-game computers. Build a thriving server economy without the fear of scammers, dupes, or database wipes. Features for Players Global Trading Network: Buy, sell, and browse items using any working computer in the world. Virtual Bank: Deposit cash into a secure virtual bank account and withdraw it whenever you need it. Smart UI and Filters: Stylish OS-style interface. Search items by name, filter by category, or set minimum/maximum price limits. The contract system: Post your tasks for other players or complete other players' contracts to earn in-game currency. Sales history: The ability to view who bought your product and when, and how much money you received for it. Delivery system: More immersion! The items will not arrive immediately in your inventory, but after the appointed time. Accurate Condition Tracking: The system correctly reads and displays the condition (durability) of weapons, tools, and clothing in percentages (%). Offline Protection ("Mailbox" system): If an admin wipes the market or someone returns an item while you are offline, your items won't disappear! They will be safely stored in a hidden queue and automatically added to your inventory the next time you log into the server. Features for Server Admins (Zero-Desync Architecture) This mod was built from scratch specifically for Build 42+ Multiplayer, focusing on extreme database safety and anti-dupe mechanics. Bulletproof Anti-Dupe: Strict server-side validation prevents quantity mismatches (e.g., duping nails, ammo or liquids in containers). Items are verified by their unique IDs before any transaction. Built-in Transaction Logs: Every single action (Create, Purchase, Cancel, Deposit, Withdraw) is logged. Admins can view the last 100 transactions via a secret in-game Log Panel (color-coded for convenience). A permanent log is also saved to the "Lua/MarketplaceTransactions.txt" file on the server. In-game Admin Panel: Players with administrator access receive secret buttons in the interface that allow them to view logs, safely clear the market, or configure the server in real time (Tax, Lot Limits, Custom currency, delivery time) without leaving the game. Economy Control & Custom Currency: Easily change the default Base.Money to any item (e.g., Gold, Diamonds) via the Admin Panel. Safety feature: changing the currency automatically wipes existing virtual balances to prevent inflation exploits. Virtual balances also track down to the cent to prevent rounding losses on cheap items. roadmap (currently in development) Mailbox: I plan to add a mailbox to which the purchased product will arrive. It will be located in the construction menu and will be linked to a specific player. ATM: Adding ATM crafting capability. replenishment and withdrawal of cash will be available only through it. How it Works Find any computer terminal in the game (e.g., in offices or banks). Ensure the building has electricity (from the grid or a generator). Right-click on the computer and select "PZ Marketplace". Deposit money into your account, list your loot for sale, and start earning! Technical Details Game Version: Project Zomboid Build 42.14.0+ Multiplayer: 100% compatible Performance: Highly optimized. Uses a "Fat Client" UI approach with server-side limit checks, ensuring zero impact on server FPS even during active trading. description: Currently working on: B41 and B42.16.1 SP/MP Updates Update 1.4 Fixed Safety button white background when sidebar is hidden Safety button now shows when toggling PVP (G key) in multiplayer Update 1.3 Added animation speed option for sidebar transitions Improved internal code for better stability and compatibility with other mods Update 1.2 Added animation support for borders and text colors on non-vanilla custom buttons Added option to enable or disable Minimal Sidebar in the options menu Furniture button now remains visible and opaque while the tool is active (Pick Up, Place, etc.), even when the sidebar is hidden Update 1.1 Mod added to B41 version Added smooth fade-in/out animations for the sidebar and hand slots Heart icon now briefly appears when taking damage (pulsating) and fades out smoothly afterwards Added Show Heart on Pulse option in Mod Options (Default: Disabled) Mod Description Minimal Sidebar keeps your interface clean and immersive by automatically hiding sidebar shortcuts when they are not in use. When hovering over the sidebar, all shortcuts become visible again. If an item is equipped, it remains visible as a floating icon, ensuring quick access without cluttering the screen. Features Automatically hides sidebar shortcuts when not hovering Equipped item remains visible as a floating icon Clean and minimalist UI No gameplay impact FAQ The pulsing heart icon does not appear when taking damage. What can I do? A: By default, the animation stays invisible when the panel is not visible. However, you can enable it in the mod options tab. If you are using B41, Mod Options B41 is required to enable it. The animation looks slow or laggy. What can I do? A: Increase the UI FPS. The higher the UI FPS, the smoother the animation will be. It is not hiding automatically. What could be causing this? A: I recommend checking if there are other mods overriding the game side panel. Try changing the load order and, if it still does not work, it is likely an incompatibility with another mod that is overriding a crucial function used by this mod, which is ISEquippedItem. For Modders Minimal Sidebar hooks into ISEquippedItem and automatically applies fade-in/out and opacity logic to its child elements. Any UI element added as a child of ISEquippedItem will automatically follow the sidebar visibility state. Supported UI types are ISButton and ISImage. No custom fade or visibility logic is required from other mods. If you override a custom render function, you must respect the alpha values controlled by Minimal Sidebar, such as textureColor.a, backgroundColor.a, borderColor.a, and textColor.a. This system is designed to be safe and compatible with other UI mods, as long as they do not override ISEquippedItem. Example require "ISUI/ISEquippedItem" local original_createChildren = ISEquippedItem.createChildren function ISEquippedItem:createChildren() original_createChildren(self) local myButton = ISButton:new(0, 50, 20, 20, "X", self, nil) myButton:initialise() myButton:instantiate() -- Critical: ensure the Type is set myButton.Type = "ISButton" -- Add as child so Minimal Sidebar can control visibility self:addChild(myButton) end Workshop ID: 3642084851 Mod ID: MinimalSidebar Workshop ID: 3642084851 Mod ID: MinimalSidebar
