description: Industrial Distillery & Biofuel System A complete industrial-style liquid production system for Project Zomboid focused on: Fermentation Distillation Vanilla alcohol production Ethanol creation Biofuel refining Oils Vinegar Liquid storage and transport This mod expands survival progression by introducing a full production pipeline using unused vanilla world objects such as presses, barrels, stills, industrial tanks, and distillery equipment. Vanilla Alcohol Production The system allows players to produce vanilla alcoholic beverages: Whiskey Beer Gin Scotch Wine Brandy Champagne Cider Vermouth Players can also produce: Distilled Liquor Ethanol Biofuel (Bioethanol) Vegetable Oils Vinegar How The System Works 1. Pressing Stage The Press is the main workstation used to process raw ingredients into fermentable mash. You can create: Fruit Mash Grain Mash Corn Mash Potato Mash Sugar Water Vegetable Oils Ingredients require water and must be processed using valid liquid containers such as buckets. Vegetable oils can also be created using: Dried Sunflower Heads Olives 2. Barrel Fermentation After creating mash, liquids must be stored inside fermentation barrels. Available barrel capacities: Single Barrel → 100 Liters Double Barrel → 200 Liters To start fermentation, players must add: Vanilla Yeast or Fermentation Starter (new item) Fermentation takes: 48 in-game hours Mixing different mash types inside the same barrel will contaminate the process. Contaminated fermentation produces: Distilled Liquor Distilled Liquor can still be consumed or used later to produce Ethanol. 3. Distillation Stage Fermented liquids must be transferred into the Still. Still capacity: 60 Liters To begin distillation, the Still requires: A fire source Lighter Matches etc Fuel Logs Wood Charcoal etc Fermented liquid Distillation duration: 6 in-game hours After distillation is complete, players can select the final alcohol type through the contextual menu depending on the fermented liquid used. Each liquid type produces different vanilla alcohols. How to produce vinegar After producing wine, it is necessary to store it in a single or double barrel. Use the context menu to start the acetic fermentation process with the context menu. The process lasts 4 days of fermentation. It is not necessary to add yeast. As the days go by, you will be able to withdraw the vinegar stored in the barrels. 4. Ethanol Production Distilled Liquor can be distilled again using the same process to create: Ethanol This second distillation also requires: Fire source Fuel 6 in-game hours Each distillation stage reduces the final liquid yield. 5. Biofuel Refining Ethanol can be stored inside industrial tanks to begin the refining process. To create Biofuel, players must combine: Ethanol Vanilla Oils Sunflower Oil Olive Oil The refining process is immediate and does not require waiting. Final product: Biofuel (Bioethanol) Liquid Transport System All liquids must be physically transported using acceptable liquid containers and buckets. This includes: Mash transfer Fermented liquid transport Distilled alcohol movement Oil transport Fuel handling Features Uses vanilla world objects and distillery equipment Full fermentation and distillation pipeline Vanilla alcohol production Industrial liquid storage Contamination system Oil production system Ethanol refining Biofuel production Immersive multi-stage crafting Singleplayer and Multiplayer support Important Notes Different liquids can be mixed in the same barrel but the content becomes contaminated, which produces only base distilled alcohol when distilled. description: Gunworks Framework This is a library mod that simplifies the process of adding features to weapon mods. By itself, this mod does not change the game. For End Users Subscribe to this mod only if another mod lists it as a required dependency. For Modders What sets this framework apart is its focus on making weapons modular platforms for ammo, magazines, and attachments instead of forcing each weapon to use rigid, exact parts and ammunition types. Current Systems Ammunition system for weapons and magazines that can use more than one ammo type, with optional stat changes per load. Animation system for weapon cycling, racking, and extra ammo-count visuals. Bayonet system for both attachable bayonets and built-in bayonets. Custom stats attachment system so installed parts can modify weapon stats while attached. Dynamic attachments system for parts that swap between two states, such as folded and deployed variants. Folding bipod system with optional stat and visual changes between folded and deployed states. Folding stock system with optional stat and visual changes between folded and deployed states. Magazine system for assigning multiple compatible magazines or speed-loaders to the same weapon family. Prevent removal system for permanent or non-removable weapon parts. Railing system for defining which accessories a rail accepts, plus weapon-specific exclusions. Rate of fire system for custom RPM, burst settings, and optional spread tuning. Stats factory helpers for setting, scaling, and adjusting weapon stats across the framework. Underbarrel system for grenade launchers, shotguns, and other alternate weapon modes. Universal attachment system for generic kits that install different real parts depending on the weapon. Upgrade exclusives system for blocking incompatible upgrades from being installed together. Explosives system for throwable explosives and explosive ammo with custom arcs and detonation behavior. Distribution functions for adding, removing, and tuning weapons, parts, and ammo in loot tables. Coming Soon Custom animations with visible magazines during the animation process Hip firing, dual wielding, and firing while running Further improvements to the explosives system To add these systems to your mod, read the API docs included in the mod files for setup details and examples. description: Post-Soviet Armory for Build 42 is the continuation of the original PSA project by Lemes and Bigman for Build 41, rebuilt and expanded for the new era of the game. Most of the mod was reworked from the ground up. Code, balancing, weapon handling, and progression were redesigned with one goal in mind: making every firearm feel believable, distinct, and grounded in reality. PSA adds more than 140 weapons and items from the post-Soviet world before 1993, organized into immersive and logical tiers. Every weapon has its place. A worn Makarov will not perform like a modern OTs Kobalt. Fold a stock and you gain mobility at the cost of control. Cut down a barrel and recoil becomes harder to manage. Every advantage comes with a trade-off. Several new systems were developed specifically for PSA. Bayonets can be mounted for proper close combat. Foldable stocks can be switched on the fly. Suppressors were redesigned to behave more realistically. They reduce noise, but they do not make firearms silent. The overall direction of PSA is realism first. Firearms are loud, recoil matters, and suppressors only reduce noise instead of turning weapons silent. Attachments are limited to weapons that realistically support them, and every firearm was balanced around believable handling and performance rather than arcade gameplay. PSA is built to make weapons feel authentic within the limits of Project Zomboid. Thats it for the introduction. Use the information wisely, comrades. Works with vanilla-style weapon mods. If vanilla guns/ammo are not disabled in sandbox settings, PSA runs alongside them, otherwise it functions as a fully standalone arsenal. English, German (In Progress), and Russian Polish, thanks to Zxy Can the mod be added mid-save? Yes. Is it compatible with other gun mods? PSA should work with most gun mods as long as they do not modify core vanilla firearm logic. The mod is designed as a standalone system and can generally run alongside other weapon packs. Keep in mind that loot spawn chances will be shared across all installed firearm mods. Does it work in MP? Yes Huge shoutout to the guys who originally created P.S.A Post-Soviet Armory Mod Lemes for being an absolute unit and creating all 3D models and a ton of other assets. Bigman for providing the B41 codebase and helping with some code model and code related stuff. Odz for bringing me into the project and doing a lot of icons and other design things. description: 2026.06.07: Version 1.6.2 deployed Katana can now additionally be carried on the back Wakizashi can now additionally be carried on the belt (left/right) Replica Katana can now be attached to replica scabbards and authentic saya Added option to toggle and adjust duration of dulling warnings 2026.05.23: Version 1.6 deployed - see changelog or comment section for a list of additions The Motivation behind NIHONTŌ I created this mod to address several issues with the vanilla Katana and the Long Blade skill: Rarity: The vanilla Katana is a unicorn on default settings. It is entirely possible to loot the entire map and never find a single one. Condition: Even if you are lucky enough to find one, it has the longevity of a glass ornament. It will break when a zombie looks at it the wrong way. Repair: In the vanilla game, you cannot sharpen them. Crafting: Vanilla blade crafting feels more like a chore than progression. Welding together scrap swords that break almost instantly or progressing to a master-level blacksmith only to craft slightly better swords didn't feel right. Lack of Variety: Progression & Gameplay What started as a personal fix evolved into a passion project. While the default settings reflect my own preferences, I have added Sandbox Options to accommodate different playstyles, with more configuration options coming in the future. In the current version, you can hunt for high-end Katanas for end-game mayhem. However, until you find or forge one, you can hone your skills with lower-tier variants. These are easier to craft, spawn more frequently in low-tier locations, and bridge the gap in your skill progression. Current Weapons & Features A standalone, immersive overhaul for Japanese bladed weapons, specifically designed for Build 42. ⚔️ Weapons Bokutō – Hand-carved wooden training sword. Your starting point. Decorative Katana – Aluminum wall-hanger. Better than nothing. Scrap Katana – Forged from scrap metal. Rough but functional. Replica Katana & Wakizashi – Iron blades, Mall Ninja grade. Found in pawn shops and schools. Nihontō Katana – Authentic steel. The endgame blade. Nihontō Wakizashi – The shorter companion blade. Tantō – A compact dagger for close quarters. Nagamaki – A long-handled blade/spear hybrid for reach and power. Ōdachi – A massive great sword. Slow, devastating. 🗡️ Customization Modular Crafting: Every part – Blade (Tōshin), Guard (Tsuba), Hilt (Tsuka) – is a separate, interchangeable component. Hilt Colors: 9 Tsuka color variants for Katana and Wakizashi. Replica Scabbards: A single dyeable Saya per weapon – color it any way you like. Authentic Saya: 15 historically accurate Urushi-lacquered and natural wood Shirasaya variants. description: Tired of single-click building? Queue up multiple placements while one is still in progress. A complete off-grid solar energy system for Project Zomboid Build 42: solar panels, battery banks, a Solar Computer to manage your devices, and a failsafe backup generator relay. Solo & Multiplayer (Host/Coop and Dedicated Server). 🔋 How It Works Place a Power Bank inside your base and connect solar panels to it. The bank charges during the day and powers every vanilla appliance in the whole building — lights, fridges, freezers, TVs — like a generator, without the noise or fuel. At night or under clouds, the stored energy keeps everything running. When the bank runs dry, an optional Solar Failsafe kicks in your vanilla generator automatically. Multiple banks can be linked into a shared network. 🖥️ Solar Computer Link a vanilla Desktop Computer to your network (place it next to a Power Bank, connect via the context menu) to manage every electrical device in the building. The Device Management panel groups devices by type (Lights, Wall Switches, TV, Radio, Washer, Dryer, Fridges, Freezers) with real-time consumption in Ah/day. Enable / Disable individual devices or whole groups — changes take effect instantly. Switching a fridge or freezer off cuts its power draw and stops it chilling food. (Ambient ceiling lighting is shown for info only; it’s managed by the building’s tile system.) 📦 Items Solar Panels — Flat (ground/roof, max exposure), Wall (N or W facing), Mounted (angled floor stand). All crafted from the raw Solar Panel component. Power Bank — The heart of the system. Stores energy, powers the whole building, accepts PSR batteries, and links into shared networks. Batteries — 200Ah / 400Ah (loot), Wired Car Battery (any car battery rewired; quality scales with your Electricity skill), Improvised Battery (crafted from scrap — renewable), DIY Battery (several batteries combined into one higher-capacity unit). Inverter — required component to build the Power Bank. Solar Failsafe — placed on a vanilla generator; auto-starts when the bank can’t keep up with demand, auto-stops when it recovers. One Solar Failsafe is enough for a linked battery network — a second generator won’t charge your banks any faster. New Advancements: Energy From The Sun — skill magazine teaching all PSR recipes. description: Computer Mod A Project Zomboid mod that turns useless computers into fully functional machines. About This Mod Computers in Project Zomboid usually do not do much besides being dismantled. This mod changes that. Computer Mod adds usable computers with their own operating system. You can install an OS, set passwords, browse websites, download and install games, read magazines and newspapers, watch video files, use apps, burn CDs, store files, and communicate with other players. Features Playable Games There are currently 17 playable games. Some computers may already have games installed, while others may have none. Games can be installed in two ways: Game CDs: Find a game CD, insert it into a computer, and install it through My Files. Internet downloads: Open the browser, visit knoxshare.bbs, download a game, then install it from the Downloads folder. Downloads take time. You do not need to stay next to the computer while downloading, but shutting the computer down will cancel the download. Playing games reduces boredom, stress, and sadness. Losing a game slightly increases stress. Applications A fresh OS includes My Files, Notepad, Browser, Paint, Calculator, Mail, Board, Chat, Market, Settings, and Music Player. Mail: Create an account, log in from different computers, send mail, reply, and delete messages. Board: Post public messages that other players with computers can read. Chat: Create an account, send requests, and privately message other players. Market: Create a market account, buy rotating shop items, and complete jobs for money. Shop items and jobs refresh over time and are shared across computers on the server. Paint: Draw simple images and save them as desktop files. Folder, File and CD System Computers now have a more functional file system. You can create folders, rename them, delete them, move files, restore files from Trash, and organize your desktop. Folders can contain notes, paint files, magazines, newspapers, video files, and other readable or downloadable files. Blank CDs can be found in the world. CDs can be opened from My Files, renamed, wiped, used to store files, or used to burn installed games. Removed CDs keep their name and stored content. Applications cannot be copied into folders or CDs, but files can. Magazines, Newspapers and Videos Computers found in the world may contain recipe magazines, newspapers, or video files. Reading or watching them takes time and can affect your character. Recipe magazines can teach the same things as their physical versions. Some hidden websites also allow you to download magazines or videos. Hidden site addresses may be found naturally inside notes or emails. Passwords, BIOS and OS Installation Some computers may be password protected. There are three ways to access them: Know the password. Reset the disk from BIOS. Use a Password Hack CD. To hack a password, insert a Password Hack CD and start the hacking process from the login screen. Complete the mini-game to remove the password. By default, hacking requires Electrical level 1. Warning: Resetting the disk deletes the operating system and local data. If a computer has no OS, it cannot boot normally. Find a PZ OS 3.1 CD, insert it, enter BIOS during boot, and install the operating system from the CD. Internet Outage System Internet access can be affected by world power. If the power grid goes down, the internet backbone can go offline depending on sandbox settings. To restore the network, players must find special relay terminals around the map and repair them with Electrical skill and electronic parts. If relay power is required, the active relay must keep receiving electricity, such as from a generator. If that generator runs out of fuel, the network can go offline again. This system can be adjusted or disabled in sandbox options. Terminal Locations Customization You can change the computer name, profile picture, password, desktop background color, date format, clock format, and file layout. Desktop icons and folders can be moved on a grid. Translations The mod includes translation files for: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Danish, Dutch, Hungarian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Brazilian Portuguese, Finnish, Korean, Thai, Traditional Chinese, and Ukrainian. Early Access Notice This mod is still growing. It became much bigger than I originally expected, and I am developing and testing it mostly alone. The mod is playable, but more features and improvements may be added over time. Editing the files and distributing them through Discord, modpacks, private server packs, or any other platform without permission is not allowed. For compatibility patches, translations, server-specific edits, or addons based on this mod, please contact me first. Unauthorized edits or reuploads may be reported. When each map chunk loads, the mod applies its generators procedurally: vegetation (trees, bushes, grass, vines), structural decay (cracks, burned walls, broken doors and windows, bent fences), trash, and barricades. Uses a persistent chunk cache to skip already-visited areas and a batched dispatcher to avoid lag spikes. Full Sandbox Customization: Every element can be tuned, enabled, or disabled. ⚡ Performance Notice ⚠️ IMPORTANT: This mod significantly alters the world generation and adds a large amount of objects to every loaded chunk. As a result, it may negatively impact performance on lower-end systems. This is completely normal due to how Project Zomboid handles object rendering and is not a bug. 🕐 First Load: It is completely normal to experience some lag during the first few seconds after loading into the world, as vegetation and objects are being generated across all visible chunks. description: This mod expands the medical side of Project Zomboid with new diseases, symptoms, treatments, diagnostic tools, blood-related mechanics, medical knowledge progression, and a more punishing survival experience. Project Zomboid health is often simple enough: patch the wound, disinfect it, take some pills, hope the bite was not that bite. This mod makes your character’s body feel more fragile, unpredictable, and dangerous to ignore. A simple fever can become a warning. A dirty wound can become a death sentence. A corpse-filled room can be more dangerous than it looks. Surviving the apocalypse is hard enough. Surviving your own immune system is where things get interesting. 🖥️EHR Health Monitoring New health monitoring UI with disease information, active medication and body status. To open new health panel press H (can be configured in Mod Options, not sandbox) Vanilla health panel still can be used, check mod options to configure what your primary health panel will be. EHR panel opens in compact mode by default, you can change that in mod options as well The mod adds a wide range of new illnesses and medical conditions designed to fit naturally into Project Zomboid’s survival loop. Diseases can be caused by wounds, corpses, contaminated food or water, poor conditions, temperature exposure, toxins, infection, untreated injuries, mental and other survival-related risks Some illnesses are mild and manageable. Others can slowly spiral out of control if ignored. Symptoms may overlap, making diagnosis less obvious and forcing the player to pay attention instead of treating every problem like “just take antibiotics.” List of current diseases: -Food Poisoning -Gastroenteritis -Trichinosis -Toxin Poisoning -Putrefaction -Cadaveric Aspergillosis -Wound Infection -Sepsis -Tetanus -Concussion -Hyperkeratotic Scabies -Dysentery -Heat Exhaustion -Heat Stroke -Common Cold -Pneumonia -AHTR -Delirium -Insomnia -Cellulitis Extensive Health Rework Evolved adds new medical items, medicines, tests, and treatment tools. Some treatments are designed for specific conditions. Others may reduce symptoms, slow disease progression, or help recovery. Using the wrong treatment may be useless, risky, or simply a waste of supplies. The mod introduces more detailed medication behavior. Different medicines can affect different symptoms and conditions. Some may help reduce fatigue, endurance penalties, infection risks, or specific disease effects. Medication can have active states, doses, side effects, durations, and condition-specific usefulness. The goal is to make treatment feel more intentional instead of turning every illness into a one-button fix. Some medication can be found in houses, more advanced in clinics and hospitals, and top tier experimental ones in secret research facility and military bases. New Medical Crafting New recipes to make survival in wilderness more manageable but it will not replace clinical items. Medicinal Plant Search Players with enough medical and foraging knowledge or read the special flyer can inspect suitable bushes for useful plants. Search spots are hidden at first, so you must identify promising signs by hand. Some spots may hide thorns and can scratch your hands unless you wear intact gloves. Hive & Spiderweb Search Some trees may contain honeycomb or spiderwebs. Not every tree is useful, and inspected trees cannot be searched again for some time. Move your hand carefully through the tree area, avoiding bees and spiders. Collected honeycomb and spiderwebs are used in medical crafting. The mod expands blood-related gameplay with new mechanics connected to blood loss, blood types, transfusions, and dangerous complications. Blood is no longer just red decoration on your shirt after missing one fence swing. Blood level can be tracked by new special medical watches 🪡New Suturing minigame Vanilla suturing system is really forgiving and does not require player skill or medical skill practically at all. New suturing system adds depths to this mechanic and respect your character's first aid skills. If your suture is not good enough, there is a 40% chance of triggering cellulitis that if untreated will give severe complications. So keep your hands steady and don't rush(unless you bleeding to death and running from zombies. Then cellulitis is the least of your problems) The more First Aid you have the easier it's become (Can be turned off in sandbox settings, but why?) 📻The mod includes atmospheric radio content connected to health, survival, and the collapse of the world. A daily broadcast on 47.0 Mhz features Amelie Crowe, a radio host whose story progresses over time. Her transmissions may include medical advice, survival warnings and personal reflections 9 AM – medical advises which gives small first aid xp 3 PM – Storry progression 9 PM – Useful knowledge of different diseases The broadcast is intended to add atmosphere, worldbuilding, and a sense that someone out there is still trying to explain the end of everything — badly, beautifully, and probably while running out of supplies. 👩‍⚕️ A new perk with unique skill EHR surgeon gives you First Aid 10, special perk that works with scalpel and full knowledge of all diseases 📑Diagnosis and Medical Knowledge Not every condition is immediately obvious. Press J to open handbook and see what knowledge you have about diseases The mod gives more value to medical skill, books, and proper diagnosis. Some diseases may share similar symptoms, and the player may need specific knowledge or tools to better understand what is happening. Specialized medical flyers can help the character identify illnesses, understand symptoms, and choose the correct treatment. Medical knowledge matters now. Because “I think it’s probably fine” is a classic final sentence. ⚙️Combability ✅Antibodies ✅Mini Health Panel (A bit overlap for now) ✅Red Days ✅Raven Creek (medicine spawns fine) ✅Lifestyle: Hobbies (Some diseases have interactions) ✅Unseasonal Weather ✅Realistic Temperature (disables body temp from RT) ⛔Other health reworks What build? Does it work in MP B42.19 seems work fine Works on B42.18 (may work on B42.17) MP should work now (some minor bugs will definitely present, please report if you encounter one) For admins if you need heal specific player use this command - /ehrfullheal PlayerName ❗Mod is in active development so it's good idea to backup your saves My Other Mods: Cut That Tree! description: Required Dependency Toxic Sky is required for this mod to function properly. It Came Without Warning You heard rumors about them. And it seems they were true. The Monoliths are anomalous structures that appeared during the Knox Infection and seem to share a mysterious connection with the infected. But that’s not all. Each Monolith emits its own hazardous zone capable of taking a heavy toll on survivors — though the zones themselves do not directly kill. Gas masks and SCBA equipment have proven useful when dealing with prolonged exposure. Some survivors even claim that destroyed Monoliths leave behind valuable loot, indispensable for those willing to take the risk. And as if that weren’t enough, many report strange radio transmissions originating from the Monoliths themselves. Which only makes it easier to find them — and destroy them. A Brief Overview Toxic Sky Anomalies adds randomly spawning Monoliths that permanently persist on the map until destroyed. As usual, the mod includes extensive sandbox and configuration options. Use the vanilla Project Zomboid military tracking system found in Military Walkies and Military HAM Radios to determine the radio distance to anomaly targets. Each Monolith transmits on two frequencies: 11.2 MHz — a strong long-range signal transmitted twice per day across the region 11.4 MHz — a more active short-range signal intended for nearby survivors The Monoliths function as stationary anomaly bosses that continuously spawn waves until destroyed. Survivors who manage to overcome them may be rewarded with valuable loot. The system uses Toxic Sky core logic, meaning every Monolith creates a Hazard Zone with unique environmental dangers. However, these zones only deal indirect damage. You will not be instantly poisoned or continuously lose health — though there are plenty of other ways for the anomalies to make your life miserable. A unique VHS tape can also be discovered through event drops in both SP and MP. It contains radio frequencies and fragments of lore surrounding the Monoliths. They are also fully compatible with MP and SP. Otherwise, the new hazard zones are fully compatible with the Toxic Sky ZoneUI and can be placed and controlled by admins directly via the TS ZoneUI. Mods that gives you a different TSA experience: Toxic Sky Anomalies (Guns of Marz add-on) - by IronLungs (Thanks dude!) Q&A Question: I don´t see any monoliths appearing - what am I doing wrong? Answer: Monoliths have the same gate protection as Toxic Sky. Only when Water and Power is shutdown, the Event-Manager will start it´s work. Mods that manipulate Water&Power (Let you restore it) can interfere with that state. Best solution is to switch off the condition in the mod options! Question: Dude, I hear them on the radio with weird messages mixed in! But I can´t find them?! Answer: Monoliths transmit on two radio frequencies: 11.2 and 11.4. On 11.2, a strong, map-wide signal is transmitted twice a day, which can be detected using military walkie-talkies and military radios (the rangefinder from Project Zomboid) – this allows you to determine the distance to the source. 11.4 is a weaker signal with a range of up to around 2,000 metres and transmits every 30–40 minutes. This signal can also be tracked, but you need to be much closer to the source to get a clear reading. The frequencies are fixed and do not change. Finding them can be part of the challenge! And they do even send out RP valuable bits and snippets :3 Question: Help, weird stuff happens with my character and I see strange colors around my screen Answer: Congrats, you found a monolith zone. Each zone has it´s own hazard specific effect. Gasmasks work fine if a monolith is still young, but they loose effectivness the older it gets. Question: Dude, I pumped 5 magazines into the monolith and nothing happens?! This is broken! Answer: Technically - no. Monoliths are bulletproof by design. If you want to take them down, you have to get up close and personal. Two-handed weapons deal significantly more damage than one-handed weapons, so if you try to stab it to death with a knife... be prepared. That may take a LONG while! Question: What do you mean - the OLDER IT GETS? Answer: Haha, Monoliths can mature if you don´t take them out. If they are fully matured, they will drop more loot (Usealy 4-5 days) but their zone effect will grow stronger and only a SCBA gear will protect you fully then. Question: I got a ton of beans from my monolith kill and some aviator shades - wtf Answer: Yeah well I did try to keep the loot table as usefull as possible - but sometimes you can be unlucky. You find the loot table under TSA_LootTables.lua and can adjust the items, and the weights of common, uncommon and rare items. Question: I want to use this for my server! Will the Monoliths spawn in Johns bedroom?! Answer: It depends. TSA uses, like TS itself now, a native recognition of Project Zomboids Safehouse System in Multiplayer. If you use that, you are fine. The Event Manager will not place monoliths in your living room or garden. But I cannot guarantee that it might, some day, spawn in such a way that a town is partialy disrupted by it´s vicinity. Doing a automated spawn system is hard enough, and I never intended it to work with MP. I tried my best to guardrail it. Question: How do I place that as an Admin/GM/Mod on my server? Answer: Easy! Use the Toxic Sky Zone Panel - It´s a button in your admin tools, clearly labeled. If the button isn´t there, well, then another mod has overwritten it. Use the chat command /ts zoneui or /ts panel instead. it will open the pannel. TSA is a addon for TS, so it loads nativly into the Zone UI and can be choosed from the dropdowns. Question: OH GOD WILL THE MONOLITHS SPAWN THE ENTIRE WORLD?! Answer: No, there can only be 10 Monoliths active, at any given time - but you can adjust it in the mod options / sandbox options Question: I want the Monoliths to drop more and I want bigger waves and I also want them to spawn each hour! And no damn sprinters! Answer: Thats...not a question. But fear not, you can adjust all of that in the mod options / sandbox options. A personal note “Toxic Sky Anomalies” is actually my labour of love when it comes to mods. I’ve always been a big fan of titles like “Into the Radius”, “Stalker” and “SCP Universe”. That’s where the idea for the anomalies with the monoliths came from. Although they weren’t monoliths from the start. Initially, I had some spectacular ideas involving particle fountains and the like, but this proved problematic with the pipeline I had available – no real shader manipulation without interfering with the world’s graphics pipeline. And unfortunately, that isn’t possible without a Java mod. I don’t intend to ever do that in Java either, but depending on how things develop, that might change in the future. Thanks for playing! You may modify or expand the mod for personal or server use. If you publish edits or derivative versions, please credit Toxic Sky Anomalies or Toxic Sky and mention the original author. Reuploads of the mod itself without modification are discouraged. If you want to build upon the project, please provide proper credit. Thank you — and enjoy the hunt for the Monoliths in Toxic Sky Anomalies. Workshop ID: 3726591479 Mod ID: TSAnomalies

Maybe it gives your base a new fuel reserve. Maybe it is just another gamble in a world that already hates you. ⭐ What does it add to your world? - Useful Exploration: Search industrial, military, and crafted barrels for resources instead of walking past decoration. - Emergency Water: Drink from water barrels when thirst becomes a problem. - Hygiene Anywhere: Wash yourself, clothes, and washable items using barrel water. - Liquid Storage: Pour compatible liquids into barrels or fill containers from them. - More Modded Logistics: Supported mods like Water Bidons and DamnLib/USMIL integrate their containers with barrel transfers. - Barrel-to-Barrel Transfer: Move liquid directly between nearby opened barrels for cleaner base organization. - Generator Refueling: Refuel nearby generators from gasoline barrels through the Barrel menu or the generator Add Fuel menu. - Progressive Emptying: Drain unwanted contents over time; if you stop halfway, the drained amount stays drained. - Base Logistics: Pick up, move, and place opened barrels while preserving their contents and dynamic weight. - Scavenger Tools: Crowbars, screwdrivers, funnels, hoses, and similar tools give barrel use a grounded survival feel. - Sandbox Tuning: Adjust barrel capacity, empty weight, interaction distance, opening tools, transfer tool requirements, and liquid spawn weights by barrel type. - Admin / Debug Panel: Authorized admins can inspect barrels, repair/reconcile state, reveal or initialize contents, empty them, set liquids, or reroll loot from the Barrel menu. - Solo and Multiplayer: Works for singleplayer runs and multiplayer bases. 🧰 Current liquids and tools - Liquids: Water, Tainted Water, Gasoline, Bleach, and Empty barrels. - Open tools: Crowbar, Forged Crowbar, Screwdriver, Pipe Wrench, or Sheet Metal Snips. - Transfer tools: Funnel to pour into barrels, Rubber Hose to fill containers from barrels or refuel generators. - Optional Mod Support: Supported container mods work with bidirectional barrel liquid transfers. 🌐 Translations Current translations: - English - Spanish - Argentinian Spanish Community translation help is more than welcome. If you want to help bring Barrels Expanded to another language or improve an existing translation, suggestions and contributions are greatly appreciated. 🔮 Future ideas These features are not in yet, but they are the kind of additions planned for future versions: - Add more rare liquid discoveries, such as milk or wine barrels in store buildings. - Add labels or ownership markers for multiplayer storage. - Add water treatment interactions for making tainted water safer. - Use a rubber hose to transfer water from pressurized sinks or bathtubs into barrels before the water shuts off, or much more slowly afterward if supported. - Cut open barrel tops with a propane torch and repurpose them as rain and snow collectors, including snow melting into water. - Refuel vehicles directly from gasoline barrels. - Pump gasoline from fuel stations directly into barrels. - Add plumbing-style water supply from nearby or elevated barrels to sinks, bathtubs, and washing machines. - Add barrel condition risks such as rust, damage, leaks, contamination, or reliability problems. 🧩 Compatibility - Game Version: Project Zomboid Build 42. - Supported Modes: Singleplayer and Multiplayer. In multiplayer, both client and server must enable the mod. - Safe Install: Designed to work with ongoing saves. Always back up your save before enabling or removing mods. Supported optional mods: - Water Bidons: bidons can pour into barrels and be filled from barrels. - DamnLib/USMIL: military gas and water cans work with barrel liquid transfers. ❓ Save FAQ Can I add it to an existing save? Yes. World barrels become interactive as you explore and load the map, no new world required. What happens if I remove it later? The mod adds no custom maps or mandatory new items. If disabled, barrels go back to being decoration. To avoid inventory oddities, place down any barrels you are carrying before disabling it. ✨ Special Mention This project was born after discovering [B42] Useful Barrels. Huge thanks to its creator for the original spark; it made me look at Project Zomboid's barrels and realize they could do much more. 🤝 Contributing You can help Barrels Expanded by opening bug reports, suggesting improvements, testing multiplayer behavior, improving translations, updating documentation, or sending pull requests Pull requests are welcome through the GitHub repository: https://github.com/nonaje/BarrelsExpanded Please do not submit copied Project Zomboid code, copied game assets, copied content from other mods, malicious code, obfuscated code, or large rewrites without opening a discussion thread first. 📋 Mod Info Workshop ID: 3727387302 Mod ID: BarrelsExpanded42 Workshop ID: 3727387302 Mod ID: BarrelsExpanded42

description: If the vehicles on your street are looking absolutely chopped, it is time to open a chop shop. Dismantle those clapped cars for spare parts and scrap metal. No cap, it is the best way to clean up the map. Multiplayer compatible. Safe to add to existing saves. CHOPPED VEHICLE SALVAGE This simple mod expands the vanilla wrecked vehicle dismantling mechanic to include all normal vehicles and trailers. While similar mods exist, this mod was born out of frustration with compatibility, or lack there of, these have with popular vehicle claiming and respawn mods. The goal was to make this as lightweight as possible. By relying mostly on base game mechanics and only adding a thin layer on top, this mod maximises compatibility and minimises the chance of breaking during future game updates. HOW IT WORKS Vehicles can be salvaged using a welding mask and a propane torch. Doing so destroys the vehicle, yields metalworking materials, and optionally recovers installed parts. Welding skill level 3 or higher is required to salvage normal vehicles or trailers (configurable in sandbox options). Higher Welding levels yield more materials upon dismantling. Normal vehicles take 2x as long to dismantle as burnt wrecks (configurable in sandbox options). Higher Welding levels increase dismantling speed. Installed parts drop upon salvage (min/max parts dropped can be configured or disabled in sandbox options). COMPATIBILITY Vehicle salvage action is derived from base game's burnt wreck dismantling, only adding skill requirements, part drops, and claim checks. It should work out of the box with most mods. Another Vehicle Claim System (AVCS) - Claimed vehicles cannot be salvaged. Vehicle Life Cycle Systems (VLCS) - Derives "ISRemoveBurntVehicle", meaning a respawn ticket is created when a vehicle is salvaged. Disable "Allow Scrapping Normal Cars" (AllowScrapNormal = false) in VLCS sandbox settings. Vehicle Repair Overhaul - Disable "Full Vehicle Salvaging" (VRO_EnableFullVehicleSalvaging = false) in VRO sandbox settings if you are using "Vehicle Salvage Overhaul" mod. description: Read and Recall Vanilla skill books in Project Zomboid give you XP just for finishing them. This mod adds an end-of-book check: after every skill-book chapter, you take a short quiz or play a hands-on minigame to KEEP the full XP multiplier. Skip or fail and you only get half the bonus. Ace it and the multiplier is yours. The result: skill books feel like LEARNING, not page-flipping. And every chapter ends in something memorable - drive a nail, read a horse's mood, dope the wind, choose the right quench for a sword, place primal cuts on a beef carcass. 2 versions available Read and Recall (Real-Life) - real-world educational content. Each chapter teaches honest technique: hammer grips, food preservation chemistry, the working-temperature window for steel. Pass the quiz to prove you read it. Read and Recall: Knox Edition - the same skill books reimagined as in-universe Knox County textbooks, with Project Zomboid game mechanics woven into the narrative. Carpenter trait benefits, generator runtimes, the day the grid drops, magazine spawn locations - referenced in-story. The two editions are incompatible. Enable only ONE at a time. How it works Finish reading a vanilla skill book as normal. A Summary screen pops up with a recap of the chapter and two buttons: Take the Test or Skip (Half XP). Pass the test (a quiz or a hands-on minigame, depending on the volume): you keep the full vanilla XP multiplier for that level range. Skip or fail: you get the half multiplier ("floor") so reading is never a total waste. Progress is saved per character per book, so you can come back and re-test later. Features 24 skills supported - every craft, survival, and combat skill that has vanilla books. 120 volumes of content: 72 written quizzes (11 hand-written questions each) and 48 hands-on minigames. Sandbox-tunable: pick the test format, XP curve, and floor reward to match how you want the mod to feel (see below). No XP cheese by default: the maximum multiplier is the vanilla one. Opt-in Bonus mode is available in sandbox if you want above-vanilla XP for acing. Per-character progress stored in ModData. Multiple characters on the same save each track their own claims. Themed UI: each skill has its own colour palette and emblem on the summary/test banner. Sandbox options Four toggles on the New Game settings page (both editions): Test format - keep the mix of minigames and quizzes (default), or convert every minigame slot into a written multiple-choice quiz. Every minigame volume has an alt MC quiz authored - 96 across both editions. XP mode - Default (linear graded curve from floor to vanilla), Lenient (90%+ instantly gives full vanilla XP), or Bonus (90%+ gives ABOVE vanilla XP for the perfectionists). XP bonus multiplier - how much above vanilla the Bonus mode awards. 1.0 to 2.0, default 1.20 (20% above vanilla). Floor percent - XP fraction kept when skipping or failing. 0.0 to 1.0, default 0.5 (half XP). Set to 0.0 if you want no reward for failing. Skill-by-skill book index Every volume listed below either ends in a written Quiz (5 questions drawn from an 11-question pool) or in the named minigame. With sandbox Test format = All Quizzes, every minigame slot becomes a written quiz too. Compatibility Compatible with any mod that does not replace that class wholesale. Singleplayer tested. Multiplayer should work but is currently unverified. No save corruption risk. Known issues / caveats Quizzes draw fresh questions each attempt, but pools are 11 deep per volume - re-reading the same book several times will revisit some questions. PZ's font does not render some Unicode dashes cleanly; all summaries use plain ASCII hyphens by design. Wind direction in Dope the Wind follows hunter convention - "left-to-right wind" means wind moving from your left to your right. Have fun. Read carefully. Pass the test. Also check out my other mods in my collection! Your support is much appreciated! Workshop ID: 3728582856 Mod ID: ReadAndRecall Mod ID: ReadAndRecallKnoxEdition

description: Better Vehicle Dynamics A drivetrain and traction overhaul for Project Zomboid Build 42. Every vehicle gains a torque-curve driven engine, surface- and weather-aware grip, and a stack of optional realism systems - all sandbox-tunable, all multiplayer-safe. What it changes Torque-curve acceleration - engines pull from a real power curve instead of a flat number. Low-end grunt for shoving wrecks, a proper top end. Surface & weather grip - independent traction on sealed road, rain, snow and off-road. Lose the back end if you push it. Tyre-type grip model - worn / standard / modern tyres each get distinct grip per surface, not one flat value. Load affects handling - a heavily loaded vehicle is slow to pull away from a stop, as if the engine is straining against the weight. Strength is a sandbox slider. Load affects fuel - hauling heavy burns extra fuel while driving. Configurable drag - air drag and rolling resistance (road and off-road) are separate, tunable knobs. Reference power & weight (opt-in) - researched HP/mass figures for the vanilla fleet; modded vehicles can register their own. Cargo-capacity rescale - per-body-type storage multipliers instead of one blanket override. Drift mode (opt-in) - hold a bindable key to break the rear loose for an arcade slide. Off by default. Tyre marks - vehicles leave a ground decal when a tyre breaks loose; marks fade out on their own. Vehicle info panel - a docked readout beside the mechanics window showing the active profile, per-surface grip, tyre type and cargo load. Ground-clip guard - a server-side safety net that snaps a vehicle back onto its floor if it ever sinks into the ground (a multiplayer desync class). Only ever acts on an impossible state, so normal driving, ramps and basements are unaffected. Tuning Everything is exposed in Sandbox Options, grouped into Handling, Tyres & Load, Drivetrain and Readout & Misc pages, plus quick tuning presets. Defaults aim for a grounded, readable feel; dial it toward arcade or hardcore to taste. Multiplayer Built for dedicated servers and co-op. Load-sensitive fuel and the ground-clip guard are server-authoritative so they behave consistently for everyone. Installation (players) Better Vehicle Dynamics is split between this Workshop subscription (Lua, sandbox options, UI) and a small one-time Java-side install (the deep physics - engine code Steam Workshop cannot patch). The subscription alone is not enough; do the manual step once and you are set. Tuning, tyre and guard updates after that are pure Workshop updates with no further manual install. Subscribe to this mod and let Steam finish downloading it. Open the mod folder: Steam\steamapps\workshop\content\108600\3728775267\mods\BetterVehicleDynamics\B42.18_Manual_Install\ Copy the zombie sub-folder from there into your Project Zomboid install directory (right-click Project Zomboid in Steam → Manage → Browse local files). Restart Project Zomboid. When Project Zomboid itself updates, recopy the zombie folder to refresh it. Dedicated server hosts Server-side install is the same idea: copy the whole zombie sub-folder from B42.18_Manual_Install\ into your server's <server>/java/zombie/ directory (merge it into the existing tree). It carries the full package layout - physics, world (iso) and texture classes - so copy the entire folder, not just one sub-path. Both the server and every connecting client need the install - a bytecode mismatch between sides will cause vehicle-related packet desync warnings. For modders A public Lua API lets other mods register vehicle reference data, tyre-grip profiles and content packs without touching this mod's files. Full reference: Better Vehicle Dynamics - Public Lua API Compatibility Works alongside vehicle-skin and content mods. Run only one vehicle-physics overhaul at a time. Build 42.18+. Returns to schedule when you walk back into range, even across an on/off boundary. Motion lights are event-driven — they react immediately when someone enters detection range. Optional zombie detection on motion sensors — early-warning porch lights. Server-authoritative — all light state lives on the server, same code path in SP, hosted MP, dedicated MP, and split-screen. Crafting Light Timer (Electrical 1) — salvaged kitchen timer or alarm clock, electronics scrap, electric wire, screws. Screwdriver required. Required Electrical skill — minimum skill to configure a light timer; applies only when Require Timer item is off (default 1, range 0–5). Default ON / OFF time — prefilled in the timer dialog (default 19:00 / 06:00). Catch up on chunk load — reconcile timer lights when their chunk reloads (default on). Motion sensor Motion sensors enabled — toggle for the motion-sensor feature (default on). Off = installed sensors stop reacting and new installs are blocked. Require Motion Sensor item — require a crafted Indoor or Outdoor Motion Sensor installed on a light (default on). Motion Sensor Electrical skill — minimum skill when the item requirement above is off (default 2, range 0–5). Default idle-off minutes — prefilled in the motion-sensor dialog (default 5, range 1–60). description: READ BEFORE ANYTHING !! For Any Bug Report For Any Suggestion Before saying "it's not working", unsuscribe, resuscribe. Then post your bug on discord with you console file "C:\Users\you\Zomboid\console.txt" and you mod list "C:\Users\you\Zomboid\mods\default.txt" => Discord : https://discord.gg/vJay7GQ92B ❄️ Plysken Frost Revolution Turn any small room into an industrial cold storage. Build a Cold Unit, mount it on a wall, power it up, and the room temperature drops. Perishable food kept in containers inside the room stays frozen — indefinitely — as long as the unit has power. The post-apocalypse just got cooler. Solo & Multiplayer (Host/Coop and Dedicated Server). 🔧 How It Works Craft a Cold Unit at Electricity 5, or read the Sub-Zero Solutions magazine to learn the recipe (also auto-learned at Electricity 7). Mount it on a wall — indoors, with a roof above (red cursor otherwise). Any of the 4 walls works. Open the Control Panel (right-click the unit), turn it on and set your target (−30 °C to 0 °C). The room cools down progressively. Food freezes automatically in any container in the room while it sits at or below 0 °C. Animal carcasses hung on a butcher hook are preserved the same way — a ”Frozen by PFR” label appears on the hook window so you know it’s working. It’s smart about the room: several units cool faster, bigger rooms cool slower (the rate scales with the real square footage, so any shape works). Open doors, smashed windows and gaps slow it down — seal your room well. Your character feels the cold inside (vanilla Hypothermia, toggleable). Works in vanilla buildings and in rooms you build yourself. 🖥️ Control Panel Each unit has its own panel: live room temperature, an adjustable target (− / + buttons), and an on/off toggle with smooth startup, ambient hum and shutdown sounds. 📦 Items Cold Unit — wall-mounted cooling unit. Crafted from engine parts, plastic pipes, electronics scrap, sheet metal, scrap metal, electrical wire and screws (Electricity 5). Sub-Zero Solutions: Industrial Cold Storage — magazine that teaches the recipe. Found in the world and in loot crates. ⚙️ Sandbox Options Default target temperature (−30 °C to 0 °C, default −10 °C) Cooling speed multiplier (0.25 to 4.0) Insulation strength (0.0 to 3.0 — set 0 to disable the breach mechanic) Player feels the cold (on/off) Temperature unit — Celsius or Fahrenheit 🤝 Companion Mod (optional) Lua Digital Watch UI by RedChili — when you wear a digital watch, it shows the cold room temperature instead of the outdoor climate. Auto-detected, no setup needed. ⚠️ Engine Limitations Your in-game watch reads the vanilla climate by default — the Control Panel is the source of truth (or install the companion mod above). Items dropped on the floor aren’t frozen — use containers (and butcher hooks for carcasses). 📋 Requirements Project Zomboid Build 42. No other mods required. Safe to add to an existing save — you craft the unit when you’re ready. As with any mod, test on a spare save first; I’m not responsible for conflicts with other mods. 🌍 Translations 16 native languages: EN, FR, DE, ES, IT, PT, PT-BR, NL, RU, UA, CN, CH, JP, KO, AR, TH, PL, TR. Others (CA, CS, DA, FI, HU, ID, NO, PH, RO) fall back to English — contributions welcome via the comments. 🙏 Credits & License Original mod by Plysken. The Cold Unit reuses the vanilla industry_01_4 sprite (Air Conditioner) but is mechanically a brand-new item with its own behavior, sounds and UI. © 2026 Plysken. All rights reserved. description: Realistic Eye Adaptation to Dark You step into a Build 42 room without lights and see nothing. Real eyes don't work that way - and now your character's eyes don't either. This mod simulates real dark adaptation. The first seconds in a pitch-black room, you can't see a thing. Over the next 20 in-game minutes (configurable), your night vision builds up until you can navigate the room. Step into bright daylight afterwards and a brief glare flash washes the screen - your dilated pupils paying the price. Features Gradual dark adaptation - eyes adjust over ~20 in-game minutes Three-zone awareness - outdoor / lit indoor / dark indoor each affect adaptation differently Soft decay, not snap-reset - leaving a dark room doesn't instantly cost you all your adaptation (10 min outdoor, 40 min lit indoor) Glare effect - per-player warm flash when dark-adapted eyes hit bright light, cooldown-gated against door spam Adapted vision moves with you - soft warm ambient light follows your character in dark rooms (singleplayer only - see below) 7 tunable sandbox options - adaptation time, decay rates, brightness cap, trigger sensitivity, glare on/off, glare duration, cooldown Multiplayer The world-light effect is disabled in multiplayer by design - a shared lighting buff would x-ray hiding teammates and break ambush gameplay. Adaptation is still tracked internally so the per-player glare flash still fires on your own screen. Not compatible with Room Light Boost Both mods spawn ambient light; running them together stacks the effect. Pick one: instant boost (RLB) or gradual realism (this mod). Compatibility Project Zomboid Build 42. Safe to add to existing saves. Safe to remove. Türkçe Build 42'de ışıksız bir odaya giriyorsun ve hiçbir şey göremiyorsun. Gerçek hayatta gözler böyle çalışmaz - artık karakterinin gözleri de çalışmıyor. Bu mod gerçek dark adaptation'ı simüle ediyor. Zifiri karanlık bir odaya girdiğin ilk saniyelerde hiçbir şey göremezsin. Sonraki 20 in-game dakika boyunca (ayarlanabilir) gece görüşün gelişir, odada hareket edebilir hale gelirsin. Sonra parlak gün ışığına çıkarsın ve ekranda kısa bir göz kamaşması patlar; genişlemiş pupillerinin bedelini ödersin. Özellikler Yavaş alışma - gözler ~20 in-game dakikada uyum sağlar Üç ortam algısı - dışarı / aydınlık iç mekan / karanlık iç mekan adaptasyonu farklı etkiler Yumuşak decay, anında sıfırlama yok - karanlık odadan çıkmak adaptasyonunu hemen yakıp atmaz (dışarıda 10 dk, aydınlık iç mekanda 40 dk) Göz kamaşması efekti - adapte gözler parlak ışıkla karşılaşınca ekranda sıcak flaş, kapı spam'ine karşı cooldown korumalı Adapte görüş seninle hareket eder - karanlık odalarda karakterini takip eden yumuşak sıcak ışık (sadece singleplayer - aşağıya bak) 7 ayarlanabilir sandbox option - adaptasyon süresi, decay oranları, parlaklık tavanı, hassasiyet, glare on/off, glare süresi, cooldown Multiplayer Dünya-ışığı efekti MP'de tasarım gereği kapalı - paylaşımlı ışık buff'ı saklanan takım arkadaşlarını x-ray ederdi ve pusu mekaniğini bozardı. Adaptasyon yine internal olarak takip edilir, per-player glare flash hâlâ senin ekranında patlar. Deutsch Du betrittst in Build 42 einen Raum ohne Licht und siehst gar nichts. Echte Augen funktionieren nicht so - und jetzt deine Spielfigur auch nicht mehr. Dieses Mod simuliert echte Dunkeladaptation. In den ersten Sekunden in einem pechschwarzen Raum siehst du nichts. Über die nächsten 20 Spielminuten (konfigurierbar) baut sich deine Nachtsicht auf, bis du den Raum erfassen kannst. Trittst du danach in helles Tageslicht, blitzt eine kurze Blendung über den Bildschirm - deine geweiteten Pupillen zahlen den Preis. Funktionen Allmähliche Anpassung - Augen passen sich über ~20 Spielminuten an Drei Zonen - Außen / hell innen / dunkel innen wirken jeweils anders auf die Adaptation Sanftes Abklingen, kein sofortiges Zurücksetzen - der Gang aus einem dunklen Raum kostet nicht sofort die ganze Anpassung (10 min außen, 40 min hell innen) Blendungseffekt - adaptierte Augen treffen helles Licht: warmer Blitz auf dem Bildschirm, Cooldown gegen Tür-Spam Adaptierte Sicht folgt dir - sanftes warmes Umgebungslicht im dunklen Raum (nur Einzelspieler - siehe unten) 7 konfigurierbare Sandbox-Optionen - Anpassungszeit, Decay-Raten, Helligkeitsgrenze, Empfindlichkeit, Blendung an/aus, Blendungsdauer, Cooldown Mehrspieler Das Welt-Licht ist im Mehrspieler bewusst deaktiviert - ein geteilter Lichtbuff würde versteckte Mitspieler durchleuchten und Hinterhalte zerstören. Die Anpassung wird intern weiter verfolgt, und der per-player Blendungseffekt erscheint trotzdem auf deinem Bildschirm. Русский Заходишь в Build 42 в комнату без света - не видишь ничего. Настоящие глаза работают не так. И теперь глаза твоего персонажа - тоже. Этот мод симулирует настоящую адаптацию к темноте. Первые секунды в кромешно тёмной комнате ты ничего не видишь. На протяжении следующих 20 игровых минут (настраивается) ночное зрение нарастает, и ты можешь ориентироваться в комнате. Затем выходишь на яркий дневной свет - экран ослепляет короткая вспышка: расширенные зрачки платят свою цену. Особенности Постепенная адаптация - глаза привыкают за ~20 игровых минут Три зоны - улица / освещённое помещение / тёмное помещение по-разному влияют на адаптацию Плавное затухание, без мгновенного сброса - выход из тёмной комнаты не лишает тебя адаптации мгновенно (10 мин на улице, 40 мин в освещённом помещении) Эффект ослепления - адаптированные глаза попадают на яркий свет: тёплая вспышка на экране, кулдаун против спама дверей Адаптированное зрение следует за тобой - мягкий тёплый свет следует за персонажем в тёмных комнатах (только одиночная игра - см. ниже) 7 настраиваемых sandbox-опций - время адаптации, скорости затухания, максимальная яркость, чувствительность, вспышка вкл/выкл, длительность, кулдаун Сетевая игра Мировой свет по дизайну отключён в сетевой игре - общий световой бафф просвечивал бы прячущихся союзников и ломал засадную механику. Адаптация по-прежнему отслеживается внутренне, и per-player вспышка по-прежнему срабатывает на твоём экране.

description: Extensive Power Rework (Community fork) A community continuation of Hunter's Extensive Power Rework for Project Zomboid Build 42. Hunter stepped back from PZ modding and publicly invited community forks; this is one of those forks. What it does Power and water infrastructure overhaul. Substations and water treatment facilities are real, repairable objects. Players restore utilities to entire zones by completing repair tasks at the right locations. Stations The mod ships with 6 facilities scattered across Knox County. Each one must be repaired to restore power or water to its zones. Louisville Power Plant is the master prerequisite - bring it online before any other substation can carry power downstream. Louisville Power Plant (12120, 1617) - powers Louisville. Prereq for the whole grid. Louisville South Substation (14732, 4083) - powers West Point, Valley Station, Louisville Airport. Muldraugh Substation (10389, 10060) - powers Muldraugh, Rosewood, March Ridge, Fallas Lake. Riverside Relay (4832, 6279) - powers Riverside. Irvington Substation (2210, 13914) - powers Irvington, Echo Creek, Ekron, Brandenburg. Rosewood Water Treatment (8044, 15360) - waters every zone. What's in this fork The full v1.0.4 codebase carried forward B42.18 compatibility (sandbox JSON translations, current API) Additional Features (Community Fork additions) Everything below is new in the Community fork on top of Hunter's original. Original codebase and gameplay design remain Hunter's; this list tracks only what the fork adds. Gameplay Storm Blackouts - during thunderstorms, online substations have a configurable chance per 10-minute tick of being knocked offline by a lightning strike, forcing repair through the normal EPR flow. Three sandbox options to tune frequency and whether thunder is required (vs heavy rain). Server-side, sandbox-gated. Admin tooling EPR Debug Panel - admin / SP / -debug-only right-click submenu opens a tabbed window: Zones (per-zone power+water toggles), Facilities (Teleport, Flicker, Repair, Activate, Deactivate per substation + water plant), World (global override, noise burst, Force vanilla shutoff, Lightning strike random / ALL online). Mirrors the pattern of The Director and Better Vehicle Dynamics. Compatibility Pure Lua, no Java patches No item-script overrides - safe to remove without orphaning inventory Uses ModData on world objects: removing mid-save reverts repaired zones to non-functional but does not corrupt the save Server-friendly: drop into the Mods= line, restart Credits Original concept, codebase, and all of the work: Hunter, who opened the project for community forks when stepping back. Source Source code is on GitHub: github.com/grphx/extensive-power-community. Issues, suggestions, and pull requests welcome. Mod info Mod ID: EPR_Community Workshop ID: 3733603053

description: Moonlight Mayhem Moonlight Mayhem is a quality-of-life mod… if your preferred quality of life is living in constant fear, checking the clock every five seconds, and treating 6 PM like a scheduled execution. This mod changes zombie speed based on the time of day. During the day, things can stay somewhat normal. But once the moon rises and the timer hits your chosen start time, the dead stop dragging their feet and start running. During the day, you prepare. At night, you survive. What This Mod Does Moonlight Mayhem lets you set a daily time window where zombies become much more dangerous. By default, zombies become sprinters at night and return to a slower speed in the morning. You can change the start time, end time, night zombie speed, off-hours zombie speed, refresh behavior, tracking options, cleanup settings, and optional extra night spawns through sandbox options. Once the event starts, loaded zombies are refreshed so they switch to the correct speed. When the event ends, cleanup passes help force zombies back to the off-hours speed so they do not stay sprinters forever. No-Spawn Area Tool This update adds a new in-game tool that lets you mark areas where Moonlight Mayhem’s optional night spawns will not place zombies. This is useful for bases, safehouses, fenced compounds, farms, yards, or anywhere you do not want this mod’s extra night zombies appearing inside like they paid rent. To use it: Right-click the ground. Open the Moonlight Mayhem menu. Choose Enable Click-and-Drag No-Spawn Zone. Click and drag over the area you want protected. Release the mouse button to save it. The menu also includes: Show Saved Area Briefly — shows saved no-spawn areas for about 10 seconds. Clear All Saved No-Spawn Areas — clears all protected areas so you can redo them. Important: This only blocks Moonlight Mayhem’s own optional night zombie spawns. It does not control vanilla Project Zomboid respawns or zombies spawned by other mods. Build 42.19 Night Hunt Options This update adds more sandbox control for how dangerous nights become. You can enable Night Player Tracking Pulse, which makes zombies within the selected radius detect and move toward your location during active night hours. For example, with the default time window: 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM Zombies can be made to know where you are and start hunting toward your area. This does not update every zombie in the entire world at once, because that would probably make your PC file for divorce. Instead, it uses a controlled radius around the player. Sandbox options include: Night Zombie Speed — speed used during the night event. Off-Hours Zombie Speed — speed zombies return to after the event. Existing Zombie Check Speed — how often loaded zombies are refreshed. Existing Zombie Batch Size — how many zombies are handled per refresh. Cleanup Passes After End — helps prevent leftover sprinters. Night Player Tracking Pulse — makes nearby zombies hunt toward the player. Tracking Pulse Radius — how far the tracking effect reaches. Tracking Pulse Strength — how strongly zombies are drawn toward you. Tracking Pulse Frequency — how often the tracking pulse runs. Optional Night Zombie Spawns — spawns extra zombies near, but not directly on, the player. No-Spawn Areas — lets you protect areas from this mod’s optional night spawns. Keep tracking and spawn options low or disabled for a calmer experience. Turn them up if you want pain. Default Behavior By default, the nightmare begins at: 6:00 PM And ends at: 6:00 AM That means every evening becomes a deadline. Loot, build, organize, and pretend you have your life together during the day. But when the clock gets close to 6 PM, know where your exits are. Because once night hits, the dead start running. If tracking is enabled, they may also start moving toward you like you personally insulted their entire bloodline. If optional night spawns are enabled, use the No-Spawn Area Tool to protect your base or other important areas from this mod’s custom spawns. Compatibility Designed for Build 42.19 Originally made for Build 42.18 Includes an in-game right-click no-spawn area tool Made mainly for single player Multiplayer may work, but it is not my main focus Mods that heavily change zombie behavior may conflict Multiplayer Note My main focus with this mod is single player. If this works in multiplayer, awesome. But multiplayer in Project Zomboid can be a hot mess, and I am not planning to go super deep into multiplayer fixes for this mod. I have a full-time job, a husband, and a daughter, so I usually mod during whatever free time I have left. Please understand that single player is the main focus here. Final Notes I am a mother of a two-year-old, and I also have a full-time job. I usually play or mod once I get home, my family is taken care of, and my daughter is asleep. description: Seed Season Indicator A mod that overlays markers on seed and seed packet icons in your inventory to indicate the current month's sowing season status. Lets you tell at a glance whether each seed is ready to plant right now. In vanilla, checking the sowing season requires opening the Info → Discovered Recipes and Media → Agriculture tab. This mod overlays the indicator directly on seed icons in the inventory, so you can tell whether a seed is plantable right now without opening any other window. Marker Types Green ★ — Best month (bestMonth): peak yield period Green ● — In season (sowMonth, excluding best/risk): safe to plant Yellow ● — Risk month (riskMonth): plantable, but with a risk of reduced yield Red ● — Out of season (outside sowMonth): cannot plant now Display Condition (Vanilla-Compliant) Markers appear only on seeds and seed packets for which you have read the seed packet and learned the corresponding sowing season recipe. Season Info in the "Category" Column The "Category" column in inventory detail view also shows the season status, and can be sorted by it. Display examples: Gardening (Best) / Gardening (In Season) / Gardening (Risk) / Gardening (Out of Season) Clicking the "Category" column header sorts by Best → In Season → Risk → Out of Season → Unread → Gardening (others) Useful for bringing "seeds ready to plant right now" to the top of the list Options Configure from Options → Mods → Seed Season Indicator. Enable Indicator (default: ON): toggles marker rendering and category column extension Markers not showing? This mod follows the sandbox setting PlantGrowingSeasons. If it is disabled, your world has no growing seasons, so all markers are intentionally hidden (there is no "in/out of season" to show). In particular, the "Outbreak" difficulty preset has this PlantGrowingSeasons setting disabled. Also note that markers only appear on seeds whose seed packet you have already read (see "Display Condition" above). Compatibility Supports: Build 42 Standalone — works with vanilla, no additional mods required When used together with mods that draw "read" markers on seed packets, the markers from both mods may appear side by side on the seed packet icon (no functional impact) Not compatible with inventory UI overhaul mods that completely redefine the ISInventoryPane class (neither marker rendering nor category column extension will function) Technical Notes Wraps ISInventoryPane:renderdetails to overlay marker textures on seed/seed packet icons via drawTexture Wraps ISInventoryPane:refreshContainer to overwrite the sort key (v.cat) with custom category keys Category column display text is replaced via drawText interception (non-destructive approach, does not call item:setDisplayCategory) Settings are saved via PZAPI.ModOptions to ~/Zomboid/ModOptions.ini Workshop ID: 3734639991 Mod ID: SeedSeasonIndicator

Airdrop Mod Compatibility: Project Zomboid Build 42.19 only. Main target: multiplayer and dedicated servers. This mod adds optimized server-side airdrop events to Project Zomboid multiplayer. The server creates one active airdrop event at a time, spawns a lootable crate vehicle/container, fills it with controlled weighted loot, adds event zombies around the area, sends temporary markers to the correct players, and safely cleans everything up when the event expires or is removed. Important Compatibility Notice Built for Project Zomboid Build 42.19. Designed for multiplayer and dedicated server use. Not intended for older Build 42 versions. The chat commands are available only in client/server multiplayer. How The Event Works The server runs the airdrop scheduler. By default, the server attempts one airdrop every 24 real-life hours. Only one airdrop can exist at a time. If an airdrop is already active, the next cycle is skipped. Each event has a limited lifetime, configured in Sandbox options. When the timer ends, the crate marker is removed and the active event state is cleared. Drop Modes Mode 1 - Private Player Drop The server chooses one random online player. The airdrop is spawned near that player, not directly on top of them. The chosen player receives the timer, direction arrow and approximate map zone. Other players can still find the crate naturally, but they do not receive the private marker. Mode 2 - Global Fixed Point Drop The server chooses one fixed map point from the configured list. All online players receive the global map zone and direction arrow. The same fixed point is not selected twice in a row. If the selected chunk is not loaded yet, the zone is still announced. The crate is spawned only when a player gets close enough to the marked area. This keeps the event optimized and avoids forcing unloaded map chunks. Location Validation The mod validates the drop location before spawning the crate. It avoids invalid or unsafe squares such as: water, rivers and lakes tiles without floor indoor rooms and buildings roofs and constructions above the square walls, doors, stairs and trees solid or blocked tiles vehicle intersections unloaded chunks Loot System The crate uses a weighted loot system with configurable categories: Military Food Medical Tools Ammo Survival Military clothing Rare loot Items are validated before being added to the container. Invalid items are logged instead of breaking the event. Loot Levels Level 1 - Simple: basic loot, up to 30 zombies. Level 2 - Medium: medium/good loot, up to 60 zombies, with a small sprinter chance. Level 3 - Top: stronger loot, 80 to 120 zombies. Level 4 - Elite Military: military-focused loot, 135 to 200 zombies, larger spawn radius. Loot levels can control zombie count, zombie radius, item count, item repeat limits, loot weight multipliers and category weights. You can also disable level defaults and manually tune many values through Sandbox options. Markers And UI Small vanilla-style countdown timer. Direction arrow pointing to the approximate zone. Approximate blinking circle inside the in-game map. No ground circle is created in the world. The map marker color is configurable in Sandbox options. The marker does not reveal the exact crate location. Zombies And Decorations Event zombies spawn around the crate according to the selected loot level or manual Sandbox values. Zombies are distributed around the area instead of stacked on one tile. Optional impact decorations can add dead bodies, blood and crater/scorch marks near the airdrop. The mod does not create explosions, fire or destructive map damage. Admin Commands /drop - force an airdrop event. /drop1 or /drop 1 - force a Level 1 airdrop. /drop2 or /drop 2 - force a Level 2 airdrop. /drop3 or /drop 3 - force a Level 3 airdrop. /drop4 or /drop 4 - force a Level 4 airdrop. /nodrop - remove the current active or pending airdrop. Commands require admin/moderator-style access. Forced drops bypass the scheduled timer, but they still respect the one-active-airdrop rule. Sandbox Options The mod includes Sandbox options for: enabling or disabling the mod event interval in real hours airdrop lifetime drop mode loot level manual loot limits loot categories zombie count and radius marker radius and marker color direction arrow and map marker toggles location search attempts Mode 2 fixed-point search radius optional /chopper trigger impact decorations debug logs Performance Notes The system is designed to be light on dedicated servers: No heavy per-frame map scans. No constant OnTick spawn checks. Server-side scheduling is handled in real time. Location validation runs only when a spawn is attempted. Pending Mode 2 drops materialize only when players approach the zone. The server keeps one active event state at a time. Summary Airdrop Mod is a multiplayer-focused event system for Project Zomboid Build 42.19. It creates timed, configurable and server-controlled airdrop events with loot, zombies, map guidance, admin tools and safe cleanup. Workshop ID: 3738819163 Mod ID: AirdropMod

description: READ BEFORE ANYTHING !! For Any Bug Report For Any Suggestion Before saying "it's not working", unsuscribe, resuscribe. Build a pipe network, hook it up to your rain collectors, and let it water your farm automatically — drawing from the barrels you already have. A clean, Build 42 take on the classic irrigation pipes, rebuilt from the ground up. Singleplayer & Multiplayer — works in co-op and on dedicated servers. 🔧 How It Works Craft Irrigation Pipes from a metal pipe, a hammer and a screwdriver (4 pipes per craft). Place pipes on the ground — right-click a tile, pick a shape (line, cross, corner, T) and drop it with the placement cursor. Pipes lay on bare ground and on built floors. Connect them into a network — pipes link to each other and to adjacent rain collectors. Each connected network is detected automatically. Crops get watered automatically — every cycle, pipes water the farming plots within their radius using water from the barrels in the same network. Smart Pipes fill each plant up to its optimal level, then stop (no waste). Shared water pool — barrels connected in the same network share and balance their water: a full barrel and an empty one even out over time. Fertilize your crops too — NEW in v1.2 — pour a bag of Fertilizer or Compost into a connected rain collector, and the network automatically fertilizes the crops it waters (one safe dose per plant — it never over-fertilizes or kills a crop). Compost is used first (renewable, reusable each season); fertilizer is kept as backup. Right-click a barrel to see its stored doses, or a crop to see if it's Fertilized / Composted. 🔎 Network View Right-click any pipe and choose Show Network to highlight every pipe (blue) and barrel (green) in that network, with a quick readout: number of pipes, number of barrels, and total water in the pool. 📦 Items Irrigation Pipe — crafted from a Metal Pipe + Hammer + Screwdriver. One item; the shape (line / cross / corner / T) is chosen when you place it. ⚙️ Sandbox Options Enable Auto-Watering (on/off) Watering Interval (1–60 in-game minutes, default 10) Watering Radius (0–10 tiles; 0 = the pipe’s own tile) Smart Pipes (fill to optimal vs fixed small amount) Smart Pipes Max Fill (per cycle) Shared Water Pool (on/off) Enable Fertigation (on/off, default on) Fertigation Quality (simulated Farming skill 0–10 — higher = better chance of a yield bonus) Doses per Fertilizer/Compost bag (how many plants one poured bag fertilizes) 📋 Requirements & Notes Project Zomboid Build 42. To activate this, simply enable the mod "U.S. M60A3 Drive and Shoot by Papa_Chad". It is not recommended to have the standard variation active at the same time. Features Animated Tracks Animated Hatches and Doors Heavily Armored Hull Fully Animated Turret Functional Main Cannon and Coaxial Machine Gun Multiple variations of military skin Mod for B42 SP and MP. Compatible with existing saves. Compatible with KI5 vehicles and other mods. Weapons 105mm M68 Cannon Uses 105mm APFSDS (Armor Piercing) and 105mm HE (High Explosive) rounds. Armor Piercing rounds can penetrate walls, vehicles, and multiple entities, losing energy with each penetration. High Explosive rounds detonate on impact, causing significant area damage—handle with care. M240 Coaxial Machine Gun Uses 7.62x51mm ammunition. All weapons grant XP when killing zombies and do not use infinite ammunition. Ammo loot is proportional to the game's vanilla ammunition system. Enhanced Aiming System When aiming, a circle indicates the mouse position, while a triangle shows where the cannon is actually pointing. You may fire at any time, but the projectile will follow the turret’s orientation—not the cursor—unless both are aligned. It is necessary to have the Military Tool Kit installed. If you want me to keep updating my mods, please consider supporting me :) I'm open to commissions. Contact me via my Ko-Fi or add me as a friend on Steam. On Lockdown This mod cannot be modified by anyone else, for anything else, at all, ever. Even if the user disappears, they would much rather you didn't touch the fruits of their hard labour.
