🚰 Water Pipes Bring real plumbing to Knox County. Project Zomboid lets you hoard water in barrels and pray for rain — but never move it where you actually need it. Water Pipes changes that. Lay a real pipe network through your base and let water (and other liquids) flow exactly where you want it. 🔧 What you can do 🧩 Build a pipe network across floors and walls — pipes snap together automatically into straights, corners, junctions and crossings. ⬆️ Go vertical. Run pipes up walls to link floors, so rooftop rain collectors can feed the kitchen below. 💧 Share your water. Connect barrels and rain collectors so the whole network draws from a single shared supply. 🚰 Plumb your sinks. A connected tap pulls straight from your network — no more hauling water bottles back and forth. ⛽ Fuel your generator. Pipe petrol to your generator and keep it topped up automatically. 🛢️ Pump any liquid. Water, petrol, whatever — your taps serve whatever the network holds. Dirty rain water comes out of the tap purified and ready to drink. 🧰 How to use it 🔧 Grab a Pipe Wrench and some Pipes. 🏗️ Open the build menu and find the Piping category. Place floor pipes to route your network; use the vertical pipe (rotate it for North/West walls) to climb between floors. 🔗 Run a pipe onto the same tile as a barrel, rain collector or sink to hook it into the network. 🪛 With the wrench in hand, plumb a sink or connect a generator from its right-click menu. 🔍 Lost track of your plumbing? Right-click any pipe → Show pipe network to light it all up: pipes in red, water sources in green, taps and generators in blue. ♻️ Changed your mind? Dismantle pipes to recover your materials. ✅ Good to know 👥 Multiplayer ready — build and plumb together on your server. 🌍 Bilingual — full English and Spanish support. 🧱 Designed for Build 42. 🎨 Want to help with the art? Love drawing pipes, fittings and fixtures? If you'd like to contribute artwork or tilesets to the mod, get in touch with the author right here on the Workshop page — collaborators are very welcome! ⚠️ Before you remove the mod Heads-up: like most Build 42 mods that add buildable objects, removing this mod from an existing save (especially on a multiplayer server) can trigger a "WorldDictionary" load error. It is fixable — just follow this guide: How to fix World Dictionary errors. And as always, back up your save before adding or removing any mod. 🐞 Bugs & requests 💬 Any request, suggestion or bug can be reported here: github.com/carthon/WaterPipesModPZ/issues ☕ Support the mod ❤️ Enjoying Water Pipes? description: Companion Dogs [ALPHA] Adopt a stray. Feed it, earn its trust, and it becomes a real companion that follows you, watches your back, and fights at your side. But a dog is a responsibility - not a cheat. Built for Build 42 (42.19). Works in singleplayer, co-op AND dedicated servers, and is safe to add to existing saves. ALPHA - playable and stable, but a work in progress. Four breeds so far: the Caramelo (the classic Brazilian street mutt), the German Shepherd (a warrior), the Golden Retriever (a hunter), and the rare Husky (a cargo hauler born for the cold). Dogs can now breed and raise puppies. More breeds and vet care are coming. Known issue - dog looks crumpled / has no texture Project Zomboid has a limitation with modded animals: if the mod is enabled while you're already in a save, the dog can show up crumpled, distorted, or untextured. Fix: enable Companion Dogs in the main-menu Mods list, then completely close and restart Project Zomboid (quit to desktop, not just back to the main menu) before loading your save. In co-op/multiplayer the host must enable it in the main-menu Mods list too (not just the server/co-op mod selection) and fully restart the server. A complete restart is what loads the dog model correctly. This is a common issue with animal mods and can't be fixed automatically from the mod's side. Details & reports here: this discussion thread. What your dog does Tame a stray - feed wild dogs to build trust (~4 treats and it's yours). Caramelos roam towns naturally; rarer German Shepherds turn up around police and military buildings, and the occasional Golden Retriever in residential houses. The rare Husky roams outdoors in winter and turns up year-round in pet shops and vet clinics. Follow / Stay / Guard - three modes. Command it the immersive way with the hold-Q radial (Come / Follow / Stay / Whistle / Attack) or the right-click menu. Rides with you - get in a vehicle and your dog comes along, out of harm's way. No more companions lost to the road. Early warning - your dog smells zombies you can't see: a quiet growl for distant threats, a loud bark when they're close. Three alert modes (Alert / Discreet / Silent) trade safety for stealth. Survivable combat - not a murder machine. The Caramelo knocks zombies down to buy you time, while a trained German Shepherd can take one down on its own. Dogs get stressed and panic, and retreat to your side when badly hurt. They can't be killed by zombies or cars - only neglect (hunger/thirst) can take them, for good. Assisted hunting - switch on Hunt mode and your dog hunts nearby wild game (rabbits, raccoons, deer), running prey down and holding big game for you to finish. Its keen nose also widens your foraging Search Mode. Cargo dog - craft or loot leather saddlebags, strap them on, and your dog hauls extra loot for you. Capacity scales with its Strength, and it's true offload: the cargo weighs nothing on you and nothing is lost. Needs & loyalty - hunger, thirst, stress and loyalty all decay. Neglect it and it disobeys; care for it and it heals. Pet it or sleep beside it to ease your own boredom & sadness. Companion moodles - a HUD icon while a fed, loyal dog stays near: the Caramelo's "Good Company", the Shepherd's "Courage" (eases your panic), and the Golden's "Keen Nose" (faster Foraging, Trapping and Aiming), and the Husky's "Warmed" (lighter load, steadier stamina and warmth in the cold). Skills & genetics - dogs earn XP (Scent, Combat, Obedience and Hunting) and are born with individual trait genes. Every dog is a little different. Breeding & puppies - a healthy, well-fed pair of your dogs can conceive on their own. Puppies inherit their parents' genes (cross-breed mutts included, with lineage shown), grow up at your side, and mature into full adult dogs keeping their name, loyalty, skills and pedigree. Management window - a clean panel: loyalty hearts, need bars, current mode, skills with XP, inborn traits, and hover tooltips explaining each system. Every benefit has a cost Barking warns you - and attracts zombies. A stressed or starving dog barks on its own, drawing the horde. Your dog survives zombies and traffic - but a starving, neglected dog dies for good. No respawn. Loyalty fades if you don't feed and interact. Multiplayer Built for multiplayer from the ground up - sounds, animations, knockdowns and state replicate cleanly across clients. Works on co-op (listen host) and dedicated servers. Co-op hosts: enable Companion Dogs in your main-menu Mods list, not just the co-op mod selection - otherwise your dog appears without its model/texture (a Project Zomboid quirk for host-side custom models). On dedicated servers each player just needs the mod subscribed/enabled - no host-side step. Real dog, real sounds Custom dog models with real dog animations and real dog voices (bark / growl / whine / idle). Known alpha limitations: when you carry the dog, its inventory icon, corpse/skeleton, droppings and footstep sounds still use placeholder art - these will be replaced. The live, walking dog is the real thing. Compatibility Build 42 (42.19+). Singleplayer, co-op & dedicated servers. Many sandbox options to tune combat, spawn rate, alerts and more. English, Portugues (Brasil), Italiano, Simplified & Traditional Chinese (简体/繁體中文), Japanese (日本語), and Thai (ไทย). Safe to add to existing saves. Roadmap - coming in Beta More breeds & rarity - additional breeds, each with its own traits and skill-XP boosts. Genes scale with rarity: the Caramelo is humble, rarer breeds are born stronger. Some show up only in the right place or season. Vet care - wounds, infections, bleeding, and veterinary meds to patch your dog back up. Art & audio polish - custom icons, refined skins, new breed models, and better dog sounds. Recommended add-ons Mods that pair well with Companion Dogs: TDDUP Companion Dogs Dialogue Bridge by The General - adds emotional dialogue and reactions between your spouse and your companion dog: feeding, petting, sickness, grief and more. Credits Animations derived from Quaternius "Ultimate Animated Animals" (CC0). Dog sounds from BigSoundBank / Joseph Sardin (CC0). Custom dog model, skeleton & skinning by the author. Translations Simplified & Traditional Chinese (简体/繁體中文) translation by duwenju1203. Italian translation by d4rk83. Japanese translation by 一匹狼. Thai translation by momineko. Asset usage All content in this mod - models, textures, animations, sounds and code - is for use within this mod only. Please do not extract, repackage, redistribute or reuse any of it in other mods or projects without our explicit permission. Support If you enjoy the mod, you can buy me a coffee - thank you! description: Functional Fuel Tankers Adds working fuel-transfer functionality to any vehicle in Project Zomboid Build 42. Designate any vehicle as a fuel tanker through the in-game admin panel, fill it from gas station pumps, store fuel, refuel nearby vehicles, fill gas cans, and more. Update - June 16, 2026 Added sandbox options to configure tanker capacity, transfer speed, transfer distance, hose requirements, and menu visibility Added in-game admin panel to designate any loaded vehicle as a fuel tanker without editing any files The '78 AM General M35 Series Trucks mod is no longer required. Any vehicle can be used as a fuel tanker Added language support. All mod text is now stored in translation files. Language packs coming soon Improved and cleaned up core logic for better stability in both singleplayer and multiplayer Features Designate any loaded vehicle as a fuel tanker through the in-game admin panel Fill the tanker from gas station pumps Fill gas cans from the tanker Pour gas cans into the tanker Refuel nearby vehicles from the tanker Siphon fuel from nearby vehicles into the tanker Check the tanker's current fuel level Right-click menu and radial menu support Multiplayer support with live sync across all players Partial transfer support for cancelled actions Configurable sandbox options How to Use Stand near any designated fuel tanker and use the right-click menu or the vehicle radial menu. Available options depend on what you are holding, what vehicles are nearby, and whether the tanker, pump, gas can, or target vehicle has fuel or available space. Filling the tanker from a pump Park the tanker next to a powered gas station pump, stand near both, and select the fill option. If the option does not appear, reposition the tanker closer to the pump. Filling or emptying a gas can Hold an empty or partial gas can to fill it from the tanker. Hold a gas can with fuel in it to pour it into the tanker. Refueling or siphoning vehicles Park the target vehicle close to the tanker and stand near both. By default a hose is required for vehicle-to-vehicle transfers. This can be turned off in sandbox options. Managing Tanker Vehicles Any vehicle can be designated as a fuel tanker without editing any files. This option is available to server admins, moderators, overseers, GMs, and in singleplayer. Open the right-click menu and select Fuel Tanker then Fuel Tanker Admin Use the search box to find any vehicle by name or script ID Select a vehicle from the list and press Add To remove a vehicle, select it from the selected list and press Remove Selected Press Save to apply changes Changes take effect immediately for all online players and persist through server restarts. Default Tanker Vehicles The following vehicles are set as tankers by default. These can be removed or replaced at any time through the admin panel. Base.78amgeneralM49A2C Base.78amgeneralM49A2CFuelTanker Base.78amgeneralM50A3 Base.78amgeneralM50A3FuelTanker Sandbox Options Tanker fuel capacity Fuel transfer speed Maximum transfer distance Whether hoses are required for vehicle-to-vehicle transfers Enable or disable right-click menu support Enable or disable radial menu support Multiplayer Fuel transfers are handled server-side so tanker, vehicle, and gas can levels stay in sync between all players. The tanker vehicle list is pushed to every player on join and updated live when an admin makes changes. No reconnect required. Make sure the mod is enabled on the server and installed by every player. Troubleshooting If an option is missing from the menu, check the following: You are close enough to the tanker The vehicle is designated as a tanker in the admin panel The gas pump has power and fuel remaining The tanker is parked close enough to the pump You are holding a gas can when using gas can options The gas can has room when filling from the tanker The gas can has fuel when pouring into the tanker You have a hose in your inventory for vehicle transfers, unless the hose requirement is disabled in sandbox options The target vehicle has room for fuel The source vehicle has fuel to give Notes Removing a vehicle from the tanker list does not delete the fuel stored in it No required mods. Each occupation is a different flavor of feral desire, from the silent, padded grace of a Domestic Shorthair to the thunderous, ground-shaking power of a Clydesdale Horse. Want to be a predator? mod_name: [B41/B42] Trample Steam - Spring Launcher Trap From Black Ops 2
description: The Trample Steam from Call of Duty: Black Ops 2 zombies, rebuilt for Project Zomboid Build 42(Backported to B41). An engine powered spring-loaded floor trap you weld together and place on a tile. Anything that steps on it gets launched. Zombies ragdoll, land, and die. The board flings its victim, ratchets itself down, dings, and waits for the next one. By default, this is intended for use in Singleplayer / Co-Op multiplayer as a zombie/animal trap, but can be adjusted to work and be balanced in PvP servers, a method of travel(chaining), simple zombie deterrence, or many other usage scenarios with sandbox settings. It should be lightweight enough to allow for several dozen to be simultaneously deployed. (Placing trap is different from deploying, placing does nothing but spawn the static model on the ground and does not allow the trap to work) The Trap Craft it with welding gear and scrap (Requires skills: Mechanics 3, Welding 3, Electrical 2). The recipe comes from a magazine, "How to Use: Trample Steam", which spawns about as rarely as the generator manual. Engineers and Welders know it from the start. Deploying one requires Mechanics 2, a technical occupation(Mechanic, Engineer, Electrician or Welder), or having read the magazine. Both crafting recipe and deployment have sandbox toggles if you just want to fling zombies. Click-to-place deployment with a live preview. description: Working, map-wide text messaging network for Project Zomboid, built for co-op. Find a pager, get your own number, and stay in touch with your group from anywhere on the map. Designed around an immersive communication ladder: use proximity voice chat up close, walkie-talkies at medium range, and pagers for everything beyond that. The pager is your long-range tier. Intended when global text chat is off and not in an external voice call. Other pager mods are depreciated, and the main issue with using in game voice chat among a group of friends is the long distance barrier where you simply cannot contact someone. This bridges that gap, while still being time period accurate. Additionally, this is a great option for in game Server Browser Discovery / PvPvE servers. If you are using this in a large scale server feel free to directly work with me for additional features, and please consider supporting my development, as well as anyone else that is able! Core Every pager has a unique number (XXX-XXXX). Send and receive short text pages to any number, anywhere on the map. Offline delivery: pages queue on the server and arrive the moment the recipient reconnects. Messages live on the physical pager, so they travel with the device. Talk to your group Contacts - save names to numbers and reply with one click. Channels / Groups - define a group of numbers and page the whole team at once. Broadcast - page every pager on the network (toggleable). SOS beacon - emergency broadcast that pages everyone and attaches your location. Quick pages - fire preset phrases ("On my way", "Need backup!", "All clear"...) straight from the right-click menu, no typing. Location & awareness Optionally attach your coordinates to a page; the recipient sees the position plus distance and a compass bearing (e.g. ~340t NE). Sharing is your choice per server: Off, ask-per-page, or always on. An SOS still shares location unless it's fully off. Share my number nearby adds you to nearby players' contacts automatically for first meet-ups. Say my number makes your character read it out loud for voice chat. Batteries Pagers run on a battery that lasts about three in-game months (tunable in sandbox). When it dies the pager goes quiet until you Replace battery from the right-click menu using an ordinary Battery. Remaining charge shows on the screen as BAT %. PvPvE Faction scoping - optionally stop rival factions from paging (or eavesdropping on) each other. Factionless players are never cut off. Block list - block a number and its pages never reach you. Block a griefer straight from your inbox. Anti-spam - optional per-player send cooldown for busy servers. Quality of life Holster the pager in the walkie-talkie belt slot. Rebindable hotkey (default P) opens the pager you're carrying and auto-activates a fresh one in a single press. Beep + on-screen message preview when a page arrives, an unread badge on the item, and a per-pager mute / Do-Not-Disturb. Read receipts, so you know your page was actually seen. Difficulty/Realism Presets: Custom, Convenient, Almost Realistic, and Ultra Realistic. Pager Tower System(Only enabled in Ultra Realistic) Craftable relay tower — requires Electrical 5 and is learned only from the Pager Tower Schematics magazine, which only appears in loot when a tower is actually needed(receive only pagers and/or required for signal). Multiple towers, each its own network node with an incrementing number (000-0001, 000-0002), its own coverage circle, inbox, and console. Towers auto-add as a contact to any pager that comes within range. Rename a tower at the tower — the new name syncs everywhere. Power source option: Grid or Generator / Generator only / None. Tower comms option: send-and-receive or send-only. Per-player tower limit (0 = unlimited; admins exempt). Sandbox options Multiplayer Built for co-op first: all routing is server-authoritative - number allocation, delivery, offline queueing, signal range and faction checks all live on the host. Notes Built for Build 42; backported to Build 41. Uses the base game's Pager item, so it fits in naturally and turns up in normal electronics loot. Electricians can also craft one. Safe to add to an existing save. Permissions All code, UI, networking and sandbox logic in this mod are original. The poster art is original; the inventory icon and world model are derived from the base game's vanilla pager. Please ask before reuploading, repackaging or reusing parts of it. description: Build 42.19 compatible modular backpack system for Project Zomboid. Custom Backpack System [B42.19] A modular backpack customization mod for Project Zomboid Build 42.19. Upgrade a backpack with side bags, tool mounts, a hydration pack, an ergonomic frame, a thermal pad, and other useful attachments. This mod is not limited to increasing storage capacity. It allows you to add separate left and right containers, display mounted tools on the outside of the backpack, and combine equipment that supports movement, combat, temperature management, and endurance recovery. Main Features []Upgrade backpacks through Tailoring []Add separate left and right side-bag containers []Install independent left and right tool mounts []Display mounted tools on the correct side of the backpack []Add a hydration pack []Improve movement and combat handling with an ergonomic frame []Reduce discomfort and temperature effects with a thermal pad []Improve endurance recovery while resting []Supports denim, leather, and aramid materials []Singleplayer and multiplayer support Independent Storage System The left and right side bags function as separate containers from the main backpack. []Main backpack container []Left side-bag container Right side-bag container A fully upgraded backpack can therefore provide up to three separate storage areas. Use them to organize food, medical supplies, tools, ammunition, or any other equipment without mixing everything into one container. Tool Mounts Independent tool mounts can be installed on the left and right sides of the backpack. Tools attached to the left mount are displayed on the left side of the backpack, while tools attached to the right mount are displayed on the right side. This allows frequently used tools or weapons to be carried separately from the backpack containers. Ergonomic Frame The ergonomic frame improves backpack handling and combat movement. Server administrators can adjust the following effects: []Normal movement speed []Movement speed while aiming with a firearm []Movement speed while holding a melee weapon in combat stance []Aiming speed Weapon attack speed Vanilla Shift movement while aiming is preserved, allowing players to use the normal faster combat-movement controls. Thermal Pad The thermal pad helps characters operate for longer periods in difficult environments. Improve your character’s skills and gradually build the ideal backpack for your play style. Supported Game Modes []Project Zomboid Build 42.19 []Singleplayer Multiplayer For multiplayer use, the mod must be enabled by both the server and connecting players.
